vulg: in principio erat Verbum et Verbum erat apud Deum et Deus erat Verbum
clem: [In principio erat Verbum, et Verbum erat apud Deum, et Deus erat Verbum.
tr: εν αρχη ην ο λογος και ο λογος ην προς τον θεον και θεος ην ο λογος
kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

vulg: hoc erat in principio apud Deum
clem: Hoc erat in principio apud Deum.
tr: ουτος ην εν αρχη προς τον θεον
kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.

vulg: omnia per ipsum facta sunt et sine ipso factum est nihil quod factum est
clem: Omnia per ipsum facta sunt: et sine ipso factum est nihil, quod factum est.
tr: παντα δι αυτου εγενετο και χωρις αυτου εγενετο ουδε εν ο γεγονεν
kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

vulg: in ipso vita erat et vita erat lux hominum
clem: In ipso vita erat, et vita erat lux hominum:
tr: εν αυτω ζωη ην και η ζωη ην το φως των ανθρωπων
kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

vulg: et lux in tenebris lucet et tenebrae eam non conprehenderunt
clem: et lux in tenebris lucet, et tenebr eam non comprehenderunt.
tr: και το φως εν τη σκοτια φαινει και η σκοτια αυτο ου κατελαβεν
kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

vulg: fuit homo missus a Deo cui nomen erat Iohannes
clem: Fuit homo missus a Deo, cui nomen erat Joannes.
tr: εγενετο ανθρωπος απεσταλμενος παρα θεου ονομα αυτω ιωαννης
kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

vulg: hic venit in testimonium ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine ut omnes crederent per illum
clem: Hic venit in testimonium ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine, ut omnes crederent per illum.
tr: ουτος ηλθεν εις μαρτυριαν ινα μαρτυρηση περι του φωτος ινα παντες πιστευσωσιν δι αυτου
kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

vulg: non erat ille lux sed ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine
clem: Non erat ille lux, sed ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine.
tr: ουκ ην εκεινος το φως αλλ ινα μαρτυρηση περι του φωτος
kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

vulg: erat lux vera quae inluminat omnem hominem venientem in mundum
clem: Erat lux vera, qu illuminat omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum.
tr: ην το φως το αληθινον ο φωτιζει παντα ανθρωπον ερχομενον  εις τον κοσμον
kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

vulg: in mundo erat et mundus per ipsum factus est et mundus eum non cognovit
clem: In mundo erat, et mundus per ipsum factus est, et mundus eum non cognovit.
tr: εν τω κοσμω ην και ο κοσμος δι αυτου εγενετο και ο κοσμος αυτον ουκ εγνω
kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

vulg: in propria venit et sui eum non receperunt
clem: In propria venit, et sui eum non receperunt.
tr: εις τα ιδια ηλθεν και οι ιδιοι αυτον ου παρελαβον
kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

vulg: quotquot autem receperunt eum dedit eis potestatem filios Dei fieri his qui credunt in nomine eius
clem: Quotquot autem receperunt eum, dedit eis potestatem filios Dei fieri, his qui credunt in nomine ejus:
tr: οσοι δε ελαβον αυτον εδωκεν αυτοις εξουσιαν τεκνα θεου γενεσθαι τοις πιστευουσιν εις το ονομα αυτου
kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

vulg: qui non ex sanguinibus neque ex voluntate carnis neque ex voluntate viri sed ex Deo nati sunt
clem: qui non ex sanguinibus, neque ex voluntate carnis, neque ex voluntate viri, sed ex Deo nati sunt.
tr: οι ουκ εξ αιματων ουδε εκ θεληματος σαρκος ουδε εκ θεληματος ανδρος αλλ εκ θεου εγεννηθησαν
kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

vulg: et Verbum caro factum est et habitavit in nobis et vidimus gloriam eius gloriam quasi unigeniti a Patre plenum gratiae et veritatis
clem: Et Verbum caro factum est, et habitavit in nobis: et vidimus gloriam ejus, gloriam quasi unigeniti a Patre plenum grati et veritatis.
tr: και ο λογος σαρξ εγενετο και εσκηνωσεν εν ημιν και εθεασαμεθα την δοξαν αυτου δοξαν ως μονογενους παρα πατρος πληρης χαριτος και αληθειας
kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

vulg: Iohannes testimonium perhibet de ipso et clamat dicens hic erat quem dixi vobis qui post me venturus est ante me factus est quia prior me erat
clem: Joannes testimonium perhibet de ipso, et clamat dicens: Hic erat quem dixi: Qui post me venturus est, ante me factus est: quia prior me erat.
tr: ιωαννης μαρτυρει περι αυτου και κεκραγεν λεγων ουτος ην ον ειπον ο οπισω μου ερχομενος εμπροσθεν μου γεγονεν οτι πρωτος μου ην
kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

vulg: et de plenitudine eius nos omnes accepimus et gratiam pro gratia
clem: Et de plenitudine ejus nos omnes accepimus, et gratiam pro gratia:
tr: και εκ του πληρωματος αυτου ημεις παντες ελαβομεν και χαριν αντι χαριτος
kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

vulg: quia lex per Mosen data est gratia et veritas per Iesum Christum facta est
clem: quia lex per Moysen data est, gratia et veritas per Jesum Christum facta est.
tr: οτι ο νομος δια μωσεως εδοθη η χαρις και η αληθεια δια ιησου χριστου εγενετο
kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

vulg: Deum nemo vidit umquam unigenitus Filius qui est in sinu Patris ipse enarravit
clem: Deum nemo vidit umquam: unigenitus Filius, qui est in sinu Patris, ipse enarravit.]
tr: θεον ουδεις εωρακεν πωποτε ο μονογενης υιος ο ων εις τον κολπον του πατρος εκεινος εξηγησατο
kjv: No man hath seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

vulg: et hoc est testimonium Iohannis quando miserunt Iudaei ab Hierosolymis sacerdotes et Levitas ad eum ut interrogarent eum tu quis es
clem: Et hoc est testimonium Joannis, quando miserunt Judi ab Jerosolymis sacerdotes et Levitas ad eum ut interrogarent eum: Tu quis es?
tr: και αυτη εστιν η μαρτυρια του ιωαννου οτε απεστειλαν οι ιουδαιοι εξ ιεροσολυμων ιερεις και λευιτας ινα ερωτησωσιν αυτον συ τις ει
kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

vulg: et confessus est et non negavit et confessus est quia non sum ego Christus
clem: Et confessus est, et non negavit, et confessus est: Quia non sum ego Christus.
tr: και ωμολογησεν και ουκ ηρνησατο και ωμολογησεν οτι ουκ ειμι εγω ο χριστος
kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

vulg: et interrogaverunt eum quid ergo Helias es tu et dicit non sum propheta es tu et respondit non
clem: Et interrogaverunt eum: Quid ergo? Elias es tu? Et dixit: Non sum. Propheta es tu? Et respondit: Non.
tr: και ηρωτησαν αυτον τι ουν ηλιας ει συ και λεγει ουκ ειμι ο προφητης ει συ και απεκριθη ου
kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ei quis es ut responsum demus his qui miserunt nos quid dicis de te ipso
clem: Dixerunt ergo ei: Quis es ut responsum demus his qui miserunt nos? quid dicis de teipso?
tr: ειπον ουν αυτω τις ει ινα αποκρισιν δωμεν τοις πεμψασιν ημας τι λεγεις περι σεαυτου
kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

vulg: ait ego vox clamantis in deserto dirigite viam Domini sicut dixit Esaias propheta
clem: Ait: Ego vox clamantis in deserto: Dirigite viam Domini, sicut dixit Isaias propheta.
tr: εφη εγω φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ευθυνατε την οδον κυριου καθως ειπεν ησαιας ο προφητης
kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

vulg: et qui missi fuerant erant ex Pharisaeis
clem: Et qui missi fuerant, erant ex pharisis.
tr: και οι απεσταλμενοι ησαν εκ των φαρισαιων
kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

vulg: et interrogaverunt eum et dixerunt ei quid ergo baptizas si tu non es Christus neque Helias neque propheta
clem: Et interrogaverunt eum, et dixerunt ei: Quid ergo baptizas, si tu non es Christus, neque Elias, neque propheta?
tr: και ηρωτησαν αυτον και ειπον αυτω τι ουν βαπτιζεις ει συ ουκ ει ο χριστος ουτε ηλιας ουτε ο προφητης
kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

vulg: respondit eis Iohannes dicens ego baptizo in aqua medius autem vestrum stetit quem vos non scitis
clem: Respondit eis Joannes, dicens: Ego baptizo in aqua: medius autem vestrum stetit, quem vos nescitis.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιωαννης λεγων εγω βαπτιζω εν υδατι μεσος δε υμων εστηκεν ον υμεις ουκ οιδατε
kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

vulg: ipse est qui post me venturus est qui ante me factus est cuius ego non sum dignus ut solvam eius corrigiam calciamenti
clem: Ipse est qui post me venturus est, qui ante me factus est: cujus ego non sum dignus ut solvam ejus corrigiam calceamenti.
tr: αυτος εστιν ο οπισω μου ερχομενος ος εμπροσθεν μου γεγονεν ου εγω ουκ ειμι αξιος ινα λυσω αυτου τον ιμαντα του υποδηματος
kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

vulg: haec in Bethania facta sunt trans Iordanen ubi erat Iohannes baptizans
clem: Hc in Bethania facta sunt trans Jordanem, ubi erat Joannes baptizans.
tr: ταυτα εν βηθαβαρα εγενετο περαν του ιορδανου οπου ην ιωαννης βαπτιζων
kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

vulg: altera die videt Iohannes Iesum venientem ad se et ait ecce agnus Dei qui tollit peccatum mundi
clem: Altera die vidit Joannes Jesum venientem ad se, et ait: Ecce agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccatum mundi.
tr: τη επαυριον βλεπει ο ιωαννης τον ιησουν ερχομενον προς αυτον και λεγει ιδε ο αμνος του θεου ο αιρων την αμαρτιαν του κοσμου
kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

vulg: hic est de quo dixi post me venit vir qui ante me factus est quia prior me erat
clem: Hic est de quo dixi: Post me venit vir qui ante me factus est: quia prior me erat:
tr: ουτος εστιν περι ου εγω ειπον οπισω μου ερχεται ανηρ ος εμπροσθεν μου γεγονεν οτι πρωτος μου ην
kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

vulg: et ego nesciebam eum sed ut manifestaretur Israhel propterea veni ego in aqua baptizans
clem: et ego nesciebam eum, sed ut manifestetur in Isral, propterea veni ego in aqua baptizans.
tr: καγω ουκ ηδειν αυτον αλλ ινα φανερωθη τω ισραηλ δια τουτο ηλθον εγω εν τω υδατι βαπτιζων
kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

vulg: et testimonium perhibuit Iohannes dicens quia vidi Spiritum descendentem quasi columbam de caelo et mansit super eum
clem: Et testimonium perhibuit Joannes, dicens: Quia vidi Spiritum descendentem quasi columbam de clo, et mansit super eum.
tr: και εμαρτυρησεν ιωαννης λεγων οτι τεθεαμαι το πνευμα καταβαινον ωσει περιστεραν εξ ουρανου και εμεινεν επ αυτον
kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

vulg: et ego nesciebam eum sed qui misit me baptizare in aqua ille mihi dixit super quem videris Spiritum descendentem et manentem super eum hic est qui baptizat in Spiritu Sancto
clem: Et ego nesciebam eum: sed qui misit me baptizare in aqua, ille mihi dixit: Super quem videris Spiritum descendentem, et manentem super eum, hic est qui baptizat in Spiritu Sancto.
tr: καγω ουκ ηδειν αυτον αλλ ο πεμψας με βαπτιζειν εν υδατι εκεινος μοι ειπεν εφ ον αν ιδης το πνευμα καταβαινον και μενον επ αυτον ουτος εστιν ο βαπτιζων εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

vulg: et ego vidi et testimonium perhibui quia hic est Filius Dei
clem: Et ego vidi: et testimonium perhibui quia hic est Filius Dei.
tr: καγω εωρακα και μεμαρτυρηκα οτι ουτος εστιν ο υιος του θεου
kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

vulg: altera die iterum stabat Iohannes et ex discipulis eius duo
clem: Altera die iterum stabat Joannes, et ex discipulis ejus duo.
tr: τη επαυριον παλιν ειστηκει ο ιωαννης και εκ των μαθητων αυτου δυο
kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

vulg: et respiciens Iesum ambulantem dicit ecce agnus Dei
clem: Et respiciens Jesum ambulantem, dicit: Ecce agnus Dei.
tr: και εμβλεψας τω ιησου περιπατουντι λεγει ιδε ο αμνος του θεου
kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

vulg: et audierunt eum duo discipuli loquentem et secuti sunt Iesum
clem: Et audierunt eum duo discipuli loquentem, et secuti sunt Jesum.
tr: και ηκουσαν αυτου οι δυο μαθηται λαλουντος και ηκολουθησαν τω ιησου
kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

vulg: conversus autem Iesus et videns eos sequentes dicit eis quid quaeritis qui dixerunt ei rabbi quod dicitur interpretatum magister ubi habitas
clem: Conversus autem Jesus, et videns eos sequentes se, dicit eis: Quid quritis? Qui dixerunt ei: Rabbi (quod dicitur interpretatum Magister), ubi habitas?
tr: στραφεις δε ο ιησους και θεασαμενος αυτους ακολουθουντας λεγει αυτοις τι ζητειτε οι δε ειπον αυτω ραββι ο λεγεται ερμηνευομενον διδασκαλε που μενεις
kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

vulg: dicit eis venite et videte venerunt et viderunt ubi maneret et apud eum manserunt die illo hora autem erat quasi decima
clem: Dicit eis: Venite et videte. Venerunt, et viderunt ubi maneret, et apud eum manserunt die illo: hora autem erat quasi decima.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ερχεσθε και ιδετε ηλθον και ειδον που μενει και παρ αυτω εμειναν την ημεραν εκεινην ωρα δε ην ως δεκατη
kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

vulg: erat autem Andreas frater Simonis Petri unus ex duobus qui audierant ab Iohanne et secuti fuerant eum
clem: Erat autem Andreas, frater Simonis Petri, unus ex duobus qui audierant a Joanne, et secuti fuerant eum.
tr: ην ανδρεας ο αδελφος σιμωνος πετρου εις εκ των δυο των ακουσαντων παρα ιωαννου και ακολουθησαντων αυτω
kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

vulg: invenit hic primum fratrem suum Simonem et dicit ei invenimus Messiam quod est interpretatum Christus
clem: Invenit hic primum fratrem suum Simonem, et dicit ei: Invenimus Messiam (quod est interpretatum Christus).
tr: ευρισκει ουτος πρωτος τον αδελφον τον ιδιον σιμωνα και λεγει αυτω ευρηκαμεν τον μεσσιαν ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον ο χριστος
kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

vulg: et adduxit eum ad Iesum intuitus autem eum Iesus dixit tu es Simon filius Iohanna tu vocaberis Cephas quod interpretatur Petrus
clem: Et adduxit eum ad Jesum. Intuitus autem eum Jesus, dixit: Tu es Simon, filius Jona; tu vocaberis Cephas, quod interpretatur Petrus.
tr: και ηγαγεν αυτον προς τον ιησουν εμβλεψας δε αυτω ο ιησους ειπεν συ ει σιμων ο υιος ιωνα συ κληθηση κηφας ο ερμηνευεται πετρος
kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

vulg: in crastinum voluit exire in Galilaeam et invenit Philippum et dicit ei Iesus sequere me
clem: In crastinam voluit exire in Galilam, et invenit Philippum. Et dicit ei Jesus: Sequere me.
tr: τη επαυριον ηθελησεν ο ιησους εξελθειν εις την γαλιλαιαν και ευρισκει φιλιππον και λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι
kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

vulg: erat autem Philippus a Bethsaida civitate Andreae et Petri
clem: Erat autem Philippus a Bethsaida, civitate Andre et Petri.
tr: ην δε ο φιλιππος απο βηθσαιδα εκ της πολεως ανδρεου και πετρου
kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

vulg: invenit Philippus Nathanahel et dicit ei quem scripsit Moses in lege et prophetae invenimus Iesum filium Ioseph a Nazareth
clem: Invenit Philippus Nathanal, et dicit ei: Quem scripsit Moyses in lege, et prophet, invenimus Jesum filium Joseph a Nazareth.
tr: ευρισκει φιλιππος τον ναθαναηλ και λεγει αυτω ον εγραψεν μωσης εν τω νομω και οι προφηται ευρηκαμεν ιησουν τον υιον του ιωσηφ τον απο ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ
kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

vulg: et dixit ei Nathanahel a Nazareth potest aliquid boni esse dicit ei Philippus veni et vide
clem: Et dixit ei Nathanal: A Nazareth potest aliquid boni esse? Dicit ei Philippus: Veni et vide.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ναθαναηλ εκ ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  δυναται τι αγαθον ειναι λεγει αυτω φιλιππος ερχου και ιδε
kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

vulg: vidit Iesus Nathanahel venientem ad se et dicit de eo ecce vere Israhelita in quo dolus non est
clem: Vidit Jesus Nathanal venientem ad se, et dicit de eo: Ecce vere Isralita, in quo dolus non est.
tr: ειδεν ο ιησους τον ναθαναηλ ερχομενον προς αυτον και λεγει περι αυτου ιδε αληθως ισραηλιτης εν ω δολος ουκ εστιν
kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

vulg: dicit ei Nathanahel unde me nosti respondit Iesus et dixit ei priusquam te Philippus vocaret cum esses sub ficu vidi te
clem: Dicit ei Nathanal: Unde me nosti? Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Priusquam te Philippus vocavit, cum esses sub ficu, vidi te.
tr: λεγει αυτω ναθαναηλ ποθεν με γινωσκεις απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτω προ του σε φιλιππον φωνησαι οντα υπο την συκην ειδον σε
kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

vulg: respondit ei Nathanahel et ait rabbi tu es Filius Dei tu es rex Israhel
clem: Respondit ei Nathanal, et ait: Rabbi, tu es Filius Dei, tu es rex Isral.
tr: απεκριθη ναθαναηλ και λεγει αυτω ραββι συ ει ο υιος του θεου συ ει ο βασιλευς του ισραηλ
kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei quia dixi tibi vidi te sub ficu credis maius his videbis
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Quia dixi tibi: Vidi te sub ficu, credis; majus his videbis.
tr: απεκριθη ιησους και ειπεν αυτω οτι ειπον σοι ειδον σε υποκατω της συκης πιστευεις μειζω τουτων οψει
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

vulg: et dicit ei amen amen dico vobis videbitis caelum apertum et angelos Dei ascendentes et descendentes supra Filium hominis
clem: Et dicit ei: Amen, amen dico vobis, videbitis clum apertum, et angelos Dei ascendentes, et descendentes supra Filium hominis.
tr: και λεγει αυτω αμην αμην λεγω υμιν απ αρτι οψεσθε τον ουρανον ανεωγοτα και τους αγγελους του θεου αναβαινοντας και καταβαινοντας επι τον υιον του ανθρωπου
kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

vulg: et die tertio nuptiae factae sunt in Cana Galilaeae et erat mater Iesu ibi
clem: Et die tertia nupti fact sunt in Cana Galil, et erat mater Jesu ibi.
tr: και τη ημερα τη τριτη γαμος εγενετο εν κανα της γαλιλαιας και ην η μητηρ του ιησου εκει
kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

vulg: vocatus est autem ibi et Iesus et discipuli eius ad nuptias
clem: Vocatus est autem et Jesus, et discipuli ejus, ad nuptias.
tr: εκληθη δε και ο ιησους και οι μαθηται αυτου εις τον γαμον
kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

vulg: et deficiente vino dicit mater Iesu ad eum vinum non habent
clem: Et deficiente vino, dicit mater Jesu ad eum: Vinum non habent.
tr: και υστερησαντος οινου λεγει η μητηρ του ιησου προς αυτον οινον ουκ εχουσιν
kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

vulg: et dicit ei Iesus quid mihi et tibi est mulier nondum venit hora mea
clem: Et dicit ei Jesus: Quid mihi et tibi est, mulier? nondum venit hora mea.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους τι εμοι και σοι γυναι ουπω ηκει η ωρα μου
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

vulg: dicit mater eius ministris quodcumque dixerit vobis facite
clem: Dicit mater ejus ministris: Quodcumque dixerit vobis, facite.
tr: λεγει η μητηρ αυτου τοις διακονοις ο τι αν λεγη υμιν ποιησατε
kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

vulg: erant autem ibi lapideae hydriae sex positae secundum purificationem Iudaeorum capientes singulae metretas binas vel ternas
clem: Erant autem ibi lapide hydri sex posit secundum purificationem Judorum, capientes singul metretas binas vel ternas.
tr: ησαν δε εκει υδριαι λιθιναι εξ κειμεναι κατα τον καθαρισμον των ιουδαιων χωρουσαι ανα μετρητας δυο η τρεις
kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

vulg: dicit eis Iesus implete hydrias aqua et impleverunt eas usque ad summum
clem: Dicit eis Jesus: Implete hydrias aqua. Et impleverunt eas usque ad summum.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους γεμισατε τας υδριας υδατος και εγεμισαν αυτας εως ανω
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

vulg: et dicit eis Iesus haurite nunc et ferte architriclino et tulerunt
clem: Et dicit eis Jesus: Haurite nunc, et ferte architriclinio. Et tulerunt.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις αντλησατε νυν και φερετε τω αρχιτρικλινω και ηνεγκαν
kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

vulg: ut autem gustavit architriclinus aquam vinum factam et non sciebat unde esset ministri autem sciebant qui haurierant aquam vocat sponsum architriclinus
clem: Ut autem gustavit architriclinius aquam vinum factam, et non sciebat unde esset, ministri autem sciebant, qui hauserant aquam: vocat sponsum architriclinius,
tr: ως δε εγευσατο ο αρχιτρικλινος το υδωρ οινον γεγενημενον και ουκ ηδει ποθεν εστιν οι δε διακονοι ηδεισαν οι ηντληκοτες το υδωρ φωνει τον νυμφιον ο αρχιτρικλινος
kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

vulg: et dicit ei omnis homo primum bonum vinum ponit et cum inebriati fuerint tunc id quod deterius est tu servasti bonum vinum usque adhuc
clem: et dicit ei: Omnis homo primum bonum vinum ponit et cum inebriati fuerint, tunc id, quod deterius est. Tu autem servasti bonum vinum usque adhuc.
tr: και λεγει αυτω πας ανθρωπος πρωτον τον καλον οινον τιθησιν και οταν μεθυσθωσιν τοτε τον ελασσω συ τετηρηκας τον καλον οινον εως αρτι
kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

vulg: hoc fecit initium signorum Iesus in Cana Galilaeae et manifestavit gloriam suam et crediderunt in eum discipuli eius
clem: Hoc fecit initium signorum Jesus in Cana Galil; et manifestavit gloriam suam, et crediderunt in eum discipuli ejus.
tr: ταυτην εποιησεν την αρχην των σημειων ο ιησους εν κανα της γαλιλαιας και εφανερωσεν την δοξαν αυτου και επιστευσαν εις αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

vulg: post hoc descendit Capharnaum ipse et mater eius et fratres eius et discipuli eius et ibi manserunt non multis diebus
clem: Post hoc descendit Capharnaum ipse, et mater ejus, et fratres ejus, et discipuli ejus: et ibi manserunt non multis diebus.
tr: μετα τουτο κατεβη εις καπερναουμ αυτος και η μητηρ αυτου και οι αδελφοι αυτου και οι μαθηται αυτου και εκει εμειναν ου πολλας ημερας
kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

vulg: et prope erat pascha Iudaeorum et ascendit Hierosolyma Iesus
clem: Et prope erat Pascha Judorum, et ascendit Jesus Jerosolymam:
tr: και εγγυς ην το πασχα των ιουδαιων και ανεβη εις ιεροσολυμα ο ιησους
kjv: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

vulg: et invenit in templo vendentes boves et oves et columbas et nummularios sedentes
clem: et invenit in templo vendentes boves, et oves, et columbas, et numularios sedentes.
tr: και ευρεν εν τω ιερω τους πωλουντας βοας και προβατα και περιστερας και τους κερματιστας καθημενους
kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

vulg: et cum fecisset quasi flagellum de funiculis omnes eiecit de templo oves quoque et boves et nummulariorum effudit aes et mensas subvertit
clem: Et cum fecisset quasi flagellum de funiculis, omnes ejecit de templo, oves quoque, et boves, et numulariorum effudit s, et mensas subvertit.
tr: και ποιησας φραγελλιον εκ σχοινιων παντας εξεβαλεν εκ του ιερου τα τε προβατα και τους βοας και των κολλυβιστων εξεχεεν το κερμα και τας τραπεζας ανεστρεψεν
kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

vulg: et his qui columbas vendebant dixit auferte ista hinc nolite facere domum Patris mei domum negotiationis
clem: Et his qui columbas vendebant, dixit: Auferte ista hinc, et nolite facere domum patris mei, domum negotiationis.
tr: και τοις τας περιστερας πωλουσιν ειπεν αρατε ταυτα εντευθεν μη ποιειτε τον οικον του πατρος μου οικον εμποριου
kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

vulg: recordati vero sunt discipuli eius quia scriptum est zelus domus tuae comedit me
clem: Recordati sunt vero discipuli ejus quia scriptum est: Zelus domus tu comedit me.
tr: εμνησθησαν δε οι μαθηται αυτου οτι γεγραμμενον εστιν ο ζηλος του οικου σου κατεφαγεν με
kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

vulg: responderunt ergo Iudaei et dixerunt ei quod signum ostendis nobis quia haec facis
clem: Responderunt ergo Judi, et dixerunt ei: Quod signum ostendis nobis, quia hc facis?
tr: απεκριθησαν ουν οι ιουδαιοι και ειπον αυτω τι σημειον δεικνυεις ημιν οτι ταυτα ποιεις
kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit eis solvite templum hoc et in tribus diebus excitabo illud
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis: Solvite templum hoc, et in tribus diebus excitabo illud.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις λυσατε τον ναον τουτον και εν τρισιν ημεραις εγερω αυτον
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

vulg: dixerunt ergo Iudaei quadraginta et sex annis aedificatum est templum hoc et tu tribus diebus excitabis illud
clem: Dixerunt ergo Judi: Quadraginta et sex annis dificatum est templum hoc, et tu in tribus diebus excitabis illud?
tr: ειπον ουν οι ιουδαιοι τεσσαρακοντα και εξ ετεσιν ωκοδομηθη ο ναος ουτος και συ εν τρισιν ημεραις εγερεις αυτον
kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

vulg: ille autem dicebat de templo corporis sui
clem: Ille autem dicebat de templo corporis sui.
tr: εκεινος δε ελεγεν περι του ναου του σωματος αυτου
kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.

vulg: cum ergo resurrexisset a mortuis recordati sunt discipuli eius quia hoc dicebat et crediderunt scripturae et sermoni quem dixit Iesus
clem: Cum ergo resurrexisset a mortuis, recordati sunt discipuli ejus, quia hoc dicebat, et crediderunt scriptur et sermoni quem dixit Jesus.
tr: οτε ουν ηγερθη εκ νεκρων εμνησθησαν οι μαθηται αυτου οτι τουτο ελεγεν αυτοις και επιστευσαν τη γραφη και τω λογω ω ειπεν ο ιησους
kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

vulg: cum autem esset Hierosolymis in pascha in die festo multi crediderunt in nomine eius videntes signa eius quae faciebat
clem: Cum autem esset Jerosolymis in Pascha in die festo, multi crediderunt in nomine ejus, videntes signa ejus, qu faciebat.
tr: ως δε ην εν ιεροσολυμοις εν τω πασχα εν τη εορτη πολλοι επιστευσαν εις το ονομα αυτου θεωρουντες αυτου τα σημεια α εποιει
kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

vulg: ipse autem Iesus non credebat semet ipsum eis eo quod ipse nosset omnes
clem: Ipse autem Jesus non credebat semetipsum eis, eo quod ipse nosset omnes,
tr: αυτος δε ο ιησους ουκ επιστευεν εαυτον αυτοις δια το αυτον γινωσκειν παντας
kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

vulg: et quia opus ei non erat ut quis testimonium perhiberet de homine ipse enim sciebat quid esset in homine
clem: et quia opus ei non erat ut quis testimonium perhiberet de homine: ipse enim sciebat quid esset in homine.
tr: και οτι ου χρειαν ειχεν ινα τις μαρτυρηση περι του ανθρωπου αυτος γαρ εγινωσκεν τι ην εν τω ανθρωπω
kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

vulg: erat autem homo ex Pharisaeis Nicodemus nomine princeps Iudaeorum
clem: Erat autem homo ex pharisis, Nicodemus nomine, princeps Judorum.
tr: ην δε ανθρωπος εκ των φαρισαιων νικοδημος ονομα αυτω αρχων των ιουδαιων
kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

vulg: hic venit ad eum nocte et dixit ei rabbi scimus quia a Deo venisti magister nemo enim potest haec signa facere quae tu facis nisi fuerit Deus cum eo
clem: Hic venit ad Jesum nocte, et dixit ei: Rabbi, scimus quia a Deo venisti magister, nemo enim potest hc signa facere, qu tu facis, nisi fuerit Deus cum eo.
tr: ουτος ηλθεν προς τον ιησουν νυκτος και ειπεν αυτω ραββι οιδαμεν οτι απο θεου εληλυθας διδασκαλος ουδεις γαρ ταυτα τα σημεια δυναται ποιειν α συ ποιεις εαν μη η ο θεος μετ αυτου
kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei amen amen dico tibi nisi quis natus fuerit denuo non potest videre regnum Dei
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Amen, amen dico tibi, nisi quis renatus fuerit denuo, non potest videre regnum Dei.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτω αμην αμην λεγω σοι εαν μη τις γεννηθη ανωθεν ου δυναται ιδειν την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

vulg: dicit ad eum Nicodemus quomodo potest homo nasci cum senex sit numquid potest in ventrem matris suae iterato introire et nasci
clem: Dicit ad eum Nicodemus: Quomodo potest homo nasci, cum sit senex? numquid potest in ventrem matris su iterato introire et renasci?
tr: λεγει προς αυτον ο νικοδημος πως δυναται ανθρωπος γεννηθηναι γερων ων μη δυναται εις την κοιλιαν της μητρος αυτου δευτερον εισελθειν και γεννηθηναι
kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

vulg: respondit Iesus amen amen dico tibi nisi quis renatus fuerit ex aqua et Spiritu non potest introire in regnum Dei
clem: Respondit Jesus: Amen, amen dico tibi, nisi quis renatus fuerit ex aqua, et Spiritu Sancto, non potest introire in regnum Dei.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω σοι εαν μη τις γεννηθη εξ υδατος και πνευματος ου δυναται εισελθειν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

vulg: quod natum est ex carne caro est et quod natum est ex Spiritu spiritus est
clem: Quod natum est ex carne, caro est: et quod natum est ex spiritu, spiritus est.
tr: το γεγεννημενον εκ της σαρκος σαρξ εστιν και το γεγεννημενον εκ του πνευματος πνευμα εστιν
kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

vulg: non mireris quia dixi tibi oportet vos nasci denuo
clem: Non mireris quia dixi tibi: oportet vos nasci denuo.
tr: μη θαυμασης οτι ειπον σοι δει υμας γεννηθηναι ανωθεν
kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

vulg: Spiritus ubi vult spirat et vocem eius audis sed non scis unde veniat et quo vadat sic est omnis qui natus est ex Spiritu
clem: Spiritus ubi vult spirat, et vocem ejus audis, sed nescis unde veniat, aut quo vadat: sic est omnis qui natus est ex spiritu.
tr: το πνευμα οπου θελει πνει και την φωνην αυτου ακουεις αλλ ουκ οιδας ποθεν ερχεται και που υπαγει ουτως εστιν πας ο γεγεννημενος εκ του πνευματος
kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

vulg: respondit Nicodemus et dixit ei quomodo possunt haec fieri
clem: Respondit Nicodemus, et dixit ei: Quomodo possunt hc fieri?
tr: απεκριθη νικοδημος και ειπεν αυτω πως δυναται ταυτα γενεσθαι
kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei tu es magister Israhel et haec ignoras
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Tu es magister in Isral, et hc ignoras?
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτω συ ει ο διδασκαλος του ισραηλ και ταυτα ου γινωσκεις
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

vulg: amen amen dico tibi quia quod scimus loquimur et quod vidimus testamur et testimonium nostrum non accipitis
clem: amen, amen dico tibi, quia quod scimus loquimur, et quod vidimus testamur, et testimonium nostrum non accipitis.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω σοι οτι ο οιδαμεν λαλουμεν και ο εωρακαμεν μαρτυρουμεν και την μαρτυριαν ημων ου λαμβανετε
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

vulg: si terrena dixi vobis et non creditis quomodo si dixero vobis caelestia credetis
clem: Si terrena dixi vobis, et non creditis: quomodo, si dixero vobis clestia, credetis?
tr: ει τα επιγεια ειπον υμιν και ου πιστευετε πως εαν ειπω υμιν τα επουρανια πιστευσετε
kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

vulg: et nemo ascendit in caelum nisi qui descendit de caelo Filius hominis qui est in caelo
clem: Et nemo ascendit in clum, nisi qui descendit de clo, Filius hominis, qui est in clo.
tr: και ουδεις αναβεβηκεν εις τον ουρανον ει μη ο εκ του ουρανου καταβας ο υιος του ανθρωπου ο ων εν τω ουρανω
kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

vulg: et sicut Moses exaltavit serpentem in deserto ita exaltari oportet Filium hominis
clem: Et sicut Moyses exaltavit serpentem in deserto, ita exaltari oportet Filium hominis:
tr: και καθως μωσης υψωσεν τον οφιν εν τη ερημω ουτως υψωθηναι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου
kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

vulg: ut omnis qui credit in ipso non pereat sed habeat vitam aeternam
clem: ut omnis qui credit in ipsum, non pereat, sed habeat vitam ternam.
tr: ινα πας ο πιστευων εις αυτον μη αποληται αλλ εχη ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

vulg: sic enim dilexit Deus mundum ut Filium suum unigenitum daret ut omnis qui credit in eum non pereat sed habeat vitam aeternam
clem: Sic enim Deus dilexit mundum, ut Filium suum unigenitum daret: ut omnis qui credit in eum, non pereat, sed habeat vitam ternam.
tr: ουτως γαρ ηγαπησεν ο θεος τον κοσμον ωστε τον υιον αυτου τον μονογενη εδωκεν ινα πας ο πιστευων εις αυτον μη αποληται αλλ εχη ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

vulg: non enim misit Deus Filium suum in mundum ut iudicet mundum sed ut salvetur mundus per ipsum
clem: Non enim misit Deus Filium suum in mundum, ut judicet mundum, sed ut salvetur mundus per ipsum.
tr: ου γαρ απεστειλεν ο θεος τον υιον αυτου εις τον κοσμον ινα κρινη τον κοσμον αλλ ινα σωθη ο κοσμος δι αυτου
kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

vulg: qui credit in eum non iudicatur qui autem non credit iam iudicatus est quia non credidit in nomine unigeniti Filii Dei
clem: Qui credit in eum, non judicatur; qui autem non credit, jam judicatus est: quia non credit in nomine unigeniti Filii Dei.
tr: ο πιστευων εις αυτον ου κρινεται ο δε μη πιστευων ηδη κεκριται οτι μη πεπιστευκεν εις το ονομα του μονογενους υιου του θεου
kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

vulg: hoc est autem iudicium quia lux venit in mundum et dilexerunt homines magis tenebras quam lucem erant enim eorum mala opera
clem: Hoc est autem judicium: quia lux venit in mundum, et dilexerunt homines magis tenebras quam lucem: erant enim eorum mala opera.
tr: αυτη δε εστιν η κρισις οτι το φως εληλυθεν εις τον κοσμον και ηγαπησαν οι ανθρωποι μαλλον το σκοτος η το φως ην γαρ πονηρα αυτων τα εργα
kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

vulg: omnis enim qui mala agit odit lucem et non venit ad lucem ut non arguantur opera eius
clem: Omnis enim qui male agit, odit lucem, et non venit ad lucem, ut non arguantur opera ejus:
tr: πας γαρ ο φαυλα πρασσων μισει το φως και ουκ ερχεται προς το φως ινα μη ελεγχθη τα εργα αυτου
kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

vulg: qui autem facit veritatem venit ad lucem ut manifestentur eius opera quia in Deo sunt facta
clem: qui autem facit veritatem, venit ad lucem, ut manifestentur opera ejus, quia in Deo sunt facta.
tr: ο δε ποιων την αληθειαν ερχεται προς το φως ινα φανερωθη αυτου τα εργα οτι εν θεω εστιν ειργασμενα
kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

vulg: post haec venit Iesus et discipuli eius in iudaeam terram et illic demorabatur cum eis et baptizabat
clem: Post hc venit Jesus et discipuli ejus in terram Judam: et illic demorabatur cum eis, et baptizabat.
tr: μετα ταυτα ηλθεν ο ιησους και οι μαθηται αυτου εις την ιουδαιαν γην και εκει διετριβεν μετ αυτων και εβαπτιζεν
kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

vulg: erat autem et Iohannes baptizans in Aenon iuxta Salim quia aquae multae erant illic et adveniebant et baptizabantur
clem: Erat autem et Joannes baptizans, in nnon, juxta Salim: quia aqu mult erant illic, et veniebant et baptizabantur.
tr: ην δε και ιωαννης βαπτιζων εν αινων εγγυς του σαλειμ οτι υδατα πολλα ην εκει και παρεγινοντο και εβαπτιζοντο
kjv: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

vulg: nondum enim missus fuerat in carcerem Iohannes
clem: Nondum enim missus fuerat Joannes in carcerem.
tr: ουπω γαρ ην βεβλημενος εις την φυλακην ο ιωαννης
kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

vulg: facta est ergo quaestio ex discipulis Iohannis cum Iudaeis de purificatione
clem: Facta est autem qustio ex discipulis Joannis cum Judis de purificatione.
tr: εγενετο ουν ζητησις εκ των μαθητων ιωαννου μετα ιουδαιων περι καθαρισμου
kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

vulg: et venerunt ad Iohannem et dixerunt ei rabbi qui erat tecum trans Iordanen cui tu testimonium perhibuisti ecce hic baptizat et omnes veniunt ad eum
clem: Et venerunt ad Joannem, et dixerunt ei: Rabbi, qui erat tecum trans Jordanem, cui tu testimonium perhibuisti, ecce hic baptizat, et omnes veniunt ad eum.
tr: και ηλθον προς τον ιωαννην και ειπον αυτω ραββι ος ην μετα σου περαν του ιορδανου ω συ μεμαρτυρηκας ιδε ουτος βαπτιζει και παντες ερχονται προς αυτον
kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

vulg: respondit Iohannes et dixit non potest homo accipere quicquam nisi fuerit ei datum de caelo
clem: Respondit Joannes, et dixit: Non potest homo accipere quidquam, nisi fuerit ei datum de clo.
tr: απεκριθη ιωαννης και ειπεν ου δυναται ανθρωπος λαμβανειν ουδεν εαν μη η δεδομενον αυτω εκ του ουρανου
kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

vulg: ipsi vos mihi testimonium perhibetis quod dixerim ego non sum Christus sed quia missus sum ante illum
clem: Ipsi vos mihi testimonium perhibetis, quod dixerim: Non sum ego Christus: sed quia missus sum ante illum.
tr: αυτοι υμεις μοι μαρτυρειτε οτι ειπον ουκ ειμι εγω ο χριστος αλλ οτι απεσταλμενος ειμι εμπροσθεν εκεινου
kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

vulg: qui habet sponsam sponsus est amicus autem sponsi qui stat et audit eum gaudio gaudet propter vocem sponsi hoc ergo gaudium meum impletum est
clem: Qui habet sponsam, sponsus est: amicus autem sponsi, qui stat, et audit eum, gaudio gaudet propter vocem sponsi. Hoc ergo gaudium meum impletum est.
tr: ο εχων την νυμφην νυμφιος εστιν ο δε φιλος του νυμφιου ο εστηκως και ακουων αυτου χαρα χαιρει δια την φωνην του νυμφιου αυτη ουν η χαρα η εμη πεπληρωται
kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

vulg: illum oportet crescere me autem minui
clem: Illum oportet crescere, me autem minui.
tr: εκεινον δει αυξανειν εμε δε ελαττουσθαι
kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.

vulg: qui desursum venit supra omnes est qui est de terra de terra est et de terra loquitur qui de caelo venit supra omnes est
clem: Qui desursum venit, super omnes est. Qui est de terra, de terra est, et de terra loquitur. Qui de clo venit, super omnes est.
tr: ο ανωθεν ερχομενος επανω παντων εστιν ο ων εκ της γης εκ της γης εστιν και εκ της γης λαλει ο εκ του ουρανου ερχομενος επανω παντων εστιν
kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

vulg: et quod vidit et audivit hoc testatur et testimonium eius nemo accipit
clem: Et quod vidit, et audivit, hoc testatur: et testimonium ejus nemo accipit.
tr: και ο εωρακεν και ηκουσεν τουτο μαρτυρει και την μαρτυριαν αυτου ουδεις λαμβανει
kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

vulg: qui accipit eius testimonium signavit quia Deus verax est
clem: Qui accepit ejus testimonium signavit, quia Deus verax est.
tr: ο λαβων αυτου την μαρτυριαν εσφραγισεν οτι ο θεος αληθης εστιν
kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

vulg: quem enim misit Deus verba Dei loquitur non enim ad mensuram dat Deus Spiritum
clem: Quem enim misit Deus, verba Dei loquitur: non enim ad mensuram dat Deus spiritum.
tr: ον γαρ απεστειλεν ο θεος τα ρηματα του θεου λαλει ου γαρ εκ μετρου διδωσιν ο θεος το πνευμα
kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

vulg: Pater diligit Filium et omnia dedit in manu eius
clem: Pater diligit Filium et omnia dedit in manu ejus.
tr: ο πατηρ αγαπα τον υιον και παντα δεδωκεν εν τη χειρι αυτου
kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

vulg: qui credit in Filium habet vitam aeternam qui autem incredulus est Filio non videbit vitam sed ira Dei manet super eum
clem: Qui credit in Filium, habet vitam ternam; qui autem incredulus est Filio, non videbit vitam, sed ira Dei manet super eum.
tr: ο πιστευων εις τον υιον εχει ζωην αιωνιον ο δε απειθων τω υιω ουκ οψεται ζωην αλλ η οργη του θεου μενει επ αυτον
kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

vulg: ut ergo cognovit Iesus quia audierunt Pharisaei quia Iesus plures discipulos facit et baptizat quam Iohannes
clem: Ut ergo cognovit Jesus quia audierunt pharisi quod Jesus plures discipulos facit, et baptizat, quam Joannes
tr: ως ουν εγνω ο κυριος οτι ηκουσαν οι φαρισαιοι οτι ιησους πλειονας μαθητας ποιει και βαπτιζει η ιωαννης
kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

vulg: quamquam Iesus non baptizaret sed discipuli eius
clem: (quamquam Jesus non baptizaret, sed discipuli ejus),
tr: καιτοιγε ιησους αυτος ουκ εβαπτιζεν αλλ οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

vulg: reliquit Iudaeam et abiit iterum in Galilaeam
clem: reliquit Judam, et abiit iterum in Galilam.
tr: αφηκεν την ιουδαιαν και απηλθεν παλιν εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

vulg: oportebat autem eum transire per Samariam
clem: Oportebat autem eum transire per Samariam.
tr: εδει δε αυτον διερχεσθαι δια της σαμαρειας
kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.

vulg: venit ergo in civitatem Samariae quae dicitur Sychar iuxta praedium quod dedit Iacob Ioseph filio suo
clem: Venit ergo in civitatem Samari, qu dicitur Sichar, juxta prdium quod dedit Jacob Joseph filio suo.
tr: ερχεται ουν εις πολιν της σαμαρειας λεγομενην συχαρ πλησιον του χωριου ο εδωκεν ιακωβ ιωσηφ τω υιω αυτου
kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

vulg: erat autem ibi fons Iacob Iesus ergo fatigatus ex itinere sedebat sic super fontem hora erat quasi sexta
clem: Erat autem ibi fons Jacob. Jesus ergo fatigatus ex itinere, sedebat sic supra fontem. Hora erat quasi sexta.
tr: ην δε εκει πηγη του ιακωβ ο ουν ιησους κεκοπιακως εκ της οδοιποριας εκαθεζετο ουτως επι τη πηγη ωρα ην ωσει εκτη
kjv: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

vulg: venit mulier de Samaria haurire aquam dicit ei Iesus da mihi bibere
clem: Venit mulier de Samaria haurire aquam. Dicit ei Jesus: Da mihi bibere.
tr: ερχεται γυνη εκ της σαμαρειας αντλησαι υδωρ λεγει αυτη ο ιησους δος μοι πιειν
kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

vulg: discipuli enim eius abierant in civitatem ut cibos emerent
clem: (Discipuli enim ejus abierant in civitatem ut cibos emerent.)
tr: οι γαρ μαθηται αυτου απεληλυθεισαν εις την πολιν ινα τροφας αγορασωσιν
kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

vulg: dicit ergo ei mulier illa samaritana quomodo tu Iudaeus cum sis bibere a me poscis quae sum mulier samaritana non enim coutuntur Iudaei Samaritanis
clem: Dicit ergo ei mulier illa Samaritana: Quomodo tu, Judus cum sis, bibere a me poscis, qu sum mulier Samaritana? non enim coutuntur Judi Samaritanis.
tr: λεγει ουν αυτω η γυνη η σαμαρειτις πως συ ιουδαιος ων παρ εμου πιειν αιτεις ουσης γυναικος σαμαρειτιδος ου γαρ συγχρωνται ιουδαιοι σαμαρειταις
kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei si scires donum Dei et quis est qui dicit tibi da mihi bibere tu forsitan petisses ab eo et dedisset tibi aquam vivam
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Si scires donum Dei, et quis est qui dicit tibi: Da mihi bibere, tu forsitan petisses ab eo, et dedisset tibi aquam vivam.
tr: απεκριθη ιησους και ειπεν αυτη ει ηδεις την δωρεαν του θεου και τις εστιν ο λεγων σοι δος μοι πιειν συ αν ητησας αυτον και εδωκεν αν σοι υδωρ ζων
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

vulg: dicit ei mulier Domine neque in quo haurias habes et puteus altus est unde ergo habes aquam vivam
clem: Dicit ei mulier: Domine, neque in quo haurias habes, et puteus altus est: unde ergo habes aquam vivam?
tr: λεγει αυτω η γυνη κυριε ουτε αντλημα εχεις και το φρεαρ εστιν βαθυ ποθεν ουν εχεις το υδωρ το ζων
kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

vulg: numquid tu maior es patre nostro Iacob qui dedit nobis puteum et ipse ex eo bibit et filii eius et pecora eius
clem: Numquid tu major es patre nostro Jacob, qui dedit nobis puteum, et ipse ex eo bibit, et filii ejus, et pecora ejus?
tr: μη συ μειζων ει του πατρος ημων ιακωβ ος εδωκεν ημιν το φρεαρ και αυτος εξ αυτου επιεν και οι υιοι αυτου και τα θρεμματα αυτου
kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei omnis qui bibit ex aqua hac sitiet iterum qui autem biberit ex aqua quam ego dabo ei non sitiet in aeternum
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Omnis qui bibit ex aqua hac, sitiet iterum; qui autem biberit ex aqua quam ego dabo ei, non sitiet in ternum:
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτη πας ο πινων εκ του υδατος τουτου διψησει παλιν
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

vulg: sed aqua quam dabo ei fiet in eo fons aquae salientis in vitam aeternam
clem: sed aqua quam ego dabo ei, fiet in eo fons aqu salientis in vitam ternam.
tr: ος δ αν πιη εκ του υδατος ου εγω δωσω αυτω ου μη διψηση εις τον αιωνα αλλα το υδωρ ο δωσω αυτω γενησεται εν αυτω πηγη υδατος αλλομενου εις ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

vulg: dicit ad eum mulier Domine da mihi hanc aquam ut non sitiam neque veniam huc haurire
clem: Dicit ad eum mulier: Domine, da mihi hanc aquam, ut non sitiam, neque veniam huc haurire.
tr: λεγει προς αυτον η γυνη κυριε δος μοι τουτο το υδωρ ινα μη διψω μηδε ερχωμαι ενθαδε αντλειν
kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus vade voca virum tuum et veni huc
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Vade, voca virum tuum, et veni huc.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους υπαγε φωνησον τον ανδρα σου και ελθε ενθαδε
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

vulg: respondit mulier et dixit non habeo virum dicit ei Iesus bene dixisti quia non habeo virum
clem: Respondit mulier, et dixit: Non habeo virum. Dicit ei Jesus: Bene dixisti, quia non habeo virum;
tr: απεκριθη η γυνη και ειπεν ουκ εχω ανδρα λεγει αυτη ο ιησους καλως ειπας οτι ανδρα ουκ εχω
kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

vulg: quinque enim viros habuisti et nunc quem habes non est tuus vir hoc vere dixisti
clem: quinque enim viros habuisti, et nunc, quem habes, non est tuus vir: hoc vere dixisti.
tr: πεντε γαρ ανδρας εσχες και νυν ον εχεις ουκ εστιν σου ανηρ τουτο αληθες ειρηκας
kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

vulg: dicit ei mulier Domine video quia propheta es tu
clem: Dicit ei mulier: Domine, video quia propheta es tu.
tr: λεγει αυτω η γυνη κυριε θεωρω οτι προφητης ει συ
kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

vulg: patres nostri in monte hoc adoraverunt et vos dicitis quia Hierosolymis est locus ubi adorare oportet
clem: Patres nostri in monte hoc adoraverunt, et vos dicitis, quia Jerosolymis est locus ubi adorare oportet.
tr: οι πατερες ημων εν τουτω τω ορει προσεκυνησαν και υμεις λεγετε οτι εν ιεροσολυμοις εστιν ο τοπος οπου δει προσκυνειν
kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus mulier crede mihi quia veniet hora quando neque in monte hoc neque in Hierosolymis adorabitis Patrem
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Mulier, crede mihi, quia venit hora, quando neque in monte hoc, neque in Jerosolymis adorabitis Patrem.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους γυναι πιστευσον μοι οτι ερχεται ωρα οτε ουτε εν τω ορει τουτω ουτε εν ιεροσολυμοις προσκυνησετε τω πατρι
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

vulg: vos adoratis quod nescitis nos adoramus quod scimus quia salus ex Iudaeis est
clem: Vos adoratis quod nescitis: nos adoramus quod scimus, quia salus ex Judis est.
tr: υμεις προσκυνειτε ο ουκ οιδατε ημεις προσκυνουμεν ο οιδαμεν οτι η σωτηρια εκ των ιουδαιων εστιν
kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

vulg: sed venit hora et nunc est quando veri adoratores adorabunt Patrem in spiritu et veritate nam et Pater tales quaerit qui adorent eum
clem: Sed venit hora, et nunc est, quando veri adoratores adorabunt Patrem in spiritu et veritate. Nam et Pater tales qurit, qui adorent eum.
tr: αλλ ερχεται ωρα και νυν εστιν οτε οι αληθινοι προσκυνηται προσκυνησουσιν τω πατρι εν πνευματι και αληθεια και γαρ ο πατηρ τοιουτους ζητει τους προσκυνουντας αυτον
kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

vulg: spiritus est Deus et eos qui adorant eum in spiritu et veritate oportet adorare
clem: Spiritus est Deus: et eos qui adorant eum, in spiritu et veritate oportet adorare.
tr: πνευμα ο θεος και τους προσκυνουντας αυτον εν πνευματι και αληθεια δει προσκυνειν
kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

vulg: dicit ei mulier scio quia Messias venit qui dicitur Christus cum ergo venerit ille nobis adnuntiabit omnia
clem: Dicit ei mulier: Scio quia Messias venit (qui dicitur Christus): cum ergo venerit ille, nobis annuntiabit omnia.
tr: λεγει αυτω η γυνη οιδα οτι μεσσιας ερχεται ο λεγομενος χριστος οταν ελθη εκεινος αναγγελει ημιν παντα
kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus ego sum qui loquor tecum
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Ego sum, qui loquor te.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους εγω ειμι ο λαλων σοι
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

vulg: et continuo venerunt discipuli eius et mirabantur quia cum muliere loquebatur nemo tamen dixit quid quaeris aut quid loqueris cum ea
clem: Et continuo venerunt discipuli ejus, et mirabantur quia cum muliere loquebatur. Nemo tamen dixit: Quid quris? aut, Quid loqueris cum ea?
tr: και επι τουτω ηλθον οι μαθηται αυτου και εθαυμασαν οτι μετα γυναικος ελαλει ουδεις μεντοι ειπεν τι ζητεις η τι λαλεις μετ αυτης
kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

vulg: reliquit ergo hydriam suam mulier et abiit in civitatem et dicit illis hominibus
clem: Reliquit ergo hydriam suam mulier, et abiit in civitatem, et dicit illis hominibus:
tr: αφηκεν ουν την υδριαν αυτης η γυνη και απηλθεν εις την πολιν και λεγει τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

vulg: venite videte hominem qui dixit mihi omnia quaecumque feci numquid ipse est Christus
clem: Venite, et videte hominem qui dixit mihi omnia qucumque feci: numquid ipse est Christus?
tr: δευτε ιδετε ανθρωπον ος ειπεν μοι παντα οσα εποιησα μητι ουτος εστιν ο χριστος
kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

vulg: exierunt de civitate et veniebant ad eum
clem: Exierunt ergo de civitate et veniebant ad eum.
tr: εξηλθον ουν εκ της πολεως και ηρχοντο προς αυτον
kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

vulg: interea rogabant eum discipuli dicentes rabbi manduca
clem: Interea rogabant eum discipuli, dicentes: Rabbi, manduca.
tr: εν δε τω μεταξυ ηρωτων αυτον οι μαθηται λεγοντες ραββι φαγε
kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

vulg: ille autem dixit eis ego cibum habeo manducare quem vos nescitis
clem: Ille autem dicit eis: Ego cibum habeo manducare, quem vos nescitis.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις εγω βρωσιν εχω φαγειν ην υμεις ουκ οιδατε
kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

vulg: dicebant ergo discipuli ad invicem numquid aliquis adtulit ei manducare
clem: Dicebant ergo discipuli ad invicem: Numquid aliquis attulit ei manducare?
tr: ελεγον ουν οι μαθηται προς αλληλους μη τις ηνεγκεν αυτω φαγειν
kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

vulg: dicit eis Iesus meus cibus est ut faciam voluntatem eius qui misit me ut perficiam opus eius
clem: Dicit eis Jesus: Meus cibus est ut faciam voluntatem ejus qui misit me, ut perficiam opus ejus.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους εμον βρωμα εστιν ινα ποιω το θελημα του πεμψαντος με και τελειωσω αυτου το εργον
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

vulg: nonne vos dicitis quod adhuc quattuor menses sunt et messis venit ecce dico vobis levate oculos vestros et videte regiones quia albae sunt iam ad messem
clem: Nonne vos dicitis quod adhuc quatuor menses sunt, et messis venit? Ecce dico vobis: levate oculos vestros, et videte regiones, quia alb sunt jam ad messem.
tr: ουχ υμεις λεγετε οτι ετι τετραμηνον εστιν και ο θερισμος ερχεται ιδου λεγω υμιν επαρατε τους οφθαλμους υμων και θεασασθε τας χωρας οτι λευκαι εισιν προς θερισμον ηδη
kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

vulg: et qui metit mercedem accipit et congregat fructum in vitam aeternam ut et qui seminat simul gaudeat et qui metit
clem: Et qui metit, mercedem accipit, et congregat fructum in vitam ternam: ut et qui seminat, simul gaudeat, et qui metit.
tr: και ο θεριζων μισθον λαμβανει και συναγει καρπον εις ζωην αιωνιον ινα και ο σπειρων ομου χαιρη και ο θεριζων
kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

vulg: in hoc enim est verbum verum quia alius est qui seminat et alius est qui metit
clem: In hoc enim est verbum verum: quia alius est qui seminat, et alius est qui metit.
tr: εν γαρ τουτω ο λογος εστιν ο   αληθινος οτι αλλος εστιν ο σπειρων και αλλος ο θεριζων
kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

vulg: ego misi vos metere quod vos non laborastis alii laboraverunt et vos in laborem eorum introistis
clem: Ego misi vos metere quod vos non laborastis: alii laboraverunt, et vos in labores eorum introistis.
tr: εγω απεστειλα υμας θεριζειν ο ουχ υμεις κεκοπιακατε αλλοι κεκοπιακασιν και υμεις εις τον κοπον αυτων εισεληλυθατε
kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

vulg: ex civitate autem illa multi crediderunt in eum Samaritanorum propter verbum mulieris testimonium perhibentis quia dixit mihi omnia quaecumque feci
clem: Ex civitate autem illa multi crediderunt in eum Samaritanorum, propter verbum mulieris testimonium perhibentis: Quia dixit mihi omnia qucumque feci.
tr: εκ δε της πολεως εκεινης πολλοι επιστευσαν εις αυτον των σαμαρειτων δια τον λογον της γυναικος μαρτυρουσης οτι ειπεν μοι παντα οσα εποιησα
kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

vulg: cum venissent ergo ad illum Samaritani rogaverunt eum ut ibi maneret et mansit ibi duos dies
clem: Cum venissent ergo ad illum Samaritani, rogaverunt eum ut ibi maneret. Et mansit ibi duos dies.
tr: ως ουν ηλθον προς αυτον οι σαμαρειται ηρωτων αυτον μειναι παρ αυτοις και εμεινεν εκει δυο ημερας
kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

vulg: et multo plures crediderunt propter sermonem eius
clem: Et multo plures crediderunt in eum propter sermonem ejus.
tr: και πολλω πλειους επιστευσαν δια τον λογον αυτου
kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;

vulg: et mulieri dicebant quia iam non propter tuam loquellam credimus ipsi enim audivimus et scimus quia hic est vere salvator mundi
clem: Et mulieri dicebant: Quia jam non propter tuam loquelam credimus: ipsi enim audivimus, et scimus quia hic est vere Salvator mundi.
tr: τη τε γυναικι ελεγον οτι ουκετι δια την σην λαλιαν πιστευομεν αυτοι γαρ ακηκοαμεν και οιδαμεν οτι ουτος εστιν αληθως ο σωτηρ του κοσμου ο χριστος
kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

vulg: post duos autem dies exiit inde et abiit in Galilaeam
clem: Post duos autem dies exiit inde, et abiit in Galilam.
tr: μετα δε τας δυο ημερας εξηλθεν εκειθεν και απηλθεν εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

vulg: ipse enim Iesus testimonium perhibuit quia propheta in sua patria honorem non habet
clem: Ipse enim Jesus testimonium perhibuit, quia propheta in sua patria honorem non habet.
tr: αυτος γαρ ο ιησους εμαρτυρησεν οτι προφητης εν τη ιδια πατριδι τιμην ουκ εχει
kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

vulg: cum ergo venisset in Galilaeam exceperunt eum Galilaei cum omnia vidissent quae fecerat Hierosolymis in die festo et ipsi enim venerant in diem festum
clem: Cum ergo venisset in Galilam, exceperunt eum Galili, cum omnia vidissent qu fecerat Jerosolymis in die festo: et ipsi enim venerant ad diem festum.
tr: οτε ουν ηλθεν εις την γαλιλαιαν εδεξαντο αυτον οι γαλιλαιοι παντα εωρακοτες α εποιησεν εν ιεροσολυμοις εν τη εορτη και αυτοι γαρ ηλθον εις την εορτην
kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

vulg: venit ergo iterum in Cana Galilaeae ubi fecit aquam vinum et erat quidam regulus cuius filius infirmabatur Capharnaum
clem: Venit ergo iterum in Cana Galil, ubi fecit aquam vinum. Et erat quidam regulus, cujus filius infirmabatur Capharnaum.
tr: ηλθεν ουν ο ιησους παλιν εις την κανα της γαλιλαιας οπου εποιησεν το υδωρ οινον και ην τις βασιλικος ου ο υιος ησθενει εν καπερναουμ
kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

vulg: hic cum audisset quia Iesus adveniret a Iudaea in Galilaeam abiit ad eum et rogabat eum ut descenderet et sanaret filium eius incipiebat enim mori
clem: Hic cum audisset quia Jesus adveniret a Juda in Galilam, abiit ad eum, et rogabat eum ut descenderet, et sanaret filium ejus: incipiebat enim mori.
tr: ουτος ακουσας οτι ιησους ηκει εκ της ιουδαιας εις την γαλιλαιαν απηλθεν προς αυτον και ηρωτα αυτον ινα καταβη και ιασηται αυτου τον υιον ημελλεν γαρ αποθνησκειν
kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus ad eum nisi signa et prodigia videritis non creditis
clem: Dixit ergo Jesus ad eum: Nisi signa et prodigia videritis, non creditis.
tr: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους προς αυτον εαν μη σημεια και τερατα ιδητε ου μη πιστευσητε
kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

vulg: dicit ad eum regulus Domine descende priusquam moriatur filius meus
clem: Dicit ad eum regulus: Domine, descende priusquam moriatur filius meus.
tr: λεγει προς αυτον ο βασιλικος κυριε καταβηθι πριν αποθανειν το παιδιον μου
kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus vade filius tuus vivit credidit homo sermoni quem dixit ei Iesus et ibat
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Vade, filius tuus vivit. Credidit homo sermoni quem dixit ei Jesus, et ibat.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους πορευου ο υιος σου ζη και επιστευσεν ο ανθρωπος τω λογω ω ειπεν αυτω ιησους και επορευετο
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

vulg: iam autem eo descendente servi occurrerunt ei et nuntiaverunt dicentes quia filius eius viveret
clem: Jam autem eo descendente, servi occurrerunt ei, et nuntiaverunt dicentes, quia filius ejus viveret.
tr: ηδη δε αυτου καταβαινοντος οι δουλοι αυτου απηντησαν αυτω και απηγγειλαν λεγοντες οτι ο παις σου ζη
kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

vulg: interrogabat ergo horam ab eis in qua melius habuerit et dixerunt ei quia heri hora septima reliquit eum febris
clem: Interrogabat ergo horam ab eis in qua melius habuerit. Et dixerunt ei: Quia heri hora septima reliquit eum febris.
tr: επυθετο ουν παρ αυτων την ωραν εν η κομψοτερον εσχεν και ειπον αυτω οτι χθες ωραν εβδομην αφηκεν αυτον ο πυρετος
kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

vulg: cognovit ergo pater quia illa hora erat in qua dixit ei Iesus filius tuus vivit et credidit ipse et domus eius tota
clem: Cognovit ergo pater, quia illa hora erat in qua dixit ei Jesus: Filius tuus vivit; et credidit ipse et domus ejus tota.
tr: εγνω ουν ο πατηρ οτι εν εκεινη τη ωρα εν η ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους οτι ο υιος σου ζη και επιστευσεν αυτος και η οικια αυτου ολη
kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

vulg: hoc iterum secundum signum fecit Iesus cum venisset a Iudaea in Galilaeam
clem: Hoc iterum secundum signum fecit Jesus, cum venisset a Juda in Galilam.
tr: τουτο παλιν δευτερον σημειον εποιησεν ο ιησους ελθων εκ της ιουδαιας εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

vulg: post haec erat dies festus Iudaeorum et ascendit Iesus Hierosolymis
clem: Post hc erat dies festus Judorum, et ascendit Jesus Jerosolymam.
tr: μετα ταυτα ην εορτη των ιουδαιων και ανεβη ο ιησους εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

vulg: est autem Hierosolymis super Probatica piscina quae cognominatur hebraice Bethsaida quinque porticus habens
clem: Est autem Jerosolymis probatica piscina, qu cognominatur hebraice Bethsaida, quinque porticus habens.
tr: εστιν δε εν τοις ιεροσολυμοις επι τη προβατικη κολυμβηθρα η επιλεγομενη εβραιστι βηθεσδα πεντε στοας εχουσα
kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

vulg: in his iacebat multitudo magna languentium caecorum claudorum aridorum expectantium aquae motum
clem: In his jacebat multitudo magna languentium, ccorum, claudorum, aridorum, exspectantium aqu motum.
tr: εν ταυταις κατεκειτο πληθος πολυ των ασθενουντων τυφλων χωλων ξηρων εκδεχομενων την του υδατος κινησιν
kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

clem: Angelus autem Domini descendebat secundum tempus in piscinam, et movebatur aqua. Et qui prior descendisset in piscinam post motionem aqu, sanus fiebat a quacumque detinebatur infirmitate.
tr: αγγελος γαρ κατα καιρον κατεβαινεν εν τη κολυμβηθρα και εταρασσεν το υδωρ ο ουν πρωτος εμβας μετα την ταραχην του υδατος υγιης εγινετο ω δηποτε κατειχετο νοσηματι
kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

vulg: erat autem quidam homo ibi triginta et octo annos habens in infirmitate sua
clem: Erat autem quidam homo ibi triginta et octo annos habens in infirmitate sua.
tr: ην δε τις ανθρωπος εκει τριακονταοκτω   τριακοντα και οκτω  ετη εχων εν τη ασθενεια
kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

vulg: hunc cum vidisset Iesus iacentem et cognovisset quia multum iam tempus habet dicit ei vis sanus fieri
clem: Hunc autem cum vidisset Jesus jacentem, et cognovisset quia jam multum tempus haberet, dicit ei: Vis sanus fieri?
tr: τουτον ιδων ο ιησους κατακειμενον και γνους οτι πολυν ηδη χρονον εχει λεγει αυτω θελεις υγιης γενεσθαι
kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

vulg: respondit ei languidus Domine hominem non habeo ut cum turbata fuerit aqua mittat me in piscinam dum venio enim ego alius ante me descendit
clem: Respondit ei languidus: Domine, hominem non habeo, ut, cum turbata fuerit aqua, mittat me in piscinam: dum venio enim ego, alius ante me descendit.
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο ασθενων κυριε ανθρωπον ουκ εχω ινα οταν ταραχθη το υδωρ βαλλη με εις την κολυμβηθραν εν ω δε ερχομαι εγω αλλος προ εμου καταβαινει
kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus surge tolle grabattum tuum et ambula
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Surge, tolle grabatum tuum et ambula.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους εγειραι αρον τον κραββατον σου και περιπατει
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

vulg: et statim sanus factus est homo et sustulit grabattum suum et ambulabat erat autem sabbatum in illo die
clem: Et statim sanus factus est homo ille: et sustulit grabatum suum, et ambulabat. Erat autem sabbatum in die illo.
tr: και ευθεως εγενετο υγιης ο ανθρωπος και ηρεν τον κραββατον αυτου και περιεπατει ην δε σαββατον εν εκεινη τη ημερα
kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

vulg: dicebant Iudaei illi qui sanatus fuerat sabbatum est non licet tibi tollere grabattum tuum
clem: Dicebant ergo Judi illi qui sanatus fuerat: Sabbatum est, non licet tibi tollere grabatum tuum.
tr: ελεγον ουν οι ιουδαιοι τω τεθεραπευμενω σαββατον εστιν ουκ εξεστιν σοι αραι τον κραββατον
kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

vulg: respondit eis qui me fecit sanum ille mihi dixit tolle grabattum tuum et ambula
clem: Respondit eis: Qui me sanum fecit, ille mihi dixit: Tolle grabatum tuum et ambula.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ποιησας με υγιη εκεινος μοι ειπεν αρον τον κραββατον σου και περιπατει
kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

vulg: interrogaverunt ergo eum quis est ille homo qui dixit tibi tolle grabattum tuum et ambula
clem: Interrogaverunt ergo eum: Quis est ille homo qui dixit tibi: Tolle grabatum tuum et ambula?
tr: ηρωτησαν ουν αυτον τις εστιν ο ανθρωπος ο ειπων σοι αρον τον κραββατον σου και περιπατει
kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

vulg: is autem qui sanus fuerat effectus nesciebat quis esset Iesus enim declinavit turba constituta in loco
clem: Is autem qui sanus fuerat effectus, nesciebat quis esset. Jesus enim declinavit a turba constituta in loco.
tr: ο δε ιαθεις ουκ ηδει τις εστιν ο γαρ ιησους εξενευσεν οχλου οντος εν τω τοπω
kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

vulg: postea invenit eum Iesus in templo et dixit illi ecce sanus factus es iam noli peccare ne deterius tibi aliquid contingat
clem: Postea invenit eum Jesus in templo, et dixit illi: Ecce sanus factus es; jam noli peccare, ne deterius tibi aliquid contingat.
tr: μετα ταυτα ευρισκει αυτον ο ιησους εν τω ιερω και ειπεν αυτω ιδε υγιης γεγονας μηκετι αμαρτανε ινα μη χειρον τι σοι γενηται
kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

vulg: abiit ille homo et nuntiavit Iudaeis quia Iesus esset qui fecit eum sanum
clem: Abiit ille homo, et nuntiavit Judis quia Jesus esset, qui fecit eum sanum.
tr: απηλθεν ο ανθρωπος και ανηγγειλεν τοις ιουδαιοις οτι ιησους εστιν ο ποιησας αυτον υγιη
kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

vulg: propterea persequebantur Iudaei Iesum quia haec faciebat in sabbato
clem: Propterea persequebantur Judi Jesum, quia hc faciebat in sabbato.
tr: και δια τουτο εδιωκον τον ιησουν οι ιουδαιοι και εζητουν αυτον αποκτειναι οτι ταυτα εποιει εν σαββατω
kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

vulg: Iesus autem respondit eis Pater meus usque modo operatur et ego operor
clem: Jesus autem respondit eis: Pater meus usque modo operatur, et ego operor.
tr: ο δε ιησους απεκρινατο αυτοις ο πατηρ μου εως αρτι εργαζεται καγω εργαζομαι
kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

vulg: propterea ergo magis quaerebant eum Iudaei interficere quia non solum solvebat sabbatum sed et Patrem suum dicebat Deum aequalem se faciens Deo respondit itaque Iesus et dixit eis
clem: Propterea ergo magis qurebant eum Judi interficere: quia non solum solvebat sabbatum, sed et patrem suum dicebat Deum, qualem se faciens Deo. Respondit itaque Jesus, et dixit eis:
tr: δια τουτο ουν μαλλον εζητουν αυτον οι ιουδαιοι αποκτειναι οτι ου μονον ελυεν το σαββατον αλλα και πατερα ιδιον ελεγεν τον θεον ισον εαυτον ποιων τω θεω
kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis non potest Filius a se facere quicquam nisi quod viderit Patrem facientem quaecumque enim ille fecerit haec et Filius similiter facit
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: non potest Filius a se facere quidquam, nisi quod viderit Patrem facientem: qucumque enim ille fecerit, hc et Filius similiter facit.
tr: απεκρινατο ουν ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ου δυναται ο υιος ποιειν αφ εαυτου ουδεν εαν μη τι βλεπη τον πατερα ποιουντα α γαρ αν εκεινος ποιη ταυτα και ο υιος ομοιως ποιει
kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

vulg: Pater enim diligit Filium et omnia demonstrat ei quae ipse facit et maiora his demonstrabit ei opera ut vos miremini
clem: Pater enim diligit Filium, et omnia demonstrat ei qu ipse facit: et majora his demonstrabit ei opera, ut vos miremini.
tr: ο γαρ πατηρ φιλει τον υιον και παντα δεικνυσιν αυτω α αυτος ποιει και μειζονα τουτων δειξει αυτω εργα ινα υμεις θαυμαζητε
kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

vulg: sicut enim Pater suscitat mortuos et vivificat sic et Filius quos vult vivificat
clem: Sicut enim Pater suscitat mortuos, et vivificat, sic et Filius, quos vult, vivificat.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ ο πατηρ εγειρει τους νεκρους και ζωοποιει ουτως και ο υιος ους θελει ζωοποιει
kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

vulg: neque enim Pater iudicat quemquam sed iudicium omne dedit Filio
clem: Neque enim Pater judicat quemquam: sed omne judicium dedit Filio,
tr: ουδε γαρ ο πατηρ κρινει ουδενα αλλα την κρισιν πασαν δεδωκεν τω υιω
kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

vulg: ut omnes honorificent Filium sicut honorificant Patrem qui non honorificat Filium non honorificat Patrem qui misit illum
clem: ut omnes honorificent Filium, sicut honorificant Patrem; qui non honorificat Filium, non honorificat Patrem, qui misit illum.
tr: ινα παντες τιμωσιν τον υιον καθως τιμωσιν τον πατερα ο μη τιμων τον υιον ου τιμα τον πατερα τον πεμψαντα αυτον
kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis quia qui verbum meum audit et credit ei qui misit me habet vitam aeternam et in iudicium non venit sed transit a morte in vitam
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia qui verbum meum audit, et credit ei qui misit me, habet vitam ternam, et in judicium non venit, sed transiit a morte in vitam.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ο τον λογον μου ακουων και πιστευων τω πεμψαντι με εχει ζωην αιωνιον και εις κρισιν ουκ ερχεται αλλα μεταβεβηκεν εκ του θανατου εις την ζωην
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis quia venit hora et nunc est quando mortui audient vocem Filii Dei et qui audierint vivent
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia venit hora, et nunc est, quando mortui audient vocem Filii Dei: et qui audierint, vivent.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ερχεται ωρα και νυν εστιν οτε οι νεκροι ακουσονται της φωνης του υιου του θεου και οι ακουσαντες ζησονται
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

vulg: sicut enim Pater habet vitam in semet ipso sic dedit et Filio vitam habere in semet ipso
clem: Sicut enim Pater habet vitam in semetipso, sic dedit et Filio habere vitam in semetipso:
tr: ωσπερ γαρ ο πατηρ εχει ζωην εν εαυτω ουτως εδωκεν και τω υιω ζωην εχειν εν εαυτω
kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

vulg: et potestatem dedit ei et iudicium facere quia Filius hominis est
