clem: et potestatem dedit ei judicium facere, quia Filius hominis est.
tr: και εξουσιαν εδωκεν αυτω και κρισιν ποιειν οτι υιος ανθρωπου εστιν
kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

vulg: nolite mirari hoc quia venit hora in qua omnes qui in monumentis sunt audient vocem eius
clem: Nolite mirari hoc, quia venit hora in qua omnes qui in monumentis sunt audient vocem Filii Dei:
tr: μη θαυμαζετε τουτο οτι ερχεται ωρα εν η παντες οι εν τοις μνημειοις ακουσονται της φωνης αυτου
kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

vulg: et procedent qui bona fecerunt in resurrectionem vitae qui vero mala egerunt in resurrectionem iudicii
clem: et procedent qui bona fecerunt, in resurrectionem vit; qui vero mala egerunt, in resurrectionem judicii.
tr: και εκπορευσονται οι τα αγαθα ποιησαντες εις αναστασιν ζωης οι δε τα φαυλα πραξαντες εις αναστασιν κρισεως
kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

vulg: non possum ego a me ipso facere quicquam sicut audio iudico et iudicium meum iustum est quia non quaero voluntatem meam sed voluntatem eius qui misit me
clem: Non possum ego a meipso facere quidquam. Sicut audio, judico: et judicium meum justum est, quia non quro voluntatem meam, sed voluntatem ejus qui misit me.
tr: ου δυναμαι εγω ποιειν απ εμαυτου ουδεν καθως ακουω κρινω και η κρισις η εμη δικαια εστιν οτι ου ζητω το θελημα το εμον αλλα το θελημα του πεμψαντος με πατρος
kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

vulg: si ego testimonium perhibeo de me testimonium meum non est verum
clem: Si ego testimonium perhibeo de meipso, testimonium meum non est verum.
tr: εαν εγω μαρτυρω περι εμαυτου η μαρτυρια μου ουκ εστιν αληθης
kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

vulg: alius est qui testimonium perhibet de me et scio quia verum est testimonium quod perhibet de me
clem: Alius est qui testimonium perhibet de me: et scio quia verum est testimonium, quod perhibet de me.
tr: αλλος εστιν ο μαρτυρων περι εμου και οιδα οτι αληθης εστιν η μαρτυρια ην μαρτυρει περι εμου
kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

vulg: vos misistis ad Iohannem et testimonium perhibuit veritati
clem: Vos misistis ad Joannem, et testimonium perhibuit veritati.
tr: υμεις απεσταλκατε προς ιωαννην και μεμαρτυρηκεν τη αληθεια
kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

vulg: ego autem non ab homine testimonium accipio sed haec dico ut vos salvi sitis
clem: Ego autem non ab homine testimonium accipio: sed hc dico ut vos salvi sitis.
tr: εγω δε ου παρα ανθρωπου την μαρτυριαν λαμβανω αλλα ταυτα λεγω ινα υμεις σωθητε
kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

vulg: ille erat lucerna ardens et lucens vos autem voluistis exultare ad horam in luce eius
clem: Ille erat lucerna ardens et lucens: vos autem voluistis ad horam exsultare in luce ejus.
tr: εκεινος ην ο λυχνος ο καιομενος και φαινων υμεις δε ηθελησατε αγαλλιασθηναι προς ωραν εν τω φωτι αυτου
kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

vulg: ego autem habeo testimonium maius Iohanne opera enim quae dedit mihi Pater ut perficiam ea ipsa opera quae ego facio testimonium perhibent de me quia Pater me misit
clem: Ego autem habeo testimonium majus Joanne. Opera enim qu dedit mihi Pater ut perficiam ea: ipsa opera, qu ego facio, testimonium perhibent de me, quia Pater misit me:
tr: εγω δε εχω την μαρτυριαν μειζω του ιωαννου τα γαρ εργα α εδωκεν μοι ο πατηρ ινα τελειωσω αυτα αυτα τα εργα α εγω ποιω μαρτυρει περι εμου οτι ο πατηρ με απεσταλκεν
kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

vulg: et qui misit me Pater ipse testimonium perhibuit de me neque vocem eius umquam audistis neque speciem eius vidistis
clem: et qui misit me Pater, ipse testimonium perhibuit de me: neque vocem ejus umquam audistis, neque speciem ejus vidistis:
tr: και ο πεμψας με πατηρ αυτος μεμαρτυρηκεν περι εμου ουτε φωνην αυτου ακηκοατε πωποτε ουτε ειδος αυτου εωρακατε
kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

vulg: et verbum eius non habetis in vobis manens quia quem misit ille huic vos non creditis
clem: et verbum ejus non habetis in vobis manens: quia quem misit ille, huic vos non creditis.
tr: και τον λογον αυτου ουκ εχετε μενοντα εν υμιν οτι ον απεστειλεν εκεινος τουτω υμεις ου πιστευετε
kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

vulg: scrutamini scripturas quia vos putatis in ipsis vitam aeternam habere et illae sunt quae testimonium perhibent de me
clem: Scrutamini Scripturas, quia vos putatis in ipsis vitam ternam habere: et ill sunt qu testimonium perhibent de me:
tr: ερευνατε  τας γραφας οτι υμεις δοκειτε εν αυταις ζωην αιωνιον εχειν και εκειναι εισιν αι μαρτυρουσαι περι εμου
kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

vulg: et non vultis venire ad me ut vitam habeatis
clem: et non vultis venire ad me ut vitam habeatis.
tr: και ου θελετε ελθειν προς με ινα ζωην εχητε
kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

vulg: claritatem ab hominibus non accipio
clem: Claritatem ab hominibus non accipio.
tr: δοξαν παρα ανθρωπων ου λαμβανω
kjv: I receive not honour from men.

vulg: sed cognovi vos quia dilectionem Dei non habetis in vobis
clem: Sed cognovi vos, quia dilectionem Dei non habetis in vobis.
tr: αλλ εγνωκα υμας οτι την αγαπην του θεου ουκ εχετε εν εαυτοις
kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

vulg: ego veni in nomine Patris mei et non accipitis me si alius venerit in nomine suo illum accipietis
clem: Ego veni in nomine Patris mei, et non accipitis me; si alius venerit in nomine suo, illum accipietis.
tr: εγω εληλυθα εν τω ονοματι του πατρος μου και ου λαμβανετε με εαν αλλος ελθη εν τω ονοματι τω ιδιω εκεινον ληψεσθε
kjv: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

vulg: quomodo potestis vos credere qui gloriam ab invicem accipitis et gloriam quae a solo est Deo non quaeritis
clem: Quomodo vos potestis credere, qui gloriam ab invicem accipitis, et gloriam qu a solo Deo est, non quritis?
tr: πως δυνασθε υμεις πιστευσαι δοξαν παρα αλληλων λαμβανοντες και την δοξαν την παρα του μονου θεου ου ζητειτε
kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

vulg: nolite putare quia ego accusaturus sim vos apud Patrem est qui accuset vos Moses in quo vos speratis
clem: Nolite putare quia ego accusaturus sim vos apud Patrem: est qui accusat vos Moyses, in quo vos speratis.
tr: μη δοκειτε οτι εγω κατηγορησω υμων προς τον πατερα εστιν ο κατηγορων υμων μωσης εις ον υμεις ηλπικατε
kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

vulg: si enim crederetis Mosi crederetis forsitan et mihi de me enim ille scripsit
clem: Si enim crederetis Moysi, crederetis forsitan et mihi: de me enim ille scripsit.
tr: ει γαρ επιστευετε μωση επιστευετε αν εμοι περι γαρ εμου εκεινος εγραψεν
kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me; for he wrote of me.

vulg: si autem illius litteris non creditis quomodo meis verbis credetis
clem: Si autem illius litteris non creditis, quomodo verbis meis credetis?
tr: ει δε τοις εκεινου γραμμασιν ου πιστευετε πως τοις εμοις ρημασιν πιστευσετε
kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

vulg: post haec abiit Iesus trans mare Galilaeae quod est Tiberiadis
clem: Post hc abiit Jesus trans mare Galil, quod est Tiberiadis:
tr: μετα ταυτα απηλθεν ο ιησους περαν της θαλασσης της γαλιλαιας της τιβεριαδος
kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

vulg: et sequebatur eum multitudo magna quia videbant signa quae faciebat super his qui infirmabantur
clem: et sequebatur eum multitudo magna, quia videbant signa qu faciebat super his qui infirmabantur.
tr: και ηκολουθει αυτω οχλος πολυς οτι εωρων αυτου τα σημεια α εποιει επι των ασθενουντων
kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

vulg: subiit ergo in montem Iesus et ibi sedebat cum discipulis suis
clem: Subiit ergo in montem Jesus et ibi sedebat cum discipulis suis.
tr: ανηλθεν δε εις το ορος ο ιησους και εκει εκαθητο μετα των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

vulg: erat autem proximum pascha dies festus Iudaeorum
clem: Erat autem proximum Pascha dies festus Judorum.
tr: ην δε εγγυς το πασχα η εορτη των ιουδαιων
kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

vulg: cum sublevasset ergo oculos Iesus et vidisset quia multitudo maxima venit ad eum dicit ad Philippum unde ememus panes ut manducent hii
clem: Cum sublevasset ergo oculos Jesus, et vidisset quia multitudo maxima venit ad eum, dixit ad Philippum: Unde ememus panes, ut manducent hi?
tr: επαρας ουν ο ιησους τους οφθαλμους και θεασαμενος οτι πολυς οχλος ερχεται προς αυτον λεγει προς τον φιλιππον ποθεν αγορασομεν αρτους ινα φαγωσιν ουτοι
kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

vulg: hoc autem dicebat temptans eum ipse enim sciebat quid esset facturus
clem: Hoc autem dicebat tentans eum: ipse enim sciebat quid esset facturus.
tr: τουτο δε ελεγεν πειραζων αυτον αυτος γαρ ηδει τι εμελλεν ποιειν
kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

vulg: respondit ei Philippus ducentorum denariorum panes non sufficiunt eis ut unusquisque modicum quid accipiat
clem: Respondit ei Philippus: Ducentorum denariorum panes non sufficiunt eis, ut unusquisque modicum quid accipiat.
tr: απεκριθη αυτω φιλιππος διακοσιων δηναριων αρτοι ουκ αρκουσιν αυτοις ινα εκαστος αυτων βραχυ τι λαβη
kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

vulg: dicit ei unus ex discipulis eius Andreas frater Simonis Petri
clem: Dicit ei unus ex discipulis ejus, Andreas, frater Simonis Petri:
tr: λεγει αυτω εις εκ των μαθητων αυτου ανδρεας ο αδελφος σιμωνος πετρου
kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

vulg: est puer unus hic qui habet quinque panes hordiacios et duos pisces sed haec quid sunt inter tantos
clem: Est puer unus hic qui habet quinque panes hordeaceos et duos pisces: sed hc quid sunt inter tantos?
tr: εστιν παιδαριον εν ωδε ο εχει πεντε αρτους κριθινους και δυο οψαρια αλλα ταυτα τι εστιν εις τοσουτους
kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus facite homines discumbere erat autem faenum multum in loco discubuerunt ergo viri numero quasi quinque milia
clem: Dixit ergo Jesus: Facite homines discumbere. Erat autem fnum multum in loco. Discumberunt ergo viri, numero quasi quinque millia.
tr: ειπεν δε ο ιησους ποιησατε τους ανθρωπους αναπεσειν ην δε χορτος πολυς εν τω τοπω ανεπεσον ουν οι ανδρες τον αριθμον ωσει πεντακισχιλιοι
kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

vulg: accepit ergo panes Iesus et cum gratias egisset distribuit discumbentibus similiter et ex piscibus quantum volebant
clem: Accepit ergo Jesus panes: et cum gratias egisset, distribuit discumbentibus: similiter et ex piscibus quantum volebant.
tr: ελαβεν δε τους αρτους ο ιησους και ευχαριστησας διεδωκεν τοις μαθηταις οι δε μαθηται τοις ανακειμενοις ομοιως και εκ των οψαριων οσον ηθελον
kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

vulg: ut autem impleti sunt dixit discipulis suis colligite quae superaverunt fragmenta ne pereant
clem: Ut autem impleti sunt, dixit discipulis suis: Colligite qu superaverunt fragmenta, ne pereant.
tr: ως δε ενεπλησθησαν λεγει τοις μαθηταις αυτου συναγαγετε τα περισσευσαντα κλασματα ινα μη τι αποληται
kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

vulg: collegerunt ergo et impleverunt duodecim cofinos fragmentorum ex quinque panibus hordiaciis quae superfuerunt his qui manducaverunt
clem: Collegerunt ergo, et impleverunt duodecim cophinos fragmentorum ex quinque panibus hordeaceis, qu superfuerunt his qui manducaverant.
tr: συνηγαγον ουν και εγεμισαν δωδεκα κοφινους κλασματων εκ των πεντε αρτων των κριθινων α επερισσευσεν τοις βεβρωκοσιν
kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

vulg: illi ergo homines cum vidissent quod fecerat signum dicebant quia hic est vere propheta qui venturus est in mundum
clem: Illi ergo homines cum vidissent quod Jesus fecerat signum, dicebant: Quia hic est vere propheta, qui venturus est in mundum.
tr: οι ουν ανθρωποι ιδοντες ο εποιησεν σημειον ο ιησους ελεγον οτι ουτος εστιν αληθως ο προφητης ο ερχομενος εις τον κοσμον
kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

vulg: Iesus ergo cum cognovisset quia venturi essent ut raperent eum et facerent eum regem fugit iterum in montem ipse solus
clem: Jesus ergo cum cognovisset quia venturi essent ut raperent eum, et facerent eum regem, fugit iterum in montem ipse solus.
tr: ιησους ουν γνους οτι μελλουσιν ερχεσθαι και αρπαζειν αυτον ινα ποιησωσιν αυτον βασιλεα ανεχωρησεν παλιν εις το ορος αυτος μονος
kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

vulg: ut autem sero factum est descenderunt discipuli eius ad mare
clem: Ut autem sero factum est, descenderunt discipuli ejus ad mare.
tr: ως δε οψια εγενετο κατεβησαν οι μαθηται αυτου επι την θαλασσαν
kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

vulg: et cum ascendissent navem venerunt trans mare in Capharnaum et tenebrae iam factae erant et non venerat ad eos Iesus
clem: Et cum ascendissent navim, venerunt trans mare in Capharnaum: et tenebr jam fact erant et non venerat ad eos Jesus.
tr: και εμβαντες εις το πλοιον ηρχοντο περαν της θαλασσης εις καπερναουμ και σκοτια ηδη εγεγονει και ουκ εληλυθει προς αυτους ο ιησους
kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

vulg: mare autem vento magno flante exsurgebat
clem: Mare autem, vento magno flante, exsurgebat.
tr: η τε θαλασσα ανεμου μεγαλου πνεοντος διηγειρετο
kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

vulg: cum remigassent ergo quasi stadia viginti quinque aut triginta vident Iesum ambulantem super mare et proximum navi fieri et timuerunt
clem: Cum remigassent ergo quasi stadia viginti quinque aut triginta, vident Jesum ambulantem supra mare, et proximum navi fieri, et timuerunt.
tr: εληλακοτες ουν ως σταδιους εικοσιπεντε  η τριακοντα θεωρουσιν τον ιησουν περιπατουντα επι της θαλασσης και εγγυς του πλοιου γινομενον και εφοβηθησαν
kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

vulg: ille autem dicit eis ego sum nolite timere
clem: Ille autem dicit eis: Ego sum, nolite timere.
tr: ο δε λεγει αυτοις εγω ειμι μη φοβεισθε
kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

vulg: voluerunt ergo accipere eum in navi et statim fuit navis ad terram quam ibant
clem: Voluerunt ergo accipere eum in navim et statim navis fuit ad terram, in quam ibant.
tr: ηθελον ουν λαβειν αυτον εις το πλοιον και ευθεως το πλοιον εγενετο επι της γης εις ην υπηγον
kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

vulg: altera die turba quae stabat trans mare vidit quia navicula alia non erat ibi nisi una et quia non introisset cum discipulis suis Iesus in navem sed soli discipuli eius abissent
clem: Altera die, turba, qu stabat trans mare, vidit quia navicula alia non erat ibi nisi una, et quia non introisset cum discipulis suis Jesus in navim, sed soli discipuli ejus abiissent:
tr: τη επαυριον ο οχλος ο εστηκως περαν της θαλασσης ιδων οτι πλοιαριον αλλο ουκ ην εκει ει μη εν εκεινο εις ο ενεβησαν οι μαθηται αυτου και οτι ου συνεισηλθεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ο ιησους εις το πλοιαριον αλλα μονοι οι μαθηται αυτου απηλθον
kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

vulg: aliae vero supervenerunt naves a Tiberiade iuxta locum ubi manducaverant panem gratias agente Domino
clem: ali vero supervenerunt naves a Tiberiade juxta locum ubi manducaverunt panem, gratias agente Domino.
tr: αλλα δε ηλθεν πλοιαρια εκ τιβεριαδος εγγυς του τοπου οπου εφαγον τον αρτον ευχαριστησαντος του κυριου
kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

vulg: cum ergo vidisset turba quia Iesus non esset ibi neque discipuli eius ascenderunt naviculas et venerunt Capharnaum quaerentes Iesum
clem: Cum ergo vidisset turba quia Jesus non esset ibi, neque discipuli ejus, ascenderunt in naviculas, et venerunt Capharnaum qurentes Jesum.
tr: οτε ουν ειδεν ο οχλος οτι ιησους ουκ εστιν εκει ουδε οι μαθηται αυτου ενεβησαν και αυτοι εις τα πλοια και ηλθον εις καπερναουμ ζητουντες τον ιησουν
kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

vulg: et cum invenissent eum trans mare dixerunt ei rabbi quando huc venisti
clem: Et cum invenissent eum trans mare, dixerunt ei: Rabbi, quando huc venisti?
tr: και ευροντες αυτον περαν της θαλασσης ειπον αυτω ραββι ποτε ωδε γεγονας
kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

vulg: respondit eis Iesus et dixit amen amen dico vobis quaeritis me non quia vidistis signa sed quia manducastis ex panibus et saturati estis
clem: Respondit eis Jesus, et dixit: Amen, amen dico vobis: quritis me non quia vidistis signa, sed quia manducastis ex panibus et saturati estis.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους και ειπεν αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ζητειτε με ουχ οτι ειδετε σημεια αλλ οτι εφαγετε εκ των αρτων και εχορτασθητε
kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

vulg: operamini non cibum qui perit sed qui permanet in vitam aeternam quem Filius hominis vobis dabit hunc enim Pater signavit Deus
clem: Operamini non cibum, qui perit, sed qui permanet in vitam ternam, quem Filius hominis dabit vobis. Hunc enim Pater signavit Deus.
tr: εργαζεσθε μη την βρωσιν την απολλυμενην αλλα την βρωσιν την μενουσαν εις ζωην αιωνιον ην ο υιος του ανθρωπου υμιν δωσει τουτον γαρ ο πατηρ εσφραγισεν ο θεος
kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ad eum quid faciemus ut operemur opera Dei
clem: Dixerunt ergo ad eum: Quid faciemus ut operemur opera Dei?
tr: ειπον ουν προς αυτον τι ποιουμεν  ποιωμεν  ινα εργαζωμεθα τα εργα του θεου
kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit eis hoc est opus Dei ut credatis in eum quem misit ille
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis: Hoc est opus Dei, ut credatis in eum quem misit ille.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις τουτο εστιν το εργον του θεου ινα πιστευσητε εις ον απεστειλεν εκεινος
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ei quod ergo tu facis signum ut videamus et credamus tibi quid operaris
clem: Dixerunt ergo ei: Quod ergo tu facis signum ut videamus et credamus tibi? quid operaris?
tr: ειπον ουν αυτω τι ουν ποιεις συ σημειον ινα ιδωμεν και πιστευσωμεν σοι τι εργαζη
kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

vulg: patres nostri manna manducaverunt in deserto sicut scriptum est panem de caelo dedit eis manducare
clem: Patres nostri manducaverunt manna in deserto, sicut scriptum est: Panem de clo dedit eis manducare.
tr: οι πατερες ημων το μαννα εφαγον εν τη ερημω καθως εστιν γεγραμμενον αρτον εκ του ουρανου εδωκεν αυτοις φαγειν
kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

vulg: dixit ergo eis Iesus amen amen dico vobis non Moses dedit vobis panem de caelo sed Pater meus dat vobis panem de caelo verum
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis: non Moyses dedit vobis panem de clo, sed Pater meus dat vobis panem de clo verum.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ου μωσης δεδωκεν υμιν τον αρτον εκ του ουρανου αλλ ο πατηρ μου διδωσιν υμιν τον αρτον εκ του ουρανου τον αληθινον
kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

vulg: panis enim Dei est qui descendit de caelo et dat vitam mundo
clem: Panis enim Dei est, qui de clo descendit, et dat vitam mundo.
tr: ο γαρ αρτος του θεου εστιν ο καταβαινων εκ του ουρανου και ζωην διδους τω κοσμω
kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ad eum Domine semper da nobis panem hunc
clem: Dixerunt ergo ad eum: Domine, semper da nobis panem hunc.
tr: ειπον ουν προς αυτον κυριε παντοτε δος ημιν τον αρτον τουτον
kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

vulg: dixit autem eis Iesus ego sum panis vitae qui veniet ad me non esuriet et qui credit in me non sitiet umquam
clem: Dixit autem eis Jesus: Ego sum panis vit: qui venit ad me, non esuriet, et qui credit in me, non sitiet umquam.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις ο ιησους εγω ειμι ο αρτος της ζωης ο ερχομενος προς με ου μη πειναση και ο πιστευων εις εμε ου μη διψηση πωποτε
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

vulg: sed dixi vobis quia et vidistis me et non creditis
clem: Sed dixi vobis quia et vidistis me, et non creditis.
tr: αλλ ειπον υμιν οτι και εωρακατε με και ου πιστευετε
kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

vulg: omne quod dat mihi Pater ad me veniet et eum qui venit ad me non eiciam foras
clem: Omne quod dat mihi Pater, ad me veniet: et eum qui venit ad me, non ejiciam foras:
tr: παν ο διδωσιν μοι ο πατηρ προς εμε ηξει και τον ερχομενον προς με ου μη εκβαλω εξω
kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

vulg: quia descendi de caelo non ut faciam voluntatem meam sed voluntatem eius qui misit me
clem: quia descendi de clo, non ut faciam voluntatem meam, sed voluntatem ejus qui misit me.
tr: οτι καταβεβηκα εκ του ουρανου ουχ ινα ποιω το θελημα το εμον αλλα το θελημα του πεμψαντος με
kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

vulg: haec est autem voluntas eius qui misit me Patris ut omne quod dedit mihi non perdam ex eo sed resuscitem illum novissimo die
clem: Hc est autem voluntas ejus qui misit me, Patris: ut omne quod dedit mihi, non perdam ex eo, sed resuscitem illud in novissimo die.
tr: τουτο δε εστιν το θελημα του πεμψαντος με πατρος ινα παν ο δεδωκεν μοι μη απολεσω εξ αυτου αλλα αναστησω αυτο εν τη εσχατη ημερα
kjv: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

vulg: haec est enim voluntas Patris mei qui misit me ut omnis qui videt Filium et credit in eum habeat vitam aeternam et resuscitabo ego eum in novissimo die
clem: Hc est autem voluntas Patris mei, qui misit me: ut omnis qui videt Filium et credit in eum, habeat vitam ternam, et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
tr: τουτο δε εστιν το θελημα του πεμψαντος με ινα πας ο θεωρων τον υιον και πιστευων εις αυτον εχη ζωην αιωνιον και αναστησω αυτον εγω τη εσχατη ημερα
kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

vulg: murmurabant ergo Iudaei de illo quia dixisset ego sum panis qui de caelo descendi
clem: Murmurabant ergo Judi de illo, quia dixisset: Ego sum panis vivus, qui de clo descendi,
tr: εγογγυζον ουν οι ιουδαιοι περι αυτου οτι ειπεν εγω ειμι ο αρτος ο καταβας εκ του ουρανου
kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

vulg: et dicebant nonne hic est Iesus filius Ioseph cuius nos novimus patrem et matrem quomodo ergo dicit hic quia de caelo descendi
clem: et dicebant: Nonne hic est Jesus filius Joseph, cujus nos novimus patrem et matrem? quomodo ergo dicit hic: Quia de clo descendi?
tr: και ελεγον ουχ ουτος εστιν ιησους ο υιος ιωσηφ ου ημεις οιδαμεν τον πατερα και την μητερα πως ουν λεγει ουτος οτι εκ του ουρανου καταβεβηκα
kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

vulg: respondit ergo Iesus et dixit eis nolite murmurare in invicem
clem: Respondit ergo Jesus, et dixit eis: Nolite murmurare in invicem:
tr: απεκριθη ουν ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις μη γογγυζετε μετ αλληλων
kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

vulg: nemo potest venire ad me nisi Pater qui misit me traxerit eum et ego resuscitabo eum novissimo die
clem: nemo potest venire ad me, nisi Pater, qui misit me, traxerit eum; et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
tr: ουδεις δυναται ελθειν προς με εαν μη ο πατηρ ο πεμψας με ελκυση αυτον και εγω αναστησω αυτον τη εσχατη ημερα
kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

vulg: est scriptum in prophetis et erunt omnes docibiles Dei omnis qui audivit a Patre et didicit venit ad me
clem: Est scriptum in prophetis: Et erunt omnes docibiles Dei. Omnis qui audivit a Patre, et didicit, venit ad me.
tr: εστιν γεγραμμενον εν τοις προφηταις και εσονται παντες διδακτοι του θεου πας ουν ο ακουσας παρα του πατρος και μαθων ερχεται προς με
kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

vulg: non quia Patrem vidit quisquam nisi is qui est a Deo hic vidit Patrem
clem: Non quia Patrem vidit quisquam, nisi is, qui est a Deo, hic vidit Patrem.
tr: ουχ οτι τον πατερα τις εωρακεν ει μη ο ων παρα του θεου ουτος εωρακεν τον πατερα
kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis qui credit in me habet vitam aeternam
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: qui credit in me, habet vitam ternam.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ο πιστευων εις εμε εχει ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

vulg: ego sum panis vitae
clem: Ego sum panis vit.
tr: εγω ειμι ο αρτος της ζωης
kjv: I am that bread of life.

vulg: patres vestri manducaverunt in deserto manna et mortui sunt
clem: Patres vestri manducaverunt manna in deserto, et mortui sunt.
tr: οι πατερες υμων εφαγον το μαννα εν τη ερημω και απεθανον
kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

vulg: hic est panis de caelo descendens ut si quis ex ipso manducaverit non moriatur
clem: Hic est panis de clo descendens: ut si quis ex ipso manducaverit, non moriatur.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο αρτος ο εκ του ουρανου καταβαινων ινα τις εξ αυτου φαγη και μη αποθανη
kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

vulg: ego sum panis vivus qui de caelo descendi
clem: Ego sum panis vivus, qui de clo descendi.
tr: εγω ειμι ο αρτος ο ζων ο εκ του ουρανου καταβας εαν τις φαγη εκ τουτου του αρτου ζησεται εις τον αιωνα και ο αρτος δε ον εγω δωσω η σαρξ μου εστιν ην εγω δωσω υπερ της του κοσμου ζωης
kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

vulg: si quis manducaverit ex hoc pane vivet in aeternum et panis quem ego dabo caro mea est pro mundi vita
clem: Si quis manducaverit ex hoc pane, vivet in ternum: et panis quem ego dabo, caro mea est pro mundi vita.
tr: εμαχοντο ουν προς αλληλους οι ιουδαιοι λεγοντες πως δυναται ουτος ημιν δουναι την σαρκα φαγειν
kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

vulg: litigabant ergo Iudaei ad invicem dicentes quomodo potest hic nobis carnem suam dare ad manducandum
clem: Litigabant ergo Judi ad invicem, dicentes: Quomodo potest hic nobis carnem suam dare ad manducandum?
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν εαν μη φαγητε την σαρκα του υιου του ανθρωπου και πιητε αυτου το αιμα ουκ εχετε ζωην εν εαυτοις
kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

vulg: dixit ergo eis Iesus amen amen dico vobis nisi manducaveritis carnem Filii hominis et biberitis eius sanguinem non habetis vitam in vobis
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis: nisi manducaveritis carnem Filii hominis, et biberitis ejus sanguinem, non habebitis vitam in vobis.
tr: ο τρωγων μου την σαρκα και πινων μου το αιμα εχει ζωην αιωνιον και εγω αναστησω αυτον τη εσχατη ημερα
kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

vulg: qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem habet vitam aeternam et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die
clem: Qui manducat meam carnem, et bibit meum sanguinem, habet vitam ternam: et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
tr: η γαρ σαρξ μου αληθως εστιν βρωσις και το αιμα μου αληθως εστιν ποσις
kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

vulg: caro enim mea vere est cibus et sanguis meus vere est potus
clem: Caro enim mea vere est cibus: et sanguis meus, vere est potus;
tr: ο τρωγων μου την σαρκα και πινων μου το αιμα εν εμοι μενει καγω εν αυτω
kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

vulg: qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem in me manet et ego in illo
clem: qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem, in me manet, et ego in illo.
tr: καθως απεστειλεν με ο ζων πατηρ καγω ζω δια τον πατερα και ο τρωγων με κακεινος ζησεται δι εμε
kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

vulg: sicut misit me vivens Pater et ego vivo propter Patrem et qui manducat me et ipse vivet propter me
clem: Sicut misit me vivens Pater, et ego vivo propter Patrem: et qui manducat me, et ipse vivet propter me.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο αρτος ο εκ του ουρανου καταβας ου καθως εφαγον οι πατερες υμων το μαννα και απεθανον ο τρωγων τουτον τον αρτον ζησεται εις τον αιωνα
kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

vulg: hic est panis qui de caelo descendit non sicut manducaverunt patres vestri manna et mortui sunt qui manducat hunc panem vivet in aeternum
clem: Hic est panis qui de clo descendit. Non sicut manducaverunt patres vestri manna, et mortui sunt. Qui manducat hunc panem, vivet in ternum.
tr: ταυτα ειπεν εν συναγωγη διδασκων εν καπερναουμ
kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

vulg: haec dixit in synagoga docens in Capharnaum
clem: Hc dixit in synagoga docens, in Capharnaum.
tr: πολλοι ουν ακουσαντες εκ των μαθητων αυτου ειπον σκληρος εστιν ουτος ο λογος τις δυναται αυτου ακουειν
kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

vulg: multi ergo audientes ex discipulis eius dixerunt durus est hic sermo quis potest eum audire
clem: Multi ergo audientes ex discipulis ejus, dixerunt: Durus est hic sermo, et quis potest eum audire?
tr: ειδως δε ο ιησους εν εαυτω οτι γογγυζουσιν περι τουτου οι μαθηται αυτου ειπεν αυτοις τουτο υμας σκανδαλιζει
kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

vulg: sciens autem Iesus apud semet ipsum quia murmurarent de hoc discipuli eius dixit eis hoc vos scandalizat
clem: Sciens autem Jesus apud semetipsum quia murmurarent de hoc discipuli ejus, dixit eis: Hoc vos scandalizat?
tr: εαν ουν θεωρητε τον υιον του ανθρωπου αναβαινοντα οπου ην το προτερον
kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

vulg: si ergo videritis Filium hominis ascendentem ubi erat prius
clem: si ergo videritis Filium hominis ascendentem ubi erat prius?
tr: το πνευμα εστιν το ζωοποιουν η σαρξ ουκ ωφελει ουδεν τα ρηματα α εγω λαλω υμιν πνευμα εστιν και ζωη εστιν
kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

vulg: spiritus est qui vivificat caro non prodest quicquam verba quae ego locutus sum vobis spiritus et vita sunt
clem: Spiritus est qui vivificat: caro non prodest quidquam: verba qu ego locutus sum vobis, spiritus et vita sunt.
tr: αλλ εισιν εξ υμων τινες οι ου πιστευουσιν ηδει γαρ εξ αρχης ο ιησους τινες εισιν οι μη πιστευοντες και τις εστιν ο παραδωσων αυτον
kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

vulg: sed sunt quidam ex vobis qui non credunt sciebat enim ab initio Iesus qui essent credentes et quis traditurus esset eum
clem: Sed sunt quidam ex vobis qui non credunt. Sciebat enim ab initio Jesus qui essent non credentes, et quis traditurus esset eum.
tr: και ελεγεν δια τουτο ειρηκα υμιν οτι ουδεις δυναται ελθειν προς με εαν μη η δεδομενον αυτω εκ του πατρος μου
kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

vulg: et dicebat propterea dixi vobis quia nemo potest venire ad me nisi fuerit ei datum a Patre meo
clem: Et dicebat: Propterea dixi vobis, quia nemo potest venire ad me, nisi fuerit ei datum a Patre meo.
tr: εκ τουτου πολλοι απηλθον των μαθητων αυτου εις τα οπισω και ουκετι μετ αυτου περιεπατουν
kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

vulg: ex hoc multi discipulorum eius abierunt retro et iam non cum illo ambulabant
clem: Ex hoc multi discipulorum ejus abierunt retro: et jam non cum illo ambulabant.
tr: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους τοις δωδεκα μη και υμεις θελετε υπαγειν
kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus ad duodecim numquid et vos vultis abire
clem: Dixit ergo Jesus ad duodecim: Numquid et vos vultis abire?
tr: απεκριθη ουν αυτω σιμων πετρος κυριε προς τινα απελευσομεθα ρηματα ζωης αιωνιου εχεις
kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

vulg: respondit ergo ei Simon Petrus Domine ad quem ibimus verba vitae aeternae habes
clem: Respondit ergo ei Simon Petrus: Domine, ad quem ibimus? verba vit tern habes:
tr: και ημεις πεπιστευκαμεν και εγνωκαμεν οτι συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου του ζωντος
kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

vulg: et nos credidimus et cognovimus quia tu es Christus Filius Dei
clem: et nos credidimus, et cognovimus quia tu es Christus Filius Dei.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους ουκ εγω υμας τους δωδεκα εξελεξαμην και εξ υμων εις διαβολος εστιν
kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

vulg: respondit eis Iesus nonne ego vos duodecim elegi et ex vobis unus diabolus est
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Nonne ego vos duodecim elegi: et ex vobis unus diabolus est?
tr: ελεγεν δε τον ιουδαν σιμωνος ισκαριωτην ουτος γαρ ημελλεν αυτον παραδιδοναι εις ων εκ των δωδεκα
kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

vulg: dicebat autem Iudam Simonis Scariotis hic enim erat traditurus eum cum esset unus ex duodecim
clem: Dicebat autem Judam Simonis Iscariotem: hic enim erat traditurus eum, cum esset unus ex duodecim.

vulg: post haec ambulabat Iesus in Galilaeam non enim volebat in Iudaeam ambulare quia quaerebant eum Iudaei interficere
clem: Post hc autem ambulabat Jesus in Galilam: non enim volebat in Judam ambulare, quia qurebant eum Judi interficere.
tr: και περιεπατει ο ιησους μετα ταυτα εν τη γαλιλαια ου γαρ ηθελεν εν τη ιουδαια περιπατειν οτι εζητουν αυτον οι ιουδαιοι αποκτειναι
kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

vulg: erat autem in proximo dies festus Iudaeorum scenopegia
clem: Erat autem in proximo dies festus Judorum, Scenopegia.
tr: ην δε εγγυς η εορτη των ιουδαιων η σκηνοπηγια
kjv: Now the Jew's feast of tabernacles was at hand.

vulg: dixerunt autem ad eum fratres eius transi hinc et vade in Iudaeam ut et discipuli tui videant opera tua quae facis
clem: Dixerunt autem ad eum fratres ejus: Transi hinc, et vade in Judam, ut et discipuli tui videant opera tua, qu facis.
tr: ειπον ουν προς αυτον οι αδελφοι αυτου μεταβηθι εντευθεν και υπαγε εις την ιουδαιαν ινα και οι μαθηται σου θεωρησωσιν τα εργα σου α ποιεις
kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

vulg: nemo quippe in occulto quid facit et quaerit ipse in palam esse si haec facis manifesta te ipsum mundo
clem: Nemo quippe in occulto quid facit, et qurit ipse in palam esse: si hc facis, manifesta teipsum mundo.
tr: ουδεις γαρ εν κρυπτω τι ποιει και ζητει αυτος εν παρρησια ειναι ει ταυτα ποιεις φανερωσον σεαυτον τω κοσμω
kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

vulg: neque enim fratres eius credebant in eum
clem: Neque enim fratres ejus credebant in eum.
tr: ουδε γαρ οι αδελφοι αυτου επιστευον εις αυτον
kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

vulg: dicit ergo eis Iesus tempus meum nondum advenit tempus autem vestrum semper est paratum
clem: Dicit ergo eis Jesus: Tempus meum nondum advenit: tempus autem vestrum semper est paratum.
tr: λεγει ουν αυτοις ο ιησους ο καιρος ο εμος ουπω παρεστιν ο δε καιρος ο υμετερος παντοτε εστιν ετοιμος
kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

vulg: non potest mundus odisse vos me autem odit quia ego testimonium perhibeo de illo quia opera eius mala sunt
clem: Non potest mundus odisse vos: me autem odit, quia ego testimonium perhibeo de illo quod opera ejus mala sunt.
tr: ου δυναται ο κοσμος μισειν υμας εμε δε μισει οτι εγω μαρτυρω περι αυτου οτι τα εργα αυτου πονηρα εστιν
kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

vulg: vos ascendite ad diem festum hunc ego non ascendo ad diem festum istum quia meum tempus nondum impletum est
clem: Vos ascendite ad diem festum hunc, ego autem non ascendo ad diem festum istum: quia meum tempus nondum impletum est.
tr: υμεις αναβητε εις την εορτην ταυτην εγω ουπω αναβαινω εις την εορτην ταυτην οτι ο καιρος ο εμος ουπω πεπληρωται
kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.

vulg: haec cum dixisset ipse mansit in Galilaea
clem: Hc cum dixisset, ipse mansit in Galila.
tr: ταυτα δε ειπων αυτοις εμεινεν εν τη γαλιλαια
kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

vulg: ut autem ascenderunt fratres eius tunc et ipse ascendit ad diem festum non manifeste sed quasi in occulto
clem: Ut autem ascenderunt fratres ejus, tunc et ipse ascendit ad diem festum non manifeste, sed quasi in occulto.
tr: ως δε ανεβησαν οι αδελφοι αυτου τοτε και αυτος ανεβη εις την εορτην ου φανερως αλλ ως εν κρυπτω
kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

vulg: Iudaei ergo quaerebant eum in die festo et dicebant ubi est ille
clem: Judi ergo qurebant eum in die festo, et dicebant: Ubi est ille?
tr: οι ουν ιουδαιοι εζητουν αυτον εν τη εορτη και ελεγον που εστιν εκεινος
kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

vulg: et murmur multus de eo erat in turba; quidam enim dicebant quia bonus est alii autem dicebant non sed seducit turbas
clem: Et murmur multum erat in turba de eo. Quidam enim dicebant: Quia bonus est. Alii autem dicebant: Non, sed seducit turbas.
tr: και γογγυσμος πολυς περι αυτου ην εν τοις οχλοις οι μεν ελεγον οτι αγαθος εστιν αλλοι δε ελεγον ου αλλα πλανα τον οχλον
kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

vulg: nemo tamen palam loquebatur de illo propter metum Iudaeorum
clem: Nemo tamen palam loquebatur de illo propter metum Judorum.
tr: ουδεις μεντοι παρρησια ελαλει περι αυτου δια τον φοβον των ιουδαιων
kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

vulg: iam autem die festo mediante ascendit Iesus in templum et docebat
clem: Jam autem die festo mediante, ascendit Jesus in templum, et docebat.
tr: ηδη δε της εορτης μεσουσης ανεβη ο ιησους εις το ιερον και εδιδασκεν
kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

vulg: et mirabantur Iudaei dicentes quomodo hic litteras scit cum non didicerit
clem: Et mirabantur Judi, dicentes: Quomodo hic litteras scit, cum non didicerit?
tr: και εθαυμαζον οι ιουδαιοι λεγοντες πως ουτος γραμματα οιδεν μη μεμαθηκως
kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

vulg: respondit eis Iesus et dixit mea doctrina non est mea sed eius qui misit me
clem: Respondit eis Jesus, et dixit: Mea doctrina non est mea, sed ejus qui misit me.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους και ειπεν η εμη διδαχη ουκ εστιν εμη αλλα του πεμψαντος με
kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

vulg: si quis voluerit voluntatem eius facere cognoscet de doctrina utrum ex Deo sit an ego a me ipso loquar
clem: Si quis voluerit voluntatem ejus facere, cognoscet de doctrina, utrum ex Deo sit, an ego a meipso loquar.
tr: εαν τις θελη το θελημα αυτου ποιειν γνωσεται περι της διδαχης ποτερον εκ του θεου εστιν η εγω απ εμαυτου λαλω
kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

vulg: qui a semet ipso loquitur gloriam propriam quaerit qui autem quaerit gloriam eius qui misit illum hic verax est et iniustitia in illo non est
clem: Qui a semetipso loquitur, gloriam propriam qurit; qui autem qurit gloriam ejus qui misit eum, hic verax est, et injustitia in illo non est.
tr: ο αφ εαυτου λαλων την δοξαν την ιδιαν ζητει ο δε ζητων την δοξαν του πεμψαντος αυτον ουτος αληθης εστιν και αδικια εν αυτω ουκ εστιν
kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

vulg: nonne Moses dedit vobis legem et nemo ex vobis facit legem
clem: Nonne Moyses dedit vobis legem: et nemo ex vobis facit legem?
tr: ου μωσης δεδωκεν υμιν τον νομον και ουδεις εξ υμων ποιει τον νομον τι με ζητειτε αποκτειναι
kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

vulg: quid me quaeritis interficere respondit turba et dixit daemonium habes quis te quaerit interficere
clem: Quid me quritis interficere? Respondit turba, et dixit: Dmonium habes: quis te quret interficere?
tr: απεκριθη ο οχλος και ειπεν δαιμονιον εχεις τις σε ζητει αποκτειναι
kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit eis unum opus feci et omnes miramini
clem: Respondit Jesus et dixit eis: Unum opus feci, et omnes miramini:
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις εν εργον εποιησα και παντες θαυμαζετε
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

vulg: propterea Moses dedit vobis circumcisionem non quia ex Mose est sed ex patribus et in sabbato circumciditis hominem
clem: propterea Moyses dedit vobis circumcisionem (non quia ex Moyse est, sed ex patribus), et in sabbato circumciditis hominem.
tr: δια τουτο μωσης δεδωκεν υμιν την περιτομην ουχ οτι εκ του μωσεως εστιν αλλ εκ των πατερων και εν σαββατω περιτεμνετε ανθρωπον
kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

vulg: si circumcisionem accipit homo in sabbato ut non solvatur lex Mosi mihi indignamini quia totum hominem sanum feci in sabbato
clem: Si circumcisionem accipit homo in sabbato, ut non solvatur lex Moysi: mihi indignamini quia totum hominem sanum feci in sabbato?
tr: ει περιτομην λαμβανει ανθρωπος εν σαββατω ινα μη λυθη ο νομος μωσεως εμοι χολατε οτι ολον ανθρωπον υγιη εποιησα εν σαββατω
kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

vulg: nolite iudicare secundum faciem sed iustum iudicium iudicate
clem: Nolite judicare secundum faciem, sed justum judicium judicate.
tr: μη κρινετε κατ οψιν αλλα την δικαιαν κρισιν κρινατε
kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

vulg: dicebant ergo quidam ex Hierosolymis nonne hic est quem quaerunt interficere
clem: Dicebant ergo quidam ex Jerosolymis: Nonne hic est, quem qurunt interficere?
tr: ελεγον ουν τινες εκ των ιεροσολυμιτων ουχ ουτος εστιν ον ζητουσιν αποκτειναι
kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

vulg: et ecce palam loquitur et nihil ei dicunt numquid vere cognoverunt principes quia hic est Christus
clem: et ecce palam loquitur, et nihil ei dicunt. Numquid vere cognoverunt principes quia hic est Christus?
tr: και ιδε παρρησια λαλει και ουδεν αυτω λεγουσιν μηποτε αληθως εγνωσαν οι αρχοντες οτι ουτος εστιν αληθως ο χριστος
kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

vulg: sed hunc scimus unde sit Christus autem cum venerit nemo scit unde sit
clem: Sed hunc scimus unde sit: Christus autem cum venerit, nemo scit unde sit.
tr: αλλα τουτον οιδαμεν ποθεν εστιν ο δε χριστος οταν ερχηται ουδεις γινωσκει ποθεν εστιν
kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

vulg: clamabat ergo docens in templo Iesus et dicens et me scitis et unde sim scitis et a me ipso non veni sed est verus qui misit me quem vos non scitis
clem: Clamabat ergo Jesus in templo docens, et dicens: Et me scitis, et unde sim scitis: et a meipso non veni, sed est verus qui misit me, quem vos nescitis.
tr: εκραξεν ουν εν τω ιερω διδασκων ο ιησους και λεγων καμε οιδατε και οιδατε ποθεν ειμι και απ εμαυτου ουκ εληλυθα αλλ εστιν αληθινος ο πεμψας με ον υμεις ουκ οιδατε
kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

vulg: ego scio eum quia ab ipso sum et ipse me misit
clem: Ego scio eum: quia ab ipso sum, et ipse me misit.
tr: εγω δε οιδα αυτον οτι παρ αυτου ειμι κακεινος με απεστειλεν
kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

vulg: quaerebant ergo eum adprehendere et nemo misit in illum manus quia nondum venerat hora eius
clem: Qurebant ergo eum apprehendere: et nemo misit in illum manus, quia nondum venit hora ejus.
tr: εζητουν ουν αυτον πιασαι και ουδεις επεβαλεν επ αυτον την χειρα οτι ουπω εληλυθει η ωρα αυτου
kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

vulg: de turba autem multi crediderunt in eum et dicebant Christus cum venerit numquid plura signa faciet quam quae hic facit
clem: De turba autem multi crediderunt in eum, et dicebant: Christus cum venerit, numquid plura signa faciet quam qu hic facit?
tr: πολλοι δε εκ του οχλου επιστευσαν εις αυτον και ελεγον οτι ο χριστος οταν ελθη μητι πλειονα σημεια τουτων ποιησει ων ουτος εποιησεν
kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

vulg: audierunt Pharisaei turbam murmurantem de illo haec et miserunt principes et Pharisaei ministros ut adprehenderent eum
clem: Audierunt pharisi turbam murmurantem de illo hc: et miserunt principes et pharisi ministros ut apprehenderent eum.
tr: ηκουσαν οι φαρισαιοι του οχλου γογγυζοντος περι αυτου ταυτα και απεστειλαν οι φαρισαιοι και οι αρχιερεις υπηρετας ινα πιασωσιν αυτον
kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus adhuc modicum tempus vobiscum sum et vado ad eum qui misit me
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Adhuc modicum tempus vobiscum sum: et vado ad eum qui me misit.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους ετι μικρον χρονον μεθ υμων ειμι και υπαγω προς τον πεμψαντα με
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

vulg: quaeretis me et non invenietis et ubi sum ego vos non potestis venire
clem: Quretis me, et non invenietis: et ubi ego sum, vos non potestis venire.
tr: ζητησετε με και ουχ ευρησετε και οπου ειμι εγω υμεις ου δυνασθε ελθειν
kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

vulg: dixerunt ergo Iudaei ad se ipsos quo hic iturus est quia non inveniemus eum numquid in dispersionem gentium iturus est et docturus gentes
clem: Dixerunt ergo Judi ad semetipsos: Quo hic iturus est, quia non inveniemus eum? numquid in dispersionem gentium iturus est, et docturus gentes?
tr: ειπον ουν οι ιουδαιοι προς εαυτους που ουτος μελλει πορευεσθαι οτι ημεις ουχ ευρησομεν αυτον μη εις την διασποραν των ελληνων μελλει πορευεσθαι και διδασκειν τους ελληνας
kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

vulg: quis est hic sermo quem dixit quaeretis me et non invenietis et ubi sum ego non potestis venire
clem: quis est hic sermo, quem dixit: Quretis me, et non invenietis: et ubi sum ego, vos non potestis venire?
tr: τις εστιν ουτος ο λογος ον ειπεν ζητησετε με και ουχ ευρησετε και οπου ειμι εγω υμεις ου δυνασθε ελθειν
kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

vulg: in novissimo autem die magno festivitatis stabat Iesus et clamabat dicens si quis sitit veniat ad me et bibat
clem: In novissimo autem die magno festivitatis stabat Jesus, et clamabat dicens: Si quis sitit, veniat ad me et bibat.
tr: εν δε τη εσχατη ημερα τη μεγαλη της εορτης ειστηκει ο ιησους και εκραξεν λεγων εαν τις διψα ερχεσθω προς με και πινετω
kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

vulg: qui credit in me sicut dixit scriptura flumina de ventre eius fluent aquae vivae
clem: Qui credit in me, sicut dicit Scriptura, flumina de ventre ejus fluent aqu viv.
tr: ο πιστευων εις εμε καθως ειπεν η γραφη ποταμοι εκ της κοιλιας αυτου ρευσουσιν υδατος ζωντος
kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

vulg: hoc autem dixit de Spiritu quem accepturi erant credentes in eum non enim erat Spiritus quia Iesus nondum fuerat glorificatus
clem: Hoc autem dixit de Spiritu, quem accepturi erant credentes in eum: nondum enim erat Spiritus datus, quia Jesus nondum erat glorificatus.
tr: τουτο δε ειπεν περι του πνευματος ου εμελλον λαμβανειν οι πιστευοντες εις αυτον ουπω γαρ ην πνευμα αγιον οτι ο ιησους ουδεπω εδοξασθη
kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

vulg: ex illa ergo turba cum audissent hos sermones eius dicebant hic est vere propheta
clem: Ex illa ergo turba cum audissent hos sermones ejus, dicebant: Hic est vere propheta.
tr: πολλοι ουν εκ του οχλου ακουσαντες τον λογον ελεγον ουτος εστιν αληθως ο προφητης
kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

vulg: alii dicebant hic est Christus quidam autem dicebant numquid a Galilaea Christus venit
clem: Alii dicebant: Hic est Christus. Quidam autem dicebant: Numquid a Galila venit Christus?
tr: αλλοι ελεγον ουτος εστιν ο χριστος αλλοι δε ελεγον μη γαρ εκ της γαλιλαιας ο χριστος ερχεται
kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

vulg: nonne scriptura dicit quia ex semine David et Bethleem castello ubi erat David venit Christus
clem: nonne Scriptura dicit: Quia ex semine David, et de Bethlehem castello, ubi erat David, venit Christus?
tr: ουχι η γραφη ειπεν οτι εκ του σπερματος δαβιδ και απο βηθλεεμ της κωμης οπου ην δαβιδ ο χριστος ερχεται
kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

vulg: dissensio itaque facta est in turba propter eum
clem: Dissensio itaque facta est in turba propter eum.
tr: σχισμα ουν εν τω οχλω εγενετο δι αυτον
kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.

vulg: quidam autem ex ipsis volebant adprehendere eum sed nemo misit super illum manus
clem: Quidam autem ex ipsis volebant apprehendere eum: sed nemo misit super eum manus.
tr: τινες δε ηθελον εξ αυτων πιασαι αυτον αλλ ουδεις επεβαλεν επ αυτον τας χειρας
kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

vulg: venerunt ergo ministri ad pontifices et Pharisaeos et dixerunt eis illi quare non adduxistis eum
clem: Venerunt ergo ministri ad pontifices et pharisos. Et dixerunt eis illi: Quare non adduxistis illum?
tr: ηλθον ουν οι υπηρεται προς τους αρχιερεις και φαρισαιους και ειπον αυτοις εκεινοι δια τι ουκ ηγαγετε αυτον
kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

vulg: responderunt ministri numquam sic locutus est homo sicut hic homo
clem: Responderunt ministri: Numquam sic locutus est homo, sicut hic homo.
tr: απεκριθησαν οι υπηρεται ουδεποτε ουτως ελαλησεν ανθρωπος ως ουτος ο ανθρωπος
kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

vulg: responderunt ergo eis Pharisaei numquid et vos seducti estis
clem: Responderunt ergo eis pharisi: Numquid et vos seducti estis?
tr: απεκριθησαν ουν αυτοις οι φαρισαιοι μη και υμεις πεπλανησθε
kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

vulg: numquid aliquis ex principibus credidit in eum aut ex Pharisaeis
clem: numquid ex principibus aliquis credidit in eum, aut ex pharisis?
tr: μη τις εκ των αρχοντων επιστευσεν εις αυτον η εκ των φαρισαιων
kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

vulg: sed turba haec quae non novit legem maledicti sunt
clem: sed turba hc, qu non novit legem, maledicti sunt.
tr: αλλ ο οχλος ουτος ο μη γινωσκων τον νομον επικαταρατοι εισιν
kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

vulg: dicit Nicodemus ad eos ille qui venit ad eum nocte qui unus erat ex ipsis
clem: Dixit Nicodemus ad eos, ille qui venit ad eum nocte, qui unus erat ex ipsis:
tr: λεγει νικοδημος προς αυτους ο ελθων νυκτος προς αυτον εις ων εξ αυτων
kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

vulg: numquid lex nostra iudicat hominem nisi audierit ab ipso prius et cognoverit quid faciat
clem: Numquid lex nostra judicat hominem, nisi prius audierit ab ipso, et cognoverit quid faciat?
tr: μη ο νομος ημων κρινει τον ανθρωπον εαν μη ακουση παρ αυτου προτερον και γνω τι ποιει
kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

vulg: responderunt et dixerunt ei numquid et tu Galilaeus es scrutare et vide quia propheta a Galilaea non surgit
clem: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei: Numquid et tu Galilus es? scrutare Scripturas, et vide quia a Galila propheta non surgit.
tr: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω μη και συ εκ της γαλιλαιας ει ερευνησον και ιδε οτι προφητης εκ της γαλιλαιας ουκ εγηγερται
kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

vulg: et reversi sunt unusquisque in domum suam
clem: Et reversi sunt unusquisque in domum suam.
tr: και επορευθη εκαστος εις τον οικον αυτου
kjv: And every man went unto his own house.

vulg: Iesus autem perrexit in montem Oliveti
clem: Jesus autem perrexit in montem Oliveti:
tr: ιησους δε επορευθη εις το ορος των ελαιων
kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

vulg: et diluculo iterum venit in templum et omnis populus venit ad eum et sedens docebat eos
clem: et diluculo iterum venit in templum, et omnis populus venit ad eum, et sedens docebat eos.
tr: ορθρου δε παλιν παρεγενετο εις το ιερον και πας ο λαος ηρχετο προς αυτον και καθισας εδιδασκεν αυτους
kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

vulg: adducunt autem scribae et Pharisaei mulierem in adulterio deprehensam et statuerunt eam in medio
clem: Adducunt autem scrib et pharisi mulierem in adulterio deprehensam: et statuerunt eam in medio,
tr: αγουσιν δε οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι προς αυτον γυναικα εν μοιχεια κατειλημμενην και στησαντες αυτην εν μεσω
kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

vulg: et dixerunt ei magister haec mulier modo deprehensa est in adulterio
clem: et dixerunt ei: Magister, hc mulier modo deprehensa est in adulterio.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω διδασκαλε αυτη η γυνη κατειληφθη επαυτοφωρω μοιχευομενη
kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

vulg: in lege autem Moses mandavit nobis huiusmodi lapidare tu ergo quid dicis
clem: In lege autem Moyses mandavit nobis hujusmodi lapidare. Tu ergo quid dicis?
tr: εν δε τω νομω μωσης ημιν ενετειλατο τας τοιαυτας λιθοβολεισθαι συ ουν τι λεγεις
kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

vulg: haec autem dicebant temptantes eum ut possent accusare eum Iesus autem inclinans se deorsum digito scribebat in terra
clem: Hoc autem dicebant tentantes eum, ut possent accusare eum. Jesus autem inclinans se deorsum, digito scribebat in terra.
tr: τουτο δε ελεγον πειραζοντες αυτον ινα εχωσιν κατηγορειν αυτου ο δε ιησους κατω κυψας τω δακτυλω εγραφεν εις την γην  μη προσποιουμενος
kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

vulg: cum autem perseverarent interrogantes eum erexit se et dixit eis qui sine peccato est vestrum primus in illam lapidem mittat
clem: Cum ergo perseverarent interrogantes eum, erexit se, et dixit eis: Qui sine peccato est vestrum, primus in illam lapidem mittat.
tr: ως δε επεμενον ερωτωντες αυτον ανακυψας ειπεν προς αυτους ο αναμαρτητος υμων πρωτος τον λιθον επ αυτη βαλετω
kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

vulg: et iterum se inclinans scribebat in terra
clem: Et iterum se inclinans, scribebat in terra.
tr: και παλιν κατω κυψας εγραφεν εις την γην
kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

vulg: audientes autem unus post unum exiebant incipientes a senioribus et remansit solus et mulier in medio stans
clem: Audientes autem unus post unum exibant, incipientes a senioribus: et remansit solus Jesus, et mulier in medio stans.
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες και υπο της συνειδησεως ελεγχομενοι εξηρχοντο εις καθ εις αρξαμενοι απο των πρεσβυτερων εως των εσχατων και κατελειφθη μονος ο ιησους και η γυνη εν μεσω εστωσα
kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

vulg: erigens autem se Iesus dixit ei mulier ubi sunt nemo te condemnavit
clem: Erigens autem se Jesus, dixit ei: Mulier, ubi sunt qui te accusabant? nemo te condemnavit?
tr: ανακυψας δε ο ιησους και μηδενα θεασαμενος πλην της γυναικος ειπεν αυτη η γυνη που εισιν εκεινοι οι κατηγοροι σου ουδεις σε κατεκρινεν
kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

vulg: quae dixit nemo Domine dixit autem Iesus nec ego te condemnabo vade et amplius iam noli peccare
clem: Qu dixit: Nemo, Domine. Dixit autem Jesus: Nec ego te condemnabo: vade, et jam amplius noli peccare.
tr: η δε ειπεν ουδεις κυριε ειπεν δε αυτη ο ιησους ουδε εγω σε κατακρινω πορευου και μηκετι αμαρτανε
kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

vulg: iterum ergo locutus est eis Iesus dicens ego sum lux mundi qui sequitur me non ambulabit in tenebris sed habebit lucem vitae
clem: Iterum ergo locutus est eis Jesus, dicens: Ego sum lux mundi: qui sequitur me, non ambulat in tenebris, sed habebit lumen vit.
tr: παλιν ουν ο ιησους αυτοις ελαλησεν λεγων εγω ειμι το φως του κοσμου ο ακολουθων εμοι ου μη περιπατησει εν τη σκοτια αλλ εξει το φως της ζωης
kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ei Pharisaei tu de te ipso testimonium perhibes testimonium tuum non est verum
clem: Dixerunt ergo ei pharisi: Tu de teipso testimonium perhibes; testimonium tuum non est verum.
tr: ειπον ουν αυτω οι φαρισαιοι συ περι σεαυτου μαρτυρεις η μαρτυρια σου ουκ εστιν αληθης
kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit eis et si ego testimonium perhibeo de me ipso verum est testimonium meum quia scio unde veni et quo vado vos autem nescitis unde venio aut quo vado
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis: Et si ego testimonium perhibeo de meipso, verum est testimonium meum: quia scio unde veni et quo vado; vos autem nescitis unde venio aut quo vado.
tr: απεκριθη ιησους και ειπεν αυτοις καν εγω μαρτυρω περι εμαυτου αληθης εστιν η μαρτυρια μου οτι οιδα ποθεν ηλθον και που υπαγω υμεις δε ουκ οιδατε ποθεν ερχομαι και που υπαγω
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

vulg: vos secundum carnem iudicatis ego non iudico quemquam
clem: Vos secundum carnem judicatis: ego non judico quemquam;
tr: υμεις κατα την σαρκα κρινετε εγω ου κρινω ουδενα
kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

vulg: et si iudico ego iudicium meum verum est quia solus non sum sed ego et qui me misit Pater
clem: et si judico ego, judicium meum verum est, quia solus non sum: sed ego et qui misit me, Pater.
tr: και εαν κρινω δε εγω η κρισις η εμη αληθης εστιν οτι μονος ουκ ειμι αλλ εγω και ο πεμψας με πατηρ
kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

vulg: et in lege vestra scriptum est quia duorum hominum testimonium verum est
clem: Et in lege vestra scriptum est, quia duorum hominum testimonium verum est.
tr: και εν τω νομω δε τω υμετερω γεγραπται οτι δυο ανθρωπων η μαρτυρια αληθης εστιν
kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

vulg: ego sum qui testimonium perhibeo de me ipso et testimonium perhibet de me qui misit me Pater
clem: Ego sum qui testimonium perhibeo de meipso, et testimonium perhibet de me qui misit me, Pater.
tr: εγω ειμι ο μαρτυρων περι εμαυτου και μαρτυρει περι εμου ο πεμψας με πατηρ
kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

vulg: dicebant ergo ei ubi est Pater tuus respondit Iesus neque me scitis neque Patrem meum si me sciretis forsitan et Patrem meum sciretis
clem: Dicebant ergo ei: Ubi est Pater tuus? Respondit Jesus: Neque me scitis, neque Patrem meum: si me sciretis, forsitan et Patrem meum sciretis.
tr: ελεγον ουν αυτω που εστιν ο πατηρ σου απεκριθη ο ιησους ουτε εμε οιδατε ουτε τον πατερα μου ει εμε ηδειτε και τον πατερα μου ηδειτε αν
kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

vulg: haec verba locutus est in gazofilacio docens in templo et nemo adprehendit eum quia necdum venerat hora eius
clem: Hc verba locutus est Jesus in gazophylacio, docens in templo: et nemo apprehendit eum, quia necdum venerat hora ejus.
tr: ταυτα τα ρηματα ελαλησεν ο ιησους εν τω γαζοφυλακιω διδασκων εν τω ιερω και ουδεις επιασεν αυτον οτι ουπω εληλυθει η ωρα αυτου
kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

vulg: dixit ergo iterum eis Iesus ego vado et quaeretis me et in peccato vestro moriemini quo ego vado vos non potestis venire
clem: Dixit ergo iterum eis Jesus: Ego vado, et quretis me, et in peccato vestro moriemini. Quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire.
tr: ειπεν ουν παλιν αυτοις ο ιησους εγω υπαγω και ζητησετε με και εν τη αμαρτια υμων αποθανεισθε οπου εγω υπαγω υμεις ου δυνασθε ελθειν
kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

vulg: dicebant ergo Iudaei numquid interficiet semet ipsum quia dicit quo ego vado vos non potestis venire
clem: Dicebant ergo Judi: Numquid interficiet semetipsum, quia dixit: Quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire?
tr: ελεγον ουν οι ιουδαιοι μητι αποκτενει εαυτον οτι λεγει οπου εγω υπαγω υμεις ου δυνασθε ελθειν
kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

vulg: et dicebat eis vos de deorsum estis ego de supernis sum vos de mundo hoc estis ego non sum de hoc mundo
clem: Et dicebat eis: Vos de deorsum estis, ego de supernis sum. Vos de mundo hoc estis, ego non sum de hoc mundo.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις υμεις εκ των κατω εστε εγω εκ των ανω ειμι υμεις εκ του κοσμου τουτου εστε εγω ουκ ειμι εκ του κοσμου τουτου
kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

vulg: dixi ergo vobis quia moriemini in peccatis vestris si enim non credideritis quia ego sum moriemini in peccato vestro
clem: Dixi ergo vobis quia moriemini in peccatis vestris: si enim non credideritis quia ego sum, moriemini in peccato vestro.
tr: ειπον ουν υμιν οτι αποθανεισθε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων εαν γαρ μη πιστευσητε οτι εγω ειμι αποθανεισθε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων
kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

vulg: dicebant ergo ei tu quis es dixit eis Iesus principium quia et loquor vobis
clem: Dicebant ergo ei: Tu quis es? Dixit eis Jesus: Principium, qui et loquor vobis.
tr: ελεγον ουν αυτω συ τις ει και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους την αρχην ο τι και λαλω υμιν
kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

vulg: multa habeo de vobis loqui et iudicare sed qui misit me verax est et ego quae audivi ab eo haec loquor in mundo
clem: Multa habeo de vobis loqui, et judicare; sed qui me misit, verax est; et ego qu audivi ab eo, hc loquor in mundo.
tr: πολλα εχω περι υμων λαλειν και κρινειν αλλ ο πεμψας με αληθης εστιν καγω α ηκουσα παρ αυτου ταυτα λεγω εις τον κοσμον
kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

vulg: et non cognoverunt quia Patrem eis dicebat
clem: Et non cognoverunt quia Patrem ejus dicebat Deum.
tr: ουκ εγνωσαν οτι τον πατερα αυτοις ελεγεν
kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

vulg: dixit ergo eis Iesus cum exaltaveritis Filium hominis tunc cognoscetis quia ego sum et a me ipso facio nihil sed sicut docuit me Pater haec loquor
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Cum exaltaveris Filium hominis, tunc cognoscetis quia ego sum, et a meipso facio nihil, sed sicut docuit me Pater, hc loquor:
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους οταν υψωσητε τον υιον του ανθρωπου τοτε γνωσεσθε οτι εγω ειμι και απ εμαυτου ποιω ουδεν αλλα καθως εδιδαξεν με ο πατηρ μου ταυτα λαλω
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

vulg: et qui me misit mecum est non reliquit me solum quia ego quae placita sunt ei facio semper
clem: et qui me misit, mecum est, et non reliquit me solum: quia ego qu placita sunt ei, facio semper.
tr: και ο πεμψας με μετ εμου εστιν ουκ αφηκεν με μονον ο πατηρ οτι εγω τα αρεστα αυτω ποιω παντοτε
kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

vulg: haec illo loquente multi crediderunt in eum
clem: Hc illo loquente, multi crediderunt in eum.
tr: ταυτα αυτου λαλουντος πολλοι επιστευσαν εις αυτον
kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

vulg: dicebat ergo Iesus ad eos qui crediderunt ei Iudaeos si vos manseritis in sermone meo vere discipuli mei eritis
clem: Dicebat ergo Jesus ad eos, qui crediderunt ei, Judos: Si vos manseritis in sermone meo, vere discipuli mei eritis,
tr: ελεγεν ουν ο ιησους προς τους πεπιστευκοτας αυτω ιουδαιους εαν υμεις μεινητε εν τω λογω τω εμω αληθως μαθηται μου εστε
kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

vulg: et cognoscetis veritatem et veritas liberabit vos
clem: et cognoscetis veritatem, et veritas liberabit vos.
tr: και γνωσεσθε την αληθειαν και η αληθεια ελευθερωσει υμας
kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

vulg: responderunt ei semen Abrahae sumus et nemini servivimus umquam quomodo tu dicis liberi eritis
clem: Responderunt ei: Semen Abrah sumus, et nemini servivimus umquam: quomodo tu dicis: Liberi eritis?
tr: απεκριθησαν αυτω σπερμα αβρααμ εσμεν και ουδενι δεδουλευκαμεν πωποτε πως συ λεγεις οτι ελευθεροι γενησεσθε
kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

vulg: respondit eis Iesus amen amen dico vobis quia omnis qui facit peccatum servus est peccati
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis: quia omnis qui facit peccatum, servus est peccati.
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι πας ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν δουλος εστιν της αμαρτιας
kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

vulg: servus autem non manet in domo in aeternum filius manet in aeternum
clem: Servus autem non manet in domo in ternum: filius autem manet in ternum.
tr: ο δε δουλος ου μενει εν τη οικια εις τον αιωνα ο υιος μενει εις τον αιωνα
kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

vulg: si ergo Filius vos liberaverit vere liberi eritis
clem: Si ergo vos filius liberaverit, vere liberi eritis.
tr: εαν ουν ο υιος υμας ελευθερωση οντως ελευθεροι εσεσθε
kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

vulg: scio quia filii Abrahae estis sed quaeritis me interficere quia sermo meus non capit in vobis
clem: Scio quia filii Abrah estis: sed quritis me interficere, quia sermo meus non capit in vobis.
tr: οιδα οτι σπερμα αβρααμ εστε αλλα ζητειτε με αποκτειναι οτι ο λογος ο εμος ου χωρει εν υμιν
kjv: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

vulg: ego quod vidi apud Patrem loquor et vos quae vidistis apud patrem vestrum facitis
clem: Ego quod vidi apud Patrem meum, loquor: et vos qu vidistis apud patrem vestrum, facitis.
tr: εγω ο εωρακα παρα τω πατρι μου λαλω και υμεις ουν ο εωρακατε παρα τω πατρι υμων ποιειτε
kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

vulg: responderunt et dixerunt ei pater noster Abraham est dicit eis Iesus si filii Abrahae estis opera Abrahae facite
clem: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei: Pater noster Abraham est. Dicit eis Jesus: Si filii Abrah estis, opera Abrah facite.
tr: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω ο πατηρ ημων αβρααμ εστιν λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους ει τεκνα του αβρααμ ητε τα εργα του αβρααμ εποιειτε αν
kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

vulg: nunc autem quaeritis me interficere hominem qui veritatem vobis locutus sum quam audivi a Deo hoc Abraham non fecit
clem: Nunc autem quritis me interficere, hominem, qui veritatem vobis locutus sum, quam audivi a Deo: hoc Abraham non fecit.
tr: νυν δε ζητειτε με αποκτειναι ανθρωπον ος την αληθειαν υμιν λελαληκα ην ηκουσα παρα του θεου τουτο αβρααμ ουκ εποιησεν
kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

vulg: vos facitis opera patris vestri dixerunt itaque ei nos ex fornicatione non sumus nati unum patrem habemus Deum
clem: Vos facitis opera patris vestri. Dixerunt itaque ei: Nos ex fornicatione non sumus nati: unum patrem habemus Deum.
tr: υμεις ποιειτε τα εργα του πατρος υμων ειπον ουν αυτω ημεις εκ πορνειας ου γεγεννημεθα ενα πατερα εχομεν τον θεον
kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

vulg: dixit ergo eis Iesus si Deus pater vester esset diligeretis utique me ego enim ex Deo processi et veni neque enim a me ipso veni sed ille me misit
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Si Deus pater vester esset, diligeretis utique et me; ego enim ex Deo processi, et veni: neque enim a meipso veni, sed ille me misit.
tr: ειπεν ουν   αυτοις ο ιησους ει ο θεος πατηρ υμων ην ηγαπατε αν εμε εγω γαρ εκ του θεου εξηλθον και ηκω ουδε γαρ απ εμαυτου εληλυθα αλλ εκεινος με απεστειλεν
kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

vulg: quare loquellam meam non cognoscitis quia non potestis audire sermonem meum
clem: Quare loquelam meam non cognoscitis? Quia non potestis audire sermonem meum.
tr: δια τι την λαλιαν την εμην ου γινωσκετε οτι ου δυνασθε ακουειν τον λογον τον εμον
kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

vulg: vos ex patre diabolo estis et desideria patris vestri vultis facere ille homicida erat ab initio et in veritate non stetit quia non est veritas in eo cum loquitur mendacium ex propriis loquitur quia mendax est et pater eius
clem: Vos ex patre diabolo estis: et desideria patris vestri vultis facere. Ille homicida erat ab initio, et in veritate non stetit: quia non est veritas in eo: cum loquitur mendacium, ex propriis loquitur, quia mendax est, et pater ejus.
tr: υμεις εκ πατρος του διαβολου εστε και τας επιθυμιας του πατρος υμων θελετε ποιειν εκεινος ανθρωποκτονος ην απ αρχης και εν τη αληθεια ουχ εστηκεν οτι ουκ εστιν αληθεια εν αυτω οταν λαλη το ψευδος εκ των ιδιων λαλει οτι ψευστης εστιν και ο πατηρ αυτου
kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

vulg: ego autem quia veritatem dico non creditis mihi
clem: Ego autem si veritatem dico, non creditis mihi.
tr: εγω δε οτι την αληθειαν λεγω ου πιστευετε μοι
kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

vulg: quis ex vobis arguit me de peccato si veritatem dico quare vos non creditis mihi
clem: Quis ex vobis arguet me de peccato? si veritatem dico vobis, quare non creditis mihi?
tr: τις εξ υμων ελεγχει με περι αμαρτιας ει δε αληθειαν λεγω δια τι υμεις ου πιστευετε μοι
kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

vulg: qui est ex Deo verba Dei audit propterea vos non auditis quia ex Deo non estis
clem: Qui ex Deo est, verba Dei audit. Propterea vos non auditis, quia ex Deo non estis.
tr: ο ων εκ του θεου τα ρηματα του θεου ακουει δια τουτο υμεις ουκ ακουετε οτι εκ του θεου ουκ εστε
kjv: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

vulg: responderunt igitur Iudaei et dixerunt ei nonne bene dicimus nos quia Samaritanus es tu et daemonium habes
clem: Responderunt ergo Judi, et dixerunt ei: Nonne bene dicimus nos quia Samaritanus es tu, et dmonium habes?
tr: απεκριθησαν ουν οι ιουδαιοι και ειπον αυτω ου καλως λεγομεν ημεις οτι σαμαρειτης ει συ και δαιμονιον εχεις
kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

vulg: respondit Iesus ego daemonium non habeo sed honorifico Patrem meum et vos inhonoratis me
clem: Respondit Jesus: Ego dmonium non habeo: sed honorifico Patrem meum, et vos inhonorastis me.
tr: απεκριθη ιησους εγω δαιμονιον ουκ εχω αλλα τιμω τον πατερα μου και υμεις ατιμαζετε με
kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

vulg: ego autem non quaero gloriam meam est qui quaerit et iudicat
clem: Ego autem non quro gloriam meam: est qui qurat, et judicet.
tr: εγω δε ου ζητω την δοξαν μου εστιν ο ζητων και κρινων
kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis si quis sermonem meum servaverit mortem non videbit in aeternum
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: si quis sermonem meum servaverit, mortem non videbit in ternum.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν εαν τις τον λογον τον εμον τηρηση θανατον ου μη θεωρηση εις τον αιωνα
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
