vulg: dixerunt ergo Iudaei nunc cognovimus quia daemonium habes Abraham mortuus est et prophetae et tu dicis si quis sermonem meum servaverit non gustabit mortem in aeternum
clem: Dixerunt ergo Judi: Nunc cognovimus quia dmonium habes. Abraham mortuus est, et prophet; et tu dicis: Si quis sermonem meum servaverit, non gustabit mortem in ternum.
tr: ειπον ουν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι νυν εγνωκαμεν οτι δαιμονιον εχεις αβρααμ απεθανεν και οι προφηται και συ λεγεις εαν τις τον λογον μου τηρηση ου μη γευσεται θανατου εις τον αιωνα
kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

vulg: numquid tu maior es patre nostro Abraham qui mortuus est et prophetae mortui sunt quem te ipsum facis
clem: Numquid tu major es patre nostro Abraham, qui mortuus est? et prophet mortui sunt. Quem teipsum facis?
tr: μη συ μειζων ει του πατρος ημων αβρααμ οστις απεθανεν και οι προφηται απεθανον τινα σεαυτον συ ποιεις
kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

vulg: respondit Iesus si ego glorifico me ipsum gloria mea nihil est est Pater meus qui glorificat me quem vos dicitis quia Deus noster est
clem: Respondit Jesus: Si ego glorifico meipsum, gloria mea nihil est: est Pater meus, qui glorificat me, quem vos dicitis quia Deus vester est,
tr: απεκριθη ιησους εαν εγω δοξαζω εμαυτον η δοξα μου ουδεν εστιν εστιν ο πατηρ μου ο δοξαζων με ον υμεις λεγετε οτι θεος υμων εστιν
kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

vulg: et non cognovistis eum ego autem novi eum et si dixero quia non scio eum ero similis vobis mendax sed scio eum et sermonem eius servo
clem: et non cognovistis eum: ego autem novi eum. Et si dixero quia non scio eum, ero similis vobis, mendax. Sed scio eum, et sermonem ejus servo.
tr: και ουκ εγνωκατε αυτον εγω δε οιδα αυτον και εαν ειπω οτι ουκ οιδα αυτον εσομαι ομοιος υμων ψευστης αλλ οιδα αυτον και τον λογον αυτου τηρω
kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

vulg: Abraham pater vester exultavit ut videret diem meum et vidit et gavisus est
clem: Abraham pater vester exsultavit ut videret diem meum: vidit, et gavisus est.
tr: αβρααμ ο πατηρ υμων ηγαλλιασατο ινα ιδη την ημεραν την εμην και ειδεν και εχαρη
kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

vulg: dixerunt ergo Iudaei ad eum quinquaginta annos nondum habes et Abraham vidisti
clem: Dixerunt ergo Judi ad eum: Quinquaginta annos nondum habes, et Abraham vidisti?
tr: ειπον ουν οι ιουδαιοι προς αυτον πεντηκοντα ετη ουπω εχεις και αβρααμ εωρακας
kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

vulg: dixit eis Iesus amen amen dico vobis antequam Abraham fieret ego sum
clem: Dixit eis Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis, antequam Abraham fieret, ego sum.
tr: ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν πριν αβρααμ γενεσθαι εγω ειμι
kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

vulg: tulerunt ergo lapides ut iacerent in eum Iesus autem abscondit se et exivit de templo
clem: Tulerunt ergo lapides, ut jacerent in eum: Jesus autem abscondit se, et exivit de templo.
tr: ηραν ουν λιθους ινα βαλωσιν επ αυτον ιησους δε εκρυβη και εξηλθεν εκ του ιερου διελθων δια μεσου αυτων και παρηγεν ουτως
kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

vulg: et praeteriens vidit hominem caecum a nativitate
clem: Et prteriens Jesus vidit hominem ccum a nativitate:
tr: και παραγων ειδεν ανθρωπον τυφλον εκ γενετης
kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

vulg: et interrogaverunt eum discipuli sui rabbi quis peccavit hic aut parentes eius ut caecus nasceretur
clem: et interrogaverunt eum discipuli ejus: Rabbi, quis peccavit, hic, aut parentes ejus, ut ccus nasceretur?
tr: και ηρωτησαν αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες ραββι τις ημαρτεν ουτος η οι γονεις αυτου ινα τυφλος γεννηθη
kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

vulg: respondit Iesus neque hic peccavit neque parentes eius sed ut manifestetur opera Dei in illo
clem: Respondit Jesus: Neque hic peccavit, neque parentes ejus: sed ut manifestentur opera Dei in illo.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους ουτε ουτος ημαρτεν ουτε οι γονεις αυτου αλλ ινα φανερωθη τα εργα του θεου εν αυτω
kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

vulg: me oportet operari opera eius qui misit me donec dies est venit nox quando nemo potest operari
clem: Me oportet operari opera ejus qui misit me, donec dies est: venit nox, quando nemo potest operari:
tr: εμε δει εργαζεσθαι τα εργα του πεμψαντος με εως ημερα εστιν ερχεται νυξ οτε ουδεις δυναται εργαζεσθαι
kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

vulg: quamdiu in mundo sum lux sum mundi
clem: quamdiu sum in mundo, lux sum mundi.
tr: οταν εν τω κοσμω ω φως ειμι του κοσμου
kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

vulg: haec cum dixisset expuit in terram et fecit lutum ex sputo et linuit lutum super oculos eius
clem: Hc cum dixisset, exspuit in terram, et fecit lutum ex sputo, et linivit lutum super oculos ejus,
tr: ταυτα ειπων επτυσεν χαμαι και εποιησεν πηλον εκ του πτυσματος και επεχρισεν τον πηλον επι τους οφθαλμους του τυφλου
kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

vulg: et dixit ei vade lava in natatoria Siloae quod interpretatur Missus abiit ergo et lavit et venit videns
clem: et dixit ei: Vade, lava in natatoria Silo (quod interpretatur Missus). Abiit ergo, et lavit, et venit videns.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω υπαγε νιψαι εις την κολυμβηθραν του σιλωαμ ο ερμηνευεται απεσταλμενος απηλθεν ουν και ενιψατο και ηλθεν βλεπων
kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

vulg: itaque vicini et qui videbant eum prius quia mendicus erat dicebant nonne hic est qui sedebat et mendicabat alii dicebant quia hic est
clem: Itaque vicini, et qui viderant eum prius quia mendicus erat, dicebant: Nonne hic est qui sedebat, et mendicabat? Alii dicebant: Quia hic est.
tr: οι ουν γειτονες και οι θεωρουντες αυτον το προτερον οτι τυφλος ην ελεγον ουχ ουτος εστιν ο καθημενος και προσαιτων
kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

vulg: alii autem nequaquam sed similis est eius ille dicebat quia ego sum
clem: Alii autem: Nequaquam, sed similis est ei. Ille vero dicebat: Quia ego sum.
tr: αλλοι ελεγον οτι ουτος εστιν αλλοι δε οτι ομοιος αυτω εστιν εκεινος ελεγεν οτι εγω ειμι
kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

vulg: dicebant ergo ei quomodo aperti sunt oculi tibi
clem: Dicebant ergo ei: Quomodo aperti sunt tibi oculi?
tr: ελεγον ουν αυτω πως ανεωχθησαν σου οι οφθαλμοι
kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

vulg: respondit ille homo qui dicitur Iesus lutum fecit et unxit oculos meos et dixit mihi vade ad natatoriam Siloae et lava et abii et lavi et vidi
clem: Respondit: Ille homo qui dicitur Jesus, lutum fecit: et unxit oculos meos, et dixit mihi: Vade ad natatoria Silo, et lava. Et abii, et lavi, et video.
tr: απεκριθη εκεινος και ειπεν ανθρωπος λεγομενος ιησους πηλον εποιησεν και επεχρισεν μου τους οφθαλμους και ειπεν μοι υπαγε εις την κολυμβηθραν του σιλωαμ και νιψαι απελθων δε και νιψαμενος ανεβλεψα
kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

vulg: dixerunt ei ubi est ille ait nescio
clem: Et dixerunt ei: Ubi est ille? Ait: Nescio.
tr: ειπον ουν αυτω που εστιν εκεινος λεγει ουκ οιδα
kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

vulg: adducunt eum ad Pharisaeos qui caecus fuerat
clem: Adducunt eum ad pharisos, qui ccus fuerat.
tr: αγουσιν αυτον προς τους φαρισαιους τον ποτε τυφλον
kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

vulg: erat autem sabbatum quando lutum fecit Iesus et aperuit oculos eius
clem: Erat autem sabbatum quando lutum fecit Jesus, et aperuit oculos ejus.
tr: ην δε σαββατον οτε τον πηλον εποιησεν ο ιησους και ανεωξεν αυτου τους οφθαλμους
kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

vulg: iterum ergo interrogabant eum Pharisaei quomodo vidisset ille autem dixit eis lutum posuit mihi super oculos et lavi et video
clem: Iterum ergo interrogabant eum pharisi quomodo vidisset. Ille autem dixit eis: Lutum mihi posuit super oculos, et lavi, et video.
tr: παλιν ουν ηρωτων αυτον και οι φαρισαιοι πως ανεβλεψεν ο δε ειπεν αυτοις πηλον επεθηκεν επι τους οφθαλμους μου και ενιψαμην και βλεπω
kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

vulg: dicebant ergo ex Pharisaeis quidam non est hic homo a Deo quia sabbatum non custodit alii dicebant quomodo potest homo peccator haec signa facere et scisma erat in eis
clem: Dicebant ergo ex pharisis quidam: Non est hic homo a Deo, qui sabbatum non custodit. Alii autem dicebant: Quomodo potest homo peccator hc signa facere? Et schisma erat inter eos.
tr: ελεγον ουν εκ των φαρισαιων τινες ουτος ο ανθρωπος ουκ εστιν παρα του θεου οτι το σαββατον ου τηρει αλλοι ελεγον πως δυναται ανθρωπος αμαρτωλος τοιαυτα σημεια ποιειν και σχισμα ην εν αυτοις
kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

vulg: dicunt ergo caeco iterum tu quid dicis de eo qui aperuit oculos tuos ille autem dixit quia propheta est
clem: Dicunt ergo cco iterum: Tu quid dicis de illo qui aperuit oculos tuos? Ille autem dixit: Quia propheta est.
tr: λεγουσιν τω τυφλω παλιν συ τι λεγεις περι αυτου οτι ηνοιξεν σου τους οφθαλμους ο δε ειπεν οτι προφητης εστιν
kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

vulg: non crediderunt ergo Iudaei de illo quia caecus fuisset et vidisset donec vocaverunt parentes eius qui viderat
clem: Non crediderunt ergo Judi de illo, quia ccus fuisset et vidisset, donec vocaverunt parentes ejus, qui viderat:
tr: ουκ επιστευσαν ουν οι ιουδαιοι περι αυτου οτι τυφλος ην και ανεβλεψεν εως οτου εφωνησαν τους γονεις αυτου του αναβλεψαντος
kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

vulg: et interrogaverunt eos dicentes hic est filius vester quem vos dicitis quia caecus natus est quomodo ergo nunc videt
clem: et interrogaverunt eos, dicentes: Hic est filius vester, quem vos dicitis quia ccus natus est? quomodo ergo nunc videt?
tr: και ηρωτησαν αυτους λεγοντες ουτος εστιν ο υιος υμων ον υμεις λεγετε οτι τυφλος εγεννηθη πως ουν αρτι βλεπει
kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

vulg: responderunt eis parentes eius et dixerunt scimus quia hic est filius noster et quia caecus natus est
clem: Responderunt eis parentes ejus, et dixerunt: Scimus quia hic est filius noster, et quia ccus natus est:
tr: απεκριθησαν αυτοις οι γονεις αυτου και ειπον οιδαμεν οτι ουτος εστιν ο υιος ημων και οτι τυφλος εγεννηθη
kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

vulg: quomodo autem nunc videat nescimus aut quis eius aperuit oculos nos nescimus ipsum interrogate aetatem habet ipse de se loquatur
clem: quomodo autem nunc videat, nescimus: aut quis ejus aperuit oculos, nos nescimus; ipsum interrogate: tatem habet, ipse de se loquatur.
tr: πως δε νυν βλεπει ουκ οιδαμεν η τις ηνοιξεν αυτου τους οφθαλμους ημεις ουκ οιδαμεν αυτος ηλικιαν εχει αυτον ερωτησατε αυτος περι αυτου 848  αυτου 846  {P-GSM} λαλησει
kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

vulg: haec dixerunt parentes eius quia timebant Iudaeos iam enim conspiraverant Iudaei ut si quis eum confiteretur Christum extra synagogam fieret
clem: Hc dixerunt parentes ejus, quoniam timebant Judos: jam enim conspiraverunt Judi, ut si quis eum confiteretur esse Christum, extra synagogam fieret.
tr: ταυτα ειπον οι γονεις αυτου οτι εφοβουντο τους ιουδαιους ηδη γαρ συνετεθειντο οι ιουδαιοι ινα εαν τις αυτον ομολογηση χριστον αποσυναγωγος γενηται
kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

vulg: propterea parentes eius dixerunt quia aetatem habet ipsum interrogate
clem: Propterea parentes ejus dixerunt: Quia tatem habet, ipsum interrogate.
tr: δια τουτο οι γονεις αυτου ειπον οτι ηλικιαν εχει αυτον ερωτησατε
kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

vulg: vocaverunt ergo rursum hominem qui fuerat caecus et dixerunt ei da gloriam Deo nos scimus quia hic homo peccator est
clem: Vocaverunt ergo rursum hominem qui fuerat ccus, et dixerunt ei: Da gloriam Deo: nos scimus quia hic homo peccator est.
tr: εφωνησαν ουν εκ δευτερου τον ανθρωπον ος ην τυφλος και ειπον αυτω δος δοξαν τω θεω ημεις οιδαμεν οτι ο ανθρωπος ουτος αμαρτωλος εστιν
kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

vulg: dixit ergo ille si peccator est nescio unum scio quia caecus cum essem modo video
clem: Dixit ergo eis ille: si peccator est, nescio; unum scio, quia ccus cum essem, modo video.
tr: απεκριθη ουν εκεινος και ειπεν ει αμαρτωλος εστιν ουκ οιδα εν οιδα οτι τυφλος ων αρτι βλεπω
kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

vulg: dixerunt ergo illi quid fecit tibi quomodo aperuit tibi oculos
clem: Dixerunt ergo illi: Quid fecit tibi? quomodo aperuit tibi oculos?
tr: ειπον δε αυτω παλιν τι εποιησεν σοι πως ηνοιξεν σου τους οφθαλμους
kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

vulg: respondit eis dixi vobis iam et audistis quid iterum vultis audire numquid et vos vultis discipuli eius fieri
clem: Respondit eis: Dixi vobis jam, et audistis: quod iterum vultis audire? numquid et vos vultis discipuli ejus fieri?
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ειπον υμιν ηδη και ουκ ηκουσατε τι παλιν θελετε ακουειν μη και υμεις θελετε αυτου μαθηται γενεσθαι
kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

vulg: maledixerunt ei et dixerunt tu discipulus illius es nos autem Mosi discipuli sumus
clem: Maledixerunt ergo ei, et dixerunt: Tu discipulus illius sis: nos autem Moysi discipuli sumus.
tr: ελοιδορησαν ουν αυτον και ειπον συ ει μαθητης εκεινου ημεις δε του μωσεως εσμεν μαθηται
kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

vulg: nos scimus quia Mosi locutus est Deus hunc autem nescimus unde sit
clem: Nos scimus quia Moysi locutus est Deus; hunc autem nescimus unde sit.
tr: ημεις οιδαμεν οτι μωση λελαληκεν ο θεος τουτον δε ουκ οιδαμεν ποθεν εστιν
kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

vulg: respondit ille homo et dixit eis in hoc enim mirabile est quia vos nescitis unde sit et aperuit meos oculos
clem: Respondit ille homo, et dixit eis: In hoc enim mirabile est quia vos nescitis unde sit, et aperuit meos oculos:
tr: απεκριθη ο ανθρωπος και ειπεν αυτοις εν γαρ τουτω θαυμαστον εστιν οτι υμεις ουκ οιδατε ποθεν εστιν και ανεωξεν μου τους οφθαλμους
kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

vulg: scimus autem quia peccatores Deus non audit sed si quis Dei cultor est et voluntatem eius facit hunc exaudit
clem: scimus autem quia peccatores Deus non audit: sed si quis Dei cultor est, et voluntatem ejus facit, hunc exaudit.
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι αμαρτωλων ο θεος ουκ ακουει αλλ εαν τις θεοσεβης η και το θελημα αυτου ποιη τουτου ακουει
kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

vulg: a saeculo non est auditum quia aperuit quis oculos caeci nati
clem: A sculo non est auditum quia quis aperuit oculos cci nati.
tr: εκ του αιωνος ουκ ηκουσθη οτι ηνοιξεν τις οφθαλμους τυφλου γεγεννημενου
kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

vulg: nisi esset hic a Deo non poterat facere quicquam
clem: Nisi esset hic a Deo, non poterat facere quidquam.
tr: ει μη ην ουτος παρα θεου ουκ ηδυνατο ποιειν ουδεν
kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

vulg: responderunt et dixerunt ei in peccatis natus es totus et tu doces nos et eiecerunt eum foras
clem: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei: In peccatis natus es totus, et tu doces nos? Et ejecerunt eum foras.
tr: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω εν αμαρτιαις συ εγεννηθης ολος και συ διδασκεις ημας και εξεβαλον αυτον εξω
kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

vulg: audivit Iesus quia eiecerunt eum foras et cum invenisset eum dixit ei tu credis in Filium Dei
clem: Audivit Jesus quia ejecerunt eum foras: et cum invenisset eum, dixit ei: Tu credis in Filium Dei?
tr: ηκουσεν ο ιησους οτι εξεβαλον αυτον εξω και ευρων αυτον ειπεν αυτω συ πιστευεις εις τον υιον του θεου
kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

vulg: respondit ille et dixit quis est Domine ut credam in eum
clem: Respondit ille, et dixit: Quis est, Domine, ut credam in eum?
tr: απεκριθη εκεινος και ειπεν τις εστιν κυριε ινα πιστευσω εις αυτον
kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

vulg: et dixit ei Iesus et vidisti eum et qui loquitur tecum ipse est
clem: Et dixit ei Jesus: Et vidisti eum, et qui loquitur tecum, ipse est.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ο ιησους και εωρακας αυτον και ο λαλων μετα σου εκεινος εστιν
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

vulg: at ille ait credo Domine et procidens adoravit eum
clem: At ille ait: Credo, Domine. Et procidens adoravit eum.
tr: ο δε εφη πιστευω κυριε και προσεκυνησεν αυτω
kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

vulg: dixit ei Iesus in iudicium ego in hunc mundum veni ut qui non vident videant et qui vident caeci fiant
clem: Et dixit Jesus: In judicium ego in hunc mundum veni: ut qui non vident videant, et qui vident cci fiant.
tr: και ειπεν ο ιησους εις κριμα εγω εις τον κοσμον τουτον ηλθον ινα οι μη βλεποντες βλεπωσιν και οι βλεποντες τυφλοι γενωνται
kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

vulg: et audierunt ex Pharisaeis qui cum ipso erant et dixerunt ei numquid et nos caeci sumus
clem: Et audierunt quidam ex pharisis qui cum ipso erant, et dixerunt ei: Numquid et nos cci sumus?
tr: και ηκουσαν εκ των φαρισαιων ταυτα οι οντες μετ αυτου και ειπον αυτω μη και ημεις τυφλοι εσμεν
kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

vulg: dixit eis Iesus si caeci essetis non haberetis peccatum nunc vero dicitis quia videmus peccatum vestrum manet
clem: Dixit eis Jesus: Si cci essetis, non haberetis peccatum. Nunc vero dicitis, Quia videmus: peccatum vestrum manet.
tr: ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους ει τυφλοι ητε ουκ αν ειχετε αμαρτιαν νυν δε λεγετε οτι βλεπομεν η ουν αμαρτια υμων μενει
kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis qui non intrat per ostium in ovile ovium sed ascendit aliunde ille fur est et latro
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: qui non intrat per ostium in ovile ovium, sed ascendit aliunde, ille fur est et latro.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ο μη εισερχομενος δια της θυρας εις την αυλην των προβατων αλλα αναβαινων αλλαχοθεν εκεινος κλεπτης εστιν και ληστης
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

vulg: qui autem intrat per ostium pastor est ovium
clem: Qui autem intrat per ostium, pastor est ovium.
tr: ο δε εισερχομενος δια της θυρας ποιμην εστιν των προβατων
kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

vulg: huic ostiarius aperit et oves vocem eius audiunt et proprias oves vocat nominatim et educit eas
clem: Huic ostiarius aperit, et oves vocem ejus audiunt, et proprias ovas vocat nominatim, et educit eas.
tr: τουτω ο θυρωρος ανοιγει και τα προβατα της φωνης αυτου ακουει και τα ιδια προβατα καλει κατ ονομα και εξαγει αυτα
kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

vulg: et cum proprias oves emiserit ante eas vadit et oves illum sequuntur quia sciunt vocem eius
clem: Et cum proprias oves emiserit, ante eas vadit: et oves illum sequuntur, quia sciunt vocem ejus.
tr: και οταν τα ιδια προβατα εκβαλη εμπροσθεν αυτων πορευεται και τα προβατα αυτω ακολουθει οτι οιδασιν την φωνην αυτου
kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

vulg: alienum autem non sequuntur sed fugient ab eo quia non noverunt vocem alienorum
clem: Alienum autem non sequuntur, sed fugiunt ab eo: quia non noverunt vocem alienorum.
tr: αλλοτριω δε ου μη ακολουθησωσιν αλλα φευξονται απ αυτου οτι ουκ οιδασιν των αλλοτριων την φωνην
kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

vulg: hoc proverbium dixit eis Iesus illi autem non cognoverunt quid loqueretur eis
clem: Hoc proverbium dixit eis Jesus: illi autem non cognoverunt quid loqueretur eis.
tr: ταυτην την παροιμιαν ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους εκεινοι δε ουκ εγνωσαν τινα ην α ελαλει αυτοις
kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

vulg: dixit ergo eis iterum Iesus amen amen dico vobis quia ego sum ostium ovium
clem: Dixit ergo eis iterum Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia ego sum ostium ovium.
tr: ειπεν ουν παλιν αυτοις ο ιησους αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εγω ειμι η θυρα των προβατων
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

vulg: omnes quotquot venerunt fures sunt et latrones sed non audierunt eos oves
clem: Omnes quotquot venerunt, fures sunt, et latrones, et non audierunt eos oves.
tr: παντες οσοι προ εμου ηλθον κλεπται εισιν και λησται αλλ ουκ ηκουσαν αυτων τα προβατα
kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

vulg: ego sum ostium per me si quis introierit salvabitur et ingredietur et egredietur et pascua inveniet
clem: Ego sum ostium. Per me si quis introierit, salvabitur: et ingredietur, et egredietur, et pascua inveniet.
tr: εγω ειμι η θυρα δι εμου εαν τις εισελθη σωθησεται και εισελευσεται και εξελευσεται και νομην ευρησει
kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

vulg: fur non venit nisi ut furetur et mactet et perdat ego veni ut vitam habeant et abundantius habeant
clem: Fur non venit nisi ut furetur, et mactet, et perdat. Ego veni ut vitam habeant, et abundantius habeant.
tr: ο κλεπτης ουκ ερχεται ει μη ινα κλεψη και θυση και απολεση εγω ηλθον ινα ζωην εχωσιν και περισσον εχωσιν
kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

vulg: ego sum pastor bonus bonus pastor animam suam dat pro ovibus
clem: Ego sum pastor bonus. Bonus pastor animam suam dat pro ovibus suis.
tr: εγω ειμι ο ποιμην ο καλος ο ποιμην ο καλος την ψυχην αυτου τιθησιν υπερ των προβατων
kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

vulg: mercennarius et qui non est pastor cuius non sunt oves propriae videt lupum venientem et dimittit oves et fugit et lupus rapit et dispergit oves
clem: Mercenarius autem, et qui non est pastor, cujus non sunt oves propri, videt lupum venientem, et dimittit oves, et fugit: et lupus rapit, et dispergit oves;
tr: ο μισθωτος δε και ουκ ων ποιμην ου ουκ εισιν τα προβατα ιδια θεωρει τον λυκον ερχομενον και αφιησιν τα προβατα και φευγει και ο λυκος αρπαζει αυτα και σκορπιζει τα προβατα
kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

vulg: mercennarius autem fugit quia mercennarius est et non pertinet ad eum de ovibus
clem: mercenarius autem fugit, quia mercenarius est, et non pertinet ad eum de ovibus.
tr: ο δε μισθωτος φευγει οτι μισθωτος εστιν και ου μελει αυτω περι των προβατων
kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

vulg: ego sum pastor bonus et cognosco meas et cognoscunt me meae
clem: Ego sum pastor bonus: et cognosco meas, et cognoscunt me me.
tr: εγω ειμι ο ποιμην ο καλος και γινωσκω τα εμα και γινωσκομαι υπο των εμων
kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

vulg: sicut novit me Pater et ego agnosco Patrem et animam meam pono pro ovibus
clem: Sicut novit me Pater, et ego agnosco Patrem: et animam meam pono pro ovibus meis.
tr: καθως γινωσκει με ο πατηρ καγω γινωσκω τον πατερα και την ψυχην μου τιθημι υπερ των προβατων
kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

vulg: et alias oves habeo quae non sunt ex hoc ovili et illas oportet me adducere et vocem meam audient et fiet unum ovile unus pastor
clem: Et alias oves habeo, qu non sunt ex hoc ovili: et illas oportet me adducere, et vocem meam audient, et fiet unum ovile et unus pastor.
tr: και αλλα προβατα εχω α ουκ εστιν εκ της αυλης ταυτης κακεινα με δει αγαγειν και της φωνης μου ακουσουσιν και γενησεται μια ποιμνη εις ποιμην
kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

vulg: propterea me Pater diligit quia ego pono animam meam ut iterum sumam eam
clem: Propterea me diligit Pater: quia ego pono animam meam, ut iterum sumam eam.
tr: δια τουτο ο πατηρ με αγαπα οτι εγω τιθημι την ψυχην μου ινα παλιν λαβω αυτην
kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

vulg: nemo tollit eam a me sed ego pono eam a me ipso potestatem habeo ponendi eam et potestatem habeo iterum sumendi eam hoc mandatum accepi a Patre meo
clem: Nemo tollit eam a me: sed ego pono eam a meipso, et potestatem habeo ponendi eam, et potestatem habeo iterum sumendi eam. Hoc mandatum accepi a Patre meo.
tr: ουδεις αιρει αυτην απ εμου αλλ εγω τιθημι αυτην απ εμαυτου εξουσιαν εχω θειναι αυτην και εξουσιαν εχω παλιν λαβειν αυτην ταυτην την εντολην ελαβον παρα του πατρος μου
kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

vulg: dissensio iterum facta est inter Iudaeos propter sermones hos
clem: Dissensio iterum facta est inter Judos propter sermones hos.
tr: σχισμα ουν παλιν εγενετο εν τοις ιουδαιοις δια τους λογους τουτους
kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

vulg: dicebant autem multi ex ipsis daemonium habet et insanit quid eum auditis
clem: Dicebant autem multi ex ipsis: Dmonium habet, et insanit: quid eum auditis?
tr: ελεγον δε πολλοι εξ αυτων δαιμονιον εχει και μαινεται τι αυτου ακουετε
kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

vulg: alii dicebant haec verba non sunt daemonium habentis numquid daemonium potest caecorum oculos aperire
clem: Alii dicebant: Hc verba non sunt dmonium habentis: numquid dmonium potest ccorum oculos aperire?
tr: αλλοι ελεγον ταυτα τα ρηματα ουκ εστιν δαιμονιζομενου μη δαιμονιον δυναται τυφλων οφθαλμους ανοιγειν
kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

vulg: facta sunt autem encenia in Hierosolymis et hiemps erat
clem: Facta sunt autem Encnia in Jerosolymis, et hiems erat.
tr: εγενετο δε τα εγκαινια εν τοις ιεροσολυμοις και χειμων ην
kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

vulg: et ambulabat Iesus in templo in porticu Salomonis
clem: Et ambulabat Jesus in templo, in porticu Salomonis.
tr: και περιεπατει ο ιησους εν τω ιερω εν τη στοα του σολομωντος
kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

vulg: circumdederunt ergo eum Iudaei et dicebant ei quousque animam nostram tollis si tu es Christus dic nobis palam
clem: Circumdederunt ergo eum Judi, et dicebant ei: Quousque animam nostram tollis? si tu es Christus, dic nobis palam.
tr: εκυκλωσαν ουν αυτον οι ιουδαιοι και ελεγον αυτω εως ποτε την ψυχην ημων αιρεις ει συ ει ο χριστος ειπε ημιν παρρησια
kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

vulg: respondit eis Iesus loquor vobis et non creditis opera quae ego facio in nomine Patris mei haec testimonium perhibent de me
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Loquor vobis, et non creditis: opera qu ego facio in nomine Patris mei, hc testimonium perhibent de me:
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους ειπον υμιν και ου πιστευετε τα εργα α εγω ποιω εν τω ονοματι του πατρος μου ταυτα μαρτυρει περι εμου
kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

vulg: sed vos non creditis quia non estis ex ovibus meis
clem: sed vos non creditis, quia non estis ex ovibus meis.
tr: αλλ υμεις ου πιστευετε ου γαρ εστε εκ των προβατων των εμων καθως ειπον υμιν
kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

vulg: oves meae vocem meam audiunt et ego cognosco eas et sequuntur me
clem: Oves me vocem meam audiunt, et ego cognosco eas, et sequuntur me:
tr: τα προβατα τα εμα της φωνης μου ακουει καγω γινωσκω αυτα και ακολουθουσιν μοι
kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

vulg: et ego vitam aeternam do eis et non peribunt in aeternum et non rapiet eas quisquam de manu mea
clem: et ego vitam ternam do eis, et non peribunt in ternum, et non rapiet eas quisquam de manu mea.
tr: καγω ζωην αιωνιον διδωμι αυτοις και ου μη απολωνται εις τον αιωνα και ουχ αρπασει τις αυτα εκ της χειρος μου
kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

vulg: Pater meus quod dedit mihi maius omnibus est et nemo potest rapere de manu Patris mei
clem: Pater meus quod dedit mihi, majus omnibus est: et nemo potest rapere de manu Patris mei.
tr: ο πατηρ μου ος δεδωκεν μοι μειζων παντων εστιν και ουδεις δυναται αρπαζειν εκ της χειρος του πατρος μου
kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

vulg: ego et Pater unum sumus
clem: Ego et Pater unum sumus.
tr: εγω και ο πατηρ εν εσμεν
kjv: I and my Father are one.

vulg: sustulerunt lapides Iudaei ut lapidarent eum
clem: Sustulerunt ergo lapides Judi, ut lapidarent eum.
tr: εβαστασαν ουν παλιν λιθους οι ιουδαιοι ινα λιθασωσιν αυτον
kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

vulg: respondit eis Iesus multa opera bona ostendi vobis ex Patre meo propter quod eorum opus me lapidatis
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Multa bona opera ostendi vobis ex Patre meo: propter quod eorum opus me lapidatis?
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους πολλα καλα εργα εδειξα υμιν εκ του πατρος μου δια ποιον αυτων εργον λιθαζετε με
kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

vulg: responderunt ei Iudaei de bono opere non lapidamus te sed de blasphemia et quia tu homo cum sis facis te ipsum Deum
clem: Responderunt ei Judi: De bono opere non lapidamus te, sed de blasphemia; et quia tu homo cum sis, facis teipsum Deum.
tr: απεκριθησαν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι λεγοντες περι καλου εργου ου λιθαζομεν σε αλλα περι βλασφημιας και οτι συ ανθρωπος ων ποιεις σεαυτον θεον
kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

vulg: respondit eis Iesus nonne scriptum est in lege vestra quia ego dixi dii estis
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Nonne scriptum est in lege vestra, Quia ego dixi: Dii estis?
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους ουκ εστιν γεγραμμενον εν τω νομω υμων εγω ειπα θεοι εστε
kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

vulg: si illos dixit deos ad quos sermo Dei factus est et non potest solvi scriptura
clem: Si illos dixit deos, ad quos sermo Dei factus est, et non potest solvi Scriptura:
tr: ει εκεινους ειπεν θεους προς ους ο λογος του θεου εγενετο και ου δυναται λυθηναι η γραφη
kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

vulg: quem Pater sanctificavit et misit in mundum vos dicitis quia blasphemas quia dixi Filius Dei sum
clem: quem Pater sanctificavit, et misit in mundum vos dicitis: Quia blasphemas, quia dixi: Filius Dei sum?
tr: ον ο πατηρ ηγιασεν και απεστειλεν εις τον κοσμον υμεις λεγετε οτι βλασφημεις οτι ειπον υιος του θεου ειμι
kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

vulg: si non facio opera Patris mei nolite credere mihi
clem: Si non facio opera Patris mei, nolite credere mihi.
tr: ει ου ποιω τα εργα του πατρος μου μη πιστευετε μοι
kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

vulg: si autem facio et si mihi non vultis credere operibus credite ut cognoscatis et credatis quia in me est Pater et ego in Patre
clem: Si autem facio: etsi mihi non vultis credere, operibus credite, ut cognoscatis, et credatis quia Pater in me est, et ego in Patre.
tr: ει δε ποιω καν εμοι μη πιστευητε τοις εργοις πιστευσατε ινα γνωτε και πιστευσητε οτι εν εμοι ο πατηρ καγω εν αυτω
kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

vulg: quaerebant ergo eum prendere et exivit de manibus eorum
clem: Qurebant ergo eum apprehendere: et exivit de manibus eorum.
tr: εζητουν ουν παλιν αυτον πιασαι και εξηλθεν εκ της χειρος αυτων
kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

vulg: et abiit iterum trans Iordanen in eum locum ubi erat Iohannes baptizans primum et mansit illic
clem: Et abiit iterum trans Jordanem, in eum locum ubi erat Joannes baptizans primum, et mansit illic;
tr: και απηλθεν παλιν περαν του ιορδανου εις τον τοπον οπου ην ιωαννης το πρωτον βαπτιζων και εμεινεν εκει
kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

vulg: et multi venerunt ad eum et dicebant quia Iohannes quidem signum fecit nullum
clem: et multi venerunt ad eum, et dicebant: Quia Joannes quidem signum fecit nullum.
tr: και πολλοι ηλθον προς αυτον και ελεγον οτι ιωαννης μεν σημειον εποιησεν ουδεν παντα δε οσα ειπεν ιωαννης περι τουτου αληθη ην
kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

vulg: omnia autem quaecumque dixit Iohannes de hoc vera erant et multi crediderunt in eum
clem: Omnia autem qucumque dixit Joannes de hoc, vera erant. Et multi crediderunt in eum.
tr: και επιστευσαν πολλοι εκει εις αυτον
kjv: And many believed on him there.

vulg: erat autem quidam languens Lazarus a Bethania de castello Mariae et Marthae sororis eius
clem: Erat autem quidem languens Lazarus a Bethania, de castello Mari et Marth sororis ejus.
tr: ην δε τις ασθενων λαζαρος απο βηθανιας εκ της κωμης μαριας και μαρθας της αδελφης αυτης
kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

vulg: Maria autem erat quae unxit Dominum unguento et extersit pedes eius capillis suis cuius frater Lazarus infirmabatur
clem: (Maria autem erat qu unxit Dominum unguento, et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis: cujus frater Lazarus infirmabatur.)
tr: ην δε μαρια η αλειψασα τον κυριον μυρω και εκμαξασα τους ποδας αυτου ταις θριξιν αυτης ης ο αδελφος λαζαρος ησθενει
kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

vulg: miserunt ergo sorores ad eum dicentes Domine ecce quem amas infirmatur
clem: Miserunt ergo sorores ejus ad eum dicentes: Domine, ecce quem amas infirmatur.
tr: απεστειλαν ουν αι αδελφαι προς αυτον λεγουσαι κυριε ιδε ον φιλεις ασθενει
kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

vulg: audiens autem Iesus dixit eis infirmitas haec non est ad mortem sed pro gloria Dei ut glorificetur Filius Dei per eam
clem: Audiens autem Jesus dixit eis: Infirmitas hc non est ad mortem, sed pro gloria Dei, ut glorificetur Filius Dei per eam.
tr: ακουσας δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτη η ασθενεια ουκ εστιν προς θανατον αλλ υπερ της δοξης του θεου ινα δοξασθη ο υιος του θεου δι αυτης
kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

vulg: diligebat autem Iesus Martham et sororem eius Mariam et Lazarum
clem: Diligebat autem Jesus Martham, et sororem ejus Mariam, et Lazarum.
tr: ηγαπα δε ο ιησους την μαρθαν και την αδελφην αυτης και τον λαζαρον
kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

vulg: ut ergo audivit quia infirmabatur tunc quidem mansit in eodem loco duobus diebus
clem: Ut ergo audivit quia infirmabatur, tunc quidem mansit in eodem loco duobus diebus;
tr: ως ουν ηκουσεν οτι ασθενει τοτε μεν εμεινεν εν ω ην τοπω δυο ημερας
kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

vulg: deinde post haec dicit discipulis suis eamus in Iudaeam iterum
clem: deinde post hc dixit discipulis suis: Eamus in Judam iterum.
tr: επειτα μετα τουτο λεγει τοις μαθηταις αγωμεν εις την ιουδαιαν παλιν
kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

vulg: dicunt ei discipuli rabbi nunc quaerebant te Iudaei lapidare et iterum vadis illuc
clem: Dicunt ei discipuli: Rabbi, nunc qurebant te Judi lapidare, et iterum vadis illuc?
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται ραββι νυν εζητουν σε λιθασαι οι ιουδαιοι και παλιν υπαγεις εκει
kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

vulg: respondit Iesus nonne duodecim horae sunt diei si quis ambulaverit in die non offendit quia lucem huius mundi videt
clem: Respondit Jesus: Nonne duodecim sunt hor diei? Si quis ambulaverit in die, non offendit, quia lucem hujus mundi videt:
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους ουχι δωδεκα εισιν ωραι της ημερας εαν τις περιπατη εν τη ημερα ου προσκοπτει οτι το φως του κοσμου τουτου βλεπει
kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

vulg: si autem ambulaverit nocte offendit quia lux non est in eo
clem: si autem ambulaverit in nocte, offendit, quia lux non est in eo.
tr: εαν δε τις περιπατη εν τη νυκτι προσκοπτει οτι το φως ουκ εστιν εν αυτω
kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

vulg: haec ait et post hoc dicit eis Lazarus amicus noster dormit sed vado ut a somno exsuscitem eum
clem: Hc ait, et post hc dixit eis: Lazarus amicus noster dormit: sed vado ut a somno excitem eum.
tr: ταυτα ειπεν και μετα τουτο λεγει αυτοις λαζαρος ο φιλος ημων κεκοιμηται αλλα πορευομαι ινα εξυπνισω αυτον
kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

vulg: dixerunt ergo discipuli eius Domine si dormit salvus erit
clem: Dixerunt ergo discipuli ejus: Domine, si dormit, salvus erit.
tr: ειπον ουν οι μαθηται αυτου κυριε ει κεκοιμηται σωθησεται
kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

vulg: dixerat autem Iesus de morte eius illi autem putaverunt quia de dormitione somni diceret
clem: Dixerat autem Jesus de morte ejus: illi autem putaverunt quia de dormitione somni diceret.
tr: ειρηκει δε ο ιησους περι του θανατου αυτου εκεινοι δε εδοξαν οτι περι της κοιμησεως του υπνου λεγει
kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

vulg: tunc ergo dixit eis Iesus manifeste Lazarus mortuus est
clem: Tunc ergo Jesus dixit eis manifeste: Lazarus mortuus est:
tr: τοτε ουν ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους παρρησια λαζαρος απεθανεν
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

vulg: et gaudeo propter vos ut credatis quoniam non eram ibi sed eamus ad eum
clem: et gaudeo propter vos, ut credatis, quoniam non eram ibi, sed eamus ad eum.
tr: και χαιρω δι υμας ινα πιστευσητε οτι ουκ ημην εκει αλλ αγωμεν προς αυτον
kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

vulg: dixit ergo Thomas qui dicitur Didymus ad condiscipulos eamus et nos ut moriamur cum eo
clem: Dixit ergo Thomas, qui dicitur Didymus, ad condiscipulos: Eamus et nos, ut moriamur cum eo.
tr: ειπεν ουν θωμας ο λεγομενος διδυμος τοις συμμαθηταις αγωμεν και ημεις ινα αποθανωμεν μετ αυτου
kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

vulg: venit itaque Iesus et invenit eum quattuor dies iam in monumento habentem
clem: Venit itaque Jesus: et invenit eum quatuor dies jam in monumento habentem.
tr: ελθων ουν ο ιησους ευρεν αυτον τεσσαρας ημερας ηδη εχοντα εν τω μνημειω
kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

vulg: erat autem Bethania iuxta Hierosolyma quasi stadiis quindecim
clem: (Erat autem Bethania juxta Jerosolymam quasi stadiis quindecim.)
tr: ην δε η βηθανια εγγυς των ιεροσολυμων ως απο σταδιων δεκαπεντε
kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

vulg: multi autem ex Iudaeis venerant ad Martham et Mariam ut consolarentur eas de fratre suo
clem: Multi autem ex Judis venerant ad Martham et Mariam, ut consolarentur eas de fratre suo.
tr: και πολλοι εκ των ιουδαιων εληλυθεισαν προς τας περι μαρθαν και μαριαν ινα παραμυθησωνται αυτας περι του αδελφου αυτων
kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

vulg: Martha ergo ut audivit quia Iesus venit occurrit illi Maria autem domi sedebat
clem: Martha ergo ut audivit quia Jesus venit, occurrit illi: Maria autem domi sedebat.
tr: η ουν μαρθα ως ηκουσεν οτι ο ιησους ερχεται υπηντησεν αυτω μαρια δε εν τω οικω εκαθεζετο
kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

vulg: dixit ergo Martha ad Iesum Domine si fuisses hic frater meus non fuisset mortuus
clem: Dixit ergo Martha ad Jesum: Domine, si fuisses hic, frater meus non fuisset mortuus:
tr: ειπεν ουν η μαρθα προς τον ιησουν κυριε ει ης ωδε ο αδελφος μου ουκ αν ετεθνηκει
kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

vulg: sed et nunc scio quia quaecumque poposceris a Deo dabit tibi Deus
clem: sed et nunc scio quia qucumque poposceris a Deo, dabit tibi Deus.
tr: αλλα και νυν οιδα οτι οσα αν αιτηση τον θεον δωσει σοι ο θεος
kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

vulg: dicit illi Iesus resurget frater tuus
clem: Dicit illi Jesus: Resurget frater tuus.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους αναστησεται ο αδελφος σου
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

vulg: dicit ei Martha scio quia resurget in resurrectione in novissima die
clem: Dicit ei Martha: Scio quia resurget in resurrectione in novissimo die.
tr: λεγει αυτω μαρθα οιδα οτι αναστησεται εν τη αναστασει εν τη εσχατη ημερα
kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

vulg: dixit ei Iesus ego sum resurrectio et vita qui credit in me et si mortuus fuerit vivet
clem: Dixit ei Jesus: Ego sum resurrectio et vita: qui credit in me, etiam si mortuus fuerit, vivet:
tr: ειπεν αυτη ο ιησους εγω ειμι η αναστασις και η ζωη ο πιστευων εις εμε καν αποθανη ζησεται
kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

vulg: et omnis qui vivit et credit in me non morietur in aeternum credis hoc
clem: et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non morietur in ternum. Credis hoc?
tr: και πας ο ζων και πιστευων εις εμε ου μη αποθανη εις τον αιωνα πιστευεις τουτο
kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

vulg: ait illi utique Domine ego credidi quia tu es Christus Filius Dei qui in mundum venisti
clem: Ait illi: Utique Domine, ego credidi quia tu es Christus, Filius Dei vivi, qui in hunc mundum venisti.
tr: λεγει αυτω ναι κυριε εγω πεπιστευκα οτι συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου ο εις τον κοσμον ερχομενος
kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

vulg: et cum haec dixisset abiit et vocavit Mariam sororem suam silentio dicens magister adest et vocat te
clem: Et cum hc dixisset, abiit, et vocavit Mariam sororem suam silentio, dicens: Magister adest, et vocat te.
tr: και ταυτα ειπουσα απηλθεν και εφωνησεν μαριαν την αδελφην αυτης λαθρα ειπουσα ο διδασκαλος παρεστιν και φωνει σε
kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

vulg: illa ut audivit surgit cito et venit ad eum
clem: Illa ut audivit, surgit cito, et venit ad eum;
tr: εκεινη ως ηκουσεν εγειρεται ταχυ και ερχεται προς αυτον
kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

vulg: nondum enim venerat Iesus in castellum sed erat adhuc in illo loco ubi occurrerat ei Martha
clem: nondum enim venerat Jesus in castellum: sed erat adhuc in illo loco, ubi occurrerat ei Martha.
tr: ουπω δε εληλυθει ο ιησους εις την κωμην αλλ ην εν τω τοπω οπου υπηντησεν αυτω η μαρθα
kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

vulg: Iudaei igitur qui erant cum ea in domo et consolabantur eam cum vidissent Mariam quia cito surrexit et exiit secuti sunt eam dicentes quia vadit ad monumentum ut ploret ibi
clem: Judi ergo, qui erant cum ea in domo, et consolabantur eam, cum vidissent Mariam quia cito surrexit, et exiit, secuti sunt eam dicentes: Quia vadit ad monumentum, ut ploret ibi.
tr: οι ουν ιουδαιοι οι οντες μετ αυτης εν τη οικια και παραμυθουμενοι αυτην ιδοντες την μαριαν οτι ταχεως ανεστη και εξηλθεν ηκολουθησαν αυτη λεγοντες οτι υπαγει εις το μνημειον ινα κλαυση εκει
kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

vulg: Maria ergo cum venisset ubi erat Iesus videns eum cecidit ad pedes eius et dixit ei Domine si fuisses hic non esset mortuus frater meus
clem: Maria ergo, cum venisset ubi erat Jesus, videns eum, cecidit ad pedes ejus, et dicit ei: Domine, si fuisses hic, non esset mortuus frater meus.
tr: η ουν μαρια ως ηλθεν οπου ην ο ιησους ιδουσα αυτον επεσεν εις τους ποδας αυτου λεγουσα αυτω κυριε ει ης ωδε ουκ αν απεθανεν μου ο αδελφος
kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

vulg: Iesus ergo ut vidit eam plorantem et Iudaeos qui venerant cum ea plorantes fremuit spiritu et turbavit se ipsum
clem: Jesus ergo, ut vidit eam plorantem, et Judos, qui venerant cum ea, plorantes, infremuit spiritu, et turbavit seipsum,
tr: ιησους ουν ως ειδεν αυτην κλαιουσαν και τους συνελθοντας αυτη ιουδαιους κλαιοντας ενεβριμησατο τω πνευματι και εταραξεν εαυτον
kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.

vulg: et dixit ubi posuistis eum dicunt ei Domine veni et vide
clem: et dixit: Ubi posuistis eum? Dicunt ei: Domine, veni, et vide.
tr: και ειπεν που τεθεικατε αυτον λεγουσιν αυτω κυριε ερχου και ιδε
kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

vulg: et lacrimatus est Iesus
clem: Et lacrimatus est Jesus.
tr: εδακρυσεν ο ιησους
kjv: Jesus wept.

vulg: dixerunt ergo Iudaei ecce quomodo amabat eum
clem: Dixerunt ergo Judi: Ecce quomodo amabat eum.
tr: ελεγον ουν οι ιουδαιοι ιδε πως εφιλει αυτον
kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

vulg: quidam autem dixerunt ex ipsis non poterat hic qui aperuit oculos caeci facere ut et hic non moreretur
clem: Quidam autem ex ipsis dixerunt: Non poterat hic, qui aperuit oculos cci nati, facere ut hic non moreretur?
tr: τινες δε εξ αυτων ειπον ουκ ηδυνατο ουτος ο ανοιξας τους οφθαλμους του τυφλου ποιησαι ινα και ουτος μη αποθανη
kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

vulg: Iesus ergo rursum fremens in semet ipso venit ad monumentum erat autem spelunca et lapis superpositus erat ei
clem: Jesus ergo rursum fremens in semetipso, venit ad monumentum. Erat autem spelunca, et lapis superpositus erat ei.
tr: ιησους ουν παλιν εμβριμωμενος εν εαυτω ερχεται εις το μνημειον ην δε σπηλαιον και λιθος επεκειτο επ αυτω
kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

vulg: ait Iesus tollite lapidem dicit ei Martha soror eius qui mortuus fuerat Domine iam fetet quadriduanus enim est
clem: Ait Jesus: Tollite lapidem. Dicit ei Martha, soror ejus qui mortuus fuerat: Domine, jam ftet, quatriduanus est enim.
tr: λεγει ο ιησους αρατε τον λιθον λεγει αυτω η αδελφη του τεθνηκοτος μαρθα κυριε ηδη οζει τεταρταιος γαρ εστιν
kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus nonne dixi tibi quoniam si credideris videbis gloriam Dei
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Nonne dixi tibi quoniam si credideris, videbis gloriam Dei?
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους ουκ ειπον σοι οτι εαν πιστευσης οψει την δοξαν του θεου
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

vulg: tulerunt ergo lapidem Iesus autem elevatis sursum oculis dixit Pater gratias ago tibi quoniam audisti me
clem: Tulerunt ergo lapidem: Jesus autem, elevatis sursum oculis, dixit: Pater, gratias ago tibi quoniam audisti me.
tr: ηραν ουν τον λιθον ου ην ο τεθνηκως κειμενος ο δε ιησους ηρεν τους οφθαλμους ανω και ειπεν πατερ ευχαριστω σοι οτι ηκουσας μου
kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

vulg: ego autem sciebam quia semper me audis sed propter populum qui circumstat dixi ut credant quia tu me misisti
clem: Ego autem sciebam quia semper me audis, sed propter populum qui circumstat, dixi: ut credant quia tu me misisti.
tr: εγω δε ηδειν οτι παντοτε μου ακουεις αλλα δια τον οχλον τον περιεστωτα ειπον ινα πιστευσωσιν οτι συ με απεστειλας
kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

vulg: haec cum dixisset voce magna clamavit Lazare veni foras
clem: Hc cum dixisset, voce magna clamavit: Lazare, veni foras.
tr: και ταυτα ειπων φωνη μεγαλη εκραυγασεν λαζαρε δευρο εξω
kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

vulg: et statim prodiit qui fuerat mortuus ligatus pedes et manus institis et facies illius sudario erat ligata dicit Iesus eis solvite eum et sinite abire
clem: Et statim prodiit qui fuerat mortuus, ligatus pedes, et manus institis, et facies illius sudario erat ligata. Dixit eis Jesus: Solvite eum et sinite abire.
tr: και εξηλθεν ο τεθνηκως δεδεμενος τους ποδας και τας χειρας κειριαις και η οψις αυτου σουδαριω περιεδεδετο λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους λυσατε αυτον και αφετε υπαγειν
kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

vulg: multi ergo ex Iudaeis qui venerant ad Mariam et viderant quae fecit crediderunt in eum
clem: Multi ergo ex Judis, qui venerant ad Mariam, et Martham, et viderant qu fecit Jesus, crediderunt in eum.
tr: πολλοι ουν εκ των ιουδαιων οι ελθοντες προς την μαριαν και θεασαμενοι α εποιησεν ο ιησους επιστευσαν εις αυτον
kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

vulg: quidam autem ex ipsis abierunt ad Pharisaeos et dixerunt eis quae fecit Iesus
clem: Quidam autem ex ipsis abierunt ad pharisos, et dixerunt eis qu fecit Jesus.
tr: τινες δε εξ αυτων απηλθον προς τους φαρισαιους και ειπον αυτοις α εποιησεν ο ιησους
kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

vulg: collegerunt ergo pontifices et Pharisaei concilium et dicebant quid facimus quia hic homo multa signa facit
clem: Collegerunt ergo pontifices et pharisi concilium, et dicebant: Quid faciamus, quia hic homo multa signa facit?
tr: συνηγαγον ουν οι αρχιερεις και οι φαρισαιοι συνεδριον και ελεγον τι ποιουμεν οτι ουτος ο ανθρωπος πολλα σημεια ποιει
kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

vulg: si dimittimus eum sic omnes credent in eum et venient Romani et tollent nostrum et locum et gentem
clem: Si dimittimus eum sic, omnes credent in eum, et venient Romani, et tollent nostrum locum, et gentem.
tr: εαν αφωμεν αυτον ουτως παντες πιστευσουσιν εις αυτον και ελευσονται οι ρωμαιοι και αρουσιν ημων και τον τοπον και το εθνος
kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

vulg: unus autem ex ipsis Caiaphas cum esset pontifex anni illius dixit eis vos nescitis quicquam
clem: Unus autem ex ipsis, Caiphas nomine, cum esset pontifex anni illius, dixit eis: Vos nescitis quidquam,
tr: εις δε τις εξ αυτων καιαφας αρχιερευς ων του ενιαυτου εκεινου ειπεν αυτοις υμεις ουκ οιδατε ουδεν
kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

vulg: nec cogitatis quia expedit nobis ut unus moriatur homo pro populo et non tota gens pereat
clem: nec cogitatis quia expedit vobis ut unus moriatur homo pro populo, et non tota gens pereat.
tr: ουδε διαλογιζεσθε οτι συμφερει ημιν ινα εις ανθρωπος αποθανη υπερ του λαου και μη ολον το εθνος αποληται
kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

vulg: hoc autem a semet ipso non dixit sed cum esset pontifex anni illius prophetavit quia Iesus moriturus erat pro gente
clem: Hoc autem a semetipso non dixit: sed cum esset pontifex anni illius, prophetavit, quod Jesus moriturus erat pro gente,
tr: τουτο δε αφ εαυτου ουκ ειπεν αλλα αρχιερευς ων του ενιαυτου εκεινου προεφητευσεν οτι εμελλεν ο ιησους αποθνησκειν υπερ του εθνους
kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

vulg: et non tantum pro gente sed et ut filios Dei qui erant dispersi congregaret in unum
clem: et non tantum pro gente, sed ut filios Dei, qui erant dispersi, congregaret in unum.
tr: και ουχ υπερ του εθνους μονον αλλ ινα και τα τεκνα του θεου τα διεσκορπισμενα συναγαγη εις εν
kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

vulg: ab illo ergo die cogitaverunt ut interficerent eum
clem: Ab illo ergo die cogitaverunt ut interficerent eum.
tr: απ εκεινης ουν της ημερας συνεβουλευσαντο ινα αποκτεινωσιν αυτον
kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

vulg: Iesus ergo iam non in palam ambulabat apud Iudaeos sed abiit in regionem iuxta desertum in civitatem quae dicitur Efrem et ibi morabatur cum discipulis
clem: Jesus ergo jam non in palam ambulabat apud Judos, sed abiit in regionem juxta desertum, in civitatem qu dicitur Ephrem, et ibi morabatur cum discipulis suis.
tr: ιησους ουν ουκ ετι παρρησια περιεπατει εν τοις ιουδαιοις αλλα απηλθεν εκειθεν εις την χωραν εγγυς της ερημου εις εφραιμ λεγομενην πολιν κακει διετριβεν μετα των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

vulg: proximum autem erat pascha Iudaeorum et ascenderunt multi Hierosolyma de regione ante pascha ut sanctificarent se ipsos
clem: Proximum autem erat Pascha Judorum, et ascenderunt multi Jerosolymam de regione ante Pascha, ut sanctificarent seipsos.
tr: ην δε εγγυς το πασχα των ιουδαιων και ανεβησαν πολλοι εις ιεροσολυμα εκ της χωρας προ του πασχα ινα αγνισωσιν εαυτους
kjv: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

vulg: quaerebant ergo Iesum et conloquebantur ad invicem in templo stantes quid putatis quia non veniat ad diem festum
clem: Qurebant ergo Jesum, et colloquebantur ad invicem, in templo stantes: Quid putatis, quia non venit ad diem festum?
tr: εζητουν ουν τον ιησουν και ελεγον μετ αλληλων εν τω ιερω εστηκοτες τι δοκει υμιν οτι ου μη ελθη εις την εορτην
kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

vulg: dederant autem pontifices et Pharisaei mandatum ut si quis cognoverit ubi sit indicet ut adprehendant eum
clem: Dederant autem pontifices et pharisi mandatum ut si quis cognoverit ubi sit, indicet, ut apprehendant eum.
tr: δεδωκεισαν δε και οι αρχιερεις και οι φαρισαιοι εντολην ινα εαν τις γνω που εστιν μηνυση οπως πιασωσιν αυτον
kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

vulg: Iesus ergo ante sex dies paschae venit Bethaniam ubi fuerat Lazarus mortuus quem suscitavit Iesus
clem: Jesus ergo ante sex dies Pasch venit Bethaniam, ubi Lazarus fuerat mortuus, quem suscitavit Jesus.
tr: ο ουν ιησους προ εξ ημερων του πασχα ηλθεν εις βηθανιαν οπου ην λαζαρος ο τεθνηκως ον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων
kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

vulg: fecerunt autem ei cenam ibi et Martha ministrabat Lazarus vero unus erat ex discumbentibus cum eo
clem: Fecerunt autem ei cnam ibi, et Martha ministrabat, Lazarus vero unus erat ex discumbentibus cum eo.
tr: εποιησαν ουν αυτω δειπνον εκει και η μαρθα διηκονει ο δε λαζαρος εις ην των συνανακειμενων αυτω
kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

vulg: Maria ergo accepit libram unguenti nardi pistici pretiosi unxit pedes Iesu et extersit capillis suis pedes eius et domus impleta est ex odore unguenti
clem: Maria ergo accepit libram unguenti nardi pistici pretiosi, et unxit pedes Jesu, et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis: et domus impleta est ex odore unguenti.
tr: η ουν μαρια λαβουσα λιτραν μυρου ναρδου πιστικης πολυτιμου ηλειψεν τους ποδας του ιησου και εξεμαξεν ταις θριξιν αυτης τους ποδας αυτου η δε οικια επληρωθη εκ της οσμης του μυρου
kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

vulg: dicit ergo unus ex discipulis eius Iudas Scariotis qui erat eum traditurus
clem: Dixit ergo unus ex discipulis ejus, Judas Iscariotes, qui erat eum traditurus:
tr: λεγει ουν εις εκ των μαθητων αυτου ιουδας σιμωνος ισκαριωτης ο μελλων αυτον παραδιδοναι
kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

vulg: quare hoc unguentum non veniit trecentis denariis et datum est egenis
clem: Quare hoc unguentum non veniit trecentis denariis, et datum est egenis?
tr: δια τι τουτο το μυρον ουκ επραθη τριακοσιων δηναριων και εδοθη πτωχοις
kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

vulg: dixit autem hoc non quia de egenis pertinebat ad eum sed quia fur erat et loculos habens ea quae mittebantur portabat
clem: Dixit autem hoc, non quia de egenis pertinebat ad eum, sed quia fur erat, et loculos habens, ea qu mittebantur, portabat.
tr: ειπεν δε τουτο ουχ οτι περι των πτωχων εμελεν αυτω αλλ  αλλα   οτι κλεπτης ην και το γλωσσοκομον ειχεν και τα βαλλομενα εβασταζεν
kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus sine illam ut in die sepulturae meae servet illud
clem: Dixit ergo Jesus: Sinite illam ut in diem sepultur me servet illud.
tr: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους αφες αυτην εις την ημεραν του ενταφιασμου μου τετηρηκεν αυτο
kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

vulg: pauperes enim semper habetis vobiscum me autem non semper habetis
clem: Pauperes enim semper habetis vobiscum: me autem non semper habetis.
tr: τους πτωχους γαρ παντοτε εχετε μεθ εαυτων εμε δε ου παντοτε εχετε
kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

vulg: cognovit ergo turba multa ex Iudaeis quia illic est et venerunt non propter Iesum tantum sed ut Lazarum viderent quem suscitavit a mortuis
clem: Cognovit ergo turba multa ex Judis quia illic est, et venerunt, non propter Jesum tantum, sed ut Lazarum viderent, quem suscitavit a mortuis.
tr: εγνω ουν οχλος πολυς εκ των ιουδαιων οτι εκει εστιν και ηλθον ου δια τον ιησουν μονον αλλ ινα και τον λαζαρον ιδωσιν ον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων
kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

vulg: cogitaverunt autem principes sacerdotum ut et Lazarum interficerent
clem: Cogitaverunt autem principes sacerdotum ut et Lazarum interficerent:
tr: εβουλευσαντο δε οι αρχιερεις ινα και τον λαζαρον αποκτεινωσιν
kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

vulg: quia multi propter illum abibant ex Iudaeis et credebant in Iesum
clem: quia multi propter illum abibant ex Judis, et credebant in Jesum.
tr: οτι πολλοι δι αυτον υπηγον των ιουδαιων και επιστευον εις τον ιησουν
kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

vulg: in crastinum autem turba multa quae venerat ad diem festum cum audissent quia venit Iesus Hierosolyma
clem: In crastinum autem, turba multa qu venerat ad diem festum, cum audissent quia venit Jesus Jerosolymam,
tr: τη επαυριον οχλος πολυς ο ελθων εις την εορτην ακουσαντες οτι ερχεται ο ιησους εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

vulg: acceperunt ramos palmarum et processerunt obviam ei et clamabant osanna benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini rex Israhel
clem: acceperunt ramos palmarum, et processerunt obviam ei, et clamabant: Hosanna, benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini, rex Isral.
tr: ελαβον τα βαια των φοινικων και εξηλθον εις υπαντησιν αυτω και εκραζον ωσαννα ευλογημενος ο ερχομενος εν ονοματι κυριου ο βασιλευς του ισραηλ
kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

vulg: et invenit Iesus asellum et sedit super eum sicut scriptum est
clem: Et invenit Jesus asellum, et sedit super eum, sicut scriptum est:
tr: ευρων δε ο ιησους οναριον εκαθισεν επ αυτο καθως εστιν γεγραμμενον
kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

vulg: noli timere filia Sion ecce rex tuus venit sedens super pullum asinae
clem: Noli timere, filia Sion: ecce rex tuus venit sedens super pullum asin.
tr: μη φοβου θυγατερ σιων ιδου ο βασιλευς σου ερχεται καθημενος επι πωλον ονου
kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

vulg: haec non cognoverunt discipuli eius primum sed quando glorificatus est Iesus tunc recordati sunt quia haec erant scripta de eo et haec fecerunt ei
clem: Hc non cognoverunt discipuli ejus primum: sed quando glorificatus est Jesus, tunc recordati sunt quia hc erant scripta de eo, et hc fecerunt ei.
tr: ταυτα δε ουκ εγνωσαν οι μαθηται αυτου το πρωτον αλλ οτε εδοξασθη ο ιησους τοτε εμνησθησαν οτι ταυτα ην επ αυτω γεγραμμενα και ταυτα εποιησαν αυτω
kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

vulg: testimonium ergo perhibebat turba quae erat cum eo quando Lazarum vocavit de monumento et suscitavit eum a mortuis
clem: Testimonium ergo perhibebat turba, qu erat cum eo quando Lazarum vocavit de monumento, et suscitavit eum a mortuis.
tr: εμαρτυρει ουν ο οχλος ο ων μετ αυτου οτε τον λαζαρον εφωνησεν εκ του μνημειου και ηγειρεν αυτον εκ νεκρων
kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

vulg: propterea et obviam venit ei turba quia audierunt eum fecisse hoc signum
clem: Propterea et obviam venit ei turba: quia audierunt fecisse hoc signum.
tr: δια τουτο και υπηντησεν αυτω ο οχλος οτι ηκουσεν τουτο αυτον πεποιηκεναι το σημειον
kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

vulg: Pharisaei ergo dixerunt ad semet ipsos videtis quia nihil proficimus ecce mundus totus post eum abiit
clem: Pharisi ergo dixerunt ad semetipsos: Videtis quia nihil proficimus? ecce mundus totus post eum abiit.
tr: οι ουν φαρισαιοι ειπον προς εαυτους θεωρειτε οτι ουκ ωφελειτε ουδεν ιδε ο κοσμος οπισω αυτου απηλθεν
kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

vulg: erant autem gentiles quidam ex his qui ascenderant ut adorarent in die festo
clem: Erant autem quidam gentiles, ex his qui ascenderant ut adorarent in die festo.
tr: ησαν δε τινες ελληνες εκ των αναβαινοντων ινα προσκυνησωσιν εν τη εορτη
kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

vulg: hii ergo accesserunt ad Philippum qui erat a Bethsaida Galilaeae et rogabant eum dicentes domine volumus Iesum videre
clem: Hi ergo accesserunt ad Philippum, qui erat a Bethsaida Galil, et rogabant eum, dicentes: Domine, volumus Jesum videre.
tr: ουτοι ουν προσηλθον φιλιππω τω απο βηθσαιδα της γαλιλαιας και ηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες κυριε θελομεν τον ιησουν ιδειν
kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

vulg: venit Philippus et dicit Andreae Andreas rursum et Philippus dixerunt Iesu
clem: Venit Philippus, et dicit Andre; Andreas rursum et Philippus dixerunt Jesu.
tr: ερχεται φιλιππος και λεγει τω ανδρεα και παλιν ανδρεας και φιλιππος λεγουσιν τω ιησου
kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

vulg: Iesus autem respondit eis dicens venit hora ut clarificetur Filius hominis
clem: Jesus autem respondit eis, dicens: Venit hora, ut clarificetur Filius hominis.
tr: ο δε ιησους απεκρινατο αυτοις λεγων εληλυθεν η ωρα ινα δοξασθη ο υιος του ανθρωπου
kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis nisi granum frumenti cadens in terram mortuum fuerit
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis, nisi granum frumenti cadens in terram, mortuum fuerit,
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν εαν μη ο κοκκος του σιτου πεσων εις την γην αποθανη αυτος μονος μενει εαν δε αποθανη πολυν καρπον φερει
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

vulg: ipsum solum manet si autem mortuum fuerit multum fructum adfert qui amat animam suam perdet eam et qui odit animam suam in hoc mundo in vitam aeternam custodit eam
clem: ipsum solum manet: si autem mortuum fuerit, multum fructum affert. Qui amat animam suam, perdet eam; et qui odit animam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ternam custodit eam.
tr: ο φιλων την ψυχην αυτου απολεσει αυτην και ο μισων την ψυχην αυτου εν τω κοσμω τουτω εις ζωην αιωνιον φυλαξει αυτην
kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

vulg: si quis mihi ministrat me sequatur et ubi sum ego illic et minister meus erit si quis mihi ministraverit honorificabit eum Pater meus
clem: Si quis mihi ministrat, me sequatur, et ubi sum ego, illic et minister meus erit. Si quis mihi ministraverit, honorificabit eum Pater meus.
tr: εαν εμοι διακονη τις εμοι ακολουθειτω και οπου ειμι εγω εκει και ο διακονος ο εμος εσται και εαν τις εμοι διακονη τιμησει αυτον ο πατηρ
kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

vulg: nunc anima mea turbata est et quid dicam Pater salvifica me ex hora hac sed propterea veni in horam hanc
clem: Nunc anima mea turbata est. Et quid dicam? Pater, salvifica me ex hac hora. Sed propterea veni in horam hanc:
tr: νυν η ψυχη μου τεταρακται και τι ειπω πατερ σωσον με εκ της ωρας ταυτης αλλα δια τουτο ηλθον εις την ωραν ταυτην
kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

vulg: Pater clarifica tuum nomen venit ergo vox de caelo et clarificavi et iterum clarificabo
clem: Pater, clarifica nomen tuum. Venit ergo vox de clo: Et clarificavi, et iterum clarificabo.
tr: πατερ δοξασον σου το ονομα ηλθεν ουν φωνη εκ του ουρανου και εδοξασα και παλιν δοξασω
kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

vulg: turba ergo quae stabat et audierat dicebant tonitruum factum esse alii dicebant angelus ei locutus est
clem: Turba ergo, qu stabat, et audierat, dicebat tonitruum esse factum. Alii dicebant: Angelus ei locutus est.
tr: ο ουν οχλος ο εστως και ακουσας ελεγεν βροντην γεγονεναι αλλοι ελεγον αγγελος αυτω λελαληκεν
kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit non propter me vox haec venit sed propter vos
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit: Non propter me hc vox venit, sed propter vos.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν ου δι εμε αυτη η φωνη γεγονεν αλλα δι υμας
kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

vulg: nunc iudicium est mundi nunc princeps huius mundi eicietur foras
clem: Nunc judicium est mundi: nunc princeps hujus mundi ejicietur foras.
tr: νυν κρισις εστιν του κοσμου τουτου νυν ο αρχων του κοσμου τουτου εκβληθησεται εξω
kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

vulg: et ego si exaltatus fuero a terra omnia traham ad me ipsum
clem: Et ego, si exaltatus fuero a terra, omnia traham ad meipsum.
tr: καγω εαν υψωθω εκ της γης παντας ελκυσω προς εμαυτον
kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

vulg: hoc autem dicebat significans qua morte esset moriturus
clem: (Hoc autem dicebat, significans qua morte esset moriturus.)
tr: τουτο δε ελεγεν σημαινων ποιω θανατω ημελλεν αποθνησκειν
kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

vulg: respondit ei turba nos audivimus ex lege quia Christus manet in aeternum et quomodo tu dicis oportet exaltari Filium hominis quis est iste Filius hominis
clem: Respondit ei turba: Nos audivimus ex lege, quia Christus manet in ternum: et quomodo tu dicis: Oportet exaltari Filium hominis? quis est iste Filius hominis?
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο οχλος ημεις ηκουσαμεν εκ του νομου οτι ο χριστος μενει εις τον αιωνα και πως συ λεγεις οτι δει υψωθηναι τον υιον του ανθρωπου τις εστιν ουτος ο υιος του ανθρωπου
kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

vulg: dixit ergo eis Iesus adhuc modicum lumen in vobis est ambulate dum lucem habetis ut non tenebrae vos conprehendant et qui ambulat in tenebris nescit quo vadat
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Adhuc modicum, lumen in vobis est. Ambulate dum lucem habetis, ut non vos tenebr comprehendant; et qui ambulant in tenebris, nescit quo vadat.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους ετι μικρον χρονον το φως μεθ υμων εστιν περιπατειτε εως το φως εχετε ινα μη σκοτια υμας καταλαβη και ο περιπατων εν τη σκοτια ουκ οιδεν που υπαγει
kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

vulg: dum lucem habetis credite in lucem ut filii lucis sitis haec locutus est Iesus et abiit et abscondit se ab eis
clem: Dum lucem habetis, credite in lucem, ut filii lucis sitis. Hc locutus est Jesus, et abiit et abscondit se ab eis.
tr: εως το φως εχετε πιστευετε εις το φως ινα υιοι φωτος γενησθε ταυτα ελαλησεν ο ιησους και απελθων εκρυβη απ αυτων
kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

vulg: cum autem tanta signa fecisset coram eis non credebant in eum
clem: Cum autem tanta signa fecisset coram eis, non credebant in eum;
tr: τοσαυτα δε αυτου σημεια πεποιηκοτος εμπροσθεν αυτων ουκ επιστευον εις αυτον
kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

vulg: ut sermo Esaiae prophetae impleretur quem dixit Domine quis credidit auditui nostro et brachium Domini cui revelatum est
clem: ut sermo Isai prophet impleretur, quem dixit: [Domine, quis credidit auditui nostro? et brachium Domini cui revelatum est?]
tr: ινα ο λογος ησαιου του προφητου πληρωθη ον ειπεν κυριε τις επιστευσεν τη ακοη ημων και ο βραχιων κυριου τινι απεκαλυφθη
kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

vulg: propterea non poterant credere quia iterum dixit Esaias
clem: Propterea non poterant credere, quia iterum dixit Isaias:
tr: δια τουτο ουκ ηδυναντο πιστευειν οτι παλιν ειπεν ησαιας
kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

vulg: excaecavit oculos eorum et induravit eorum cor ut non videant oculis et intellegant corde et convertantur et sanem eos
clem: [Exccavit oculos eorum, et induravit cor eorum ut non videant oculis, et non intelligant corde, et convertantur, et sanem eos.]
tr: τετυφλωκεν αυτων τους οφθαλμους και πεπωρωκεν αυτων την καρδιαν ινα μη ιδωσιν τοις οφθαλμοις και νοησωσιν τη καρδια και επιστραφωσιν και ιασωμαι αυτους
kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

vulg: haec dixit Esaias quando vidit gloriam eius et locutus est de eo
clem: Hc dixit Isaias, quando vidit gloriam ejus, et locutus est de eo.
tr: ταυτα ειπεν ησαιας οτε ειδεν την δοξαν αυτου και ελαλησεν περι αυτου
kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

vulg: verumtamen et ex principibus multi crediderunt in eum sed propter Pharisaeos non confitebantur ut de synagoga non eicerentur
clem: Verumtamen et ex principibus multi crediderunt in eum: sed propter pharisos non confitebantur, ut e synagoga non ejicerentur.
tr: ομως μεντοι και εκ των αρχοντων πολλοι επιστευσαν εις αυτον αλλα δια τους φαρισαιους ουχ ωμολογουν ινα μη αποσυναγωγοι γενωνται
kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

vulg: dilexerunt enim gloriam hominum magis quam gloriam Dei
clem: Dilexerunt enim gloriam hominum magis quam gloriam Dei.
tr: ηγαπησαν γαρ την δοξαν των ανθρωπων μαλλον ηπερ την δοξαν του θεου
kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

vulg: Iesus autem clamavit et dixit qui credit in me non credit in me sed in eum qui misit me
clem: Jesus autem clamavit, et dixit: Qui credit in me, non credit in me, sed in eum qui misit me.
tr: ιησους δε εκραξεν και ειπεν ο πιστευων εις εμε ου πιστευει εις εμε αλλ εις τον πεμψαντα με
kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

vulg: et qui videt me videt eum qui misit me
clem: Et qui videt me, videt eum qui misit me.
tr: και ο θεωρων εμε θεωρει τον πεμψαντα με
kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

vulg: ego lux in mundum veni ut omnis qui credit in me in tenebris non maneat
clem: Ego lux in mundum veni, ut omnis qui credit in me, in tenebris non maneat.
tr: εγω φως εις τον κοσμον εληλυθα ινα πας ο πιστευων εις εμε εν τη σκοτια μη μεινη
kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

vulg: et si quis audierit verba mea et non custodierit ego non iudico eum non enim veni ut iudicem mundum sed ut salvificem mundum
clem: Et si quis audierit verba mea, et non custodierit, ego non judico eum; non enim veni ut judicem mundum, sed ut salvificem mundum.
tr: και εαν τις μου ακουση των ρηματων και μη πιστευση εγω ου κρινω αυτον ου γαρ ηλθον ινα κρινω τον κοσμον αλλ ινα σωσω τον κοσμον
kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

vulg: qui spernit me et non accipit verba mea habet qui iudicet eum sermo quem locutus sum ille iudicabit eum in novissimo die
clem: Qui spernit me et non accipit verba mea, habet qui judicet eum. Sermo quem locutus sum, ille judicabit eum in novissimo die.
tr: ο αθετων εμε και μη λαμβανων τα ρηματα μου εχει τον κρινοντα αυτον ο λογος ον ελαλησα εκεινος κρινει αυτον εν τη εσχατη ημερα
