kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

vulg: quia ego ex me ipso non sum locutus sed qui misit me Pater ipse mihi mandatum dedit quid dicam et quid loquar
clem: Quia ego ex meipso non sum locutus, sed qui misit me, Pater, ipse mihi mandatum dedit quid dicam et quid loquar.
tr: οτι εγω εξ εμαυτου ουκ ελαλησα αλλ ο πεμψας με πατηρ αυτος μοι εντολην εδωκεν τι ειπω και τι λαλησω
kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

vulg: et scio quia mandatum eius vita aeterna est quae ergo ego loquor sicut dixit mihi Pater sic loquor
clem: Et scio quia mandatum ejus vita terna est: qu ergo ego loquor, sicut dixit mihi Pater, sic loquor.
tr: και οιδα οτι η εντολη αυτου ζωη αιωνιος εστιν α ουν λαλω εγω καθως ειρηκεν μοι ο πατηρ ουτως λαλω
kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

vulg: ante diem autem festum paschae sciens Iesus quia venit eius hora ut transeat ex hoc mundo ad Patrem cum dilexisset suos qui erant in mundo in finem dilexit eos
clem: Ante diem festum Pasch, sciens Jesus quia venit hora ejus ut transeat ex hoc mundo ad Patrem: cum dilexisset suos, qui erant in mundo, in finem dilexit eos.
tr: προ δε της εορτης του πασχα ειδως ο ιησους οτι εληλυθεν αυτου η ωρα ινα μεταβη εκ του κοσμου τουτου προς τον πατερα αγαπησας τους ιδιους τους εν τω κοσμω εις τελος ηγαπησεν αυτους
kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

vulg: et cena facta cum diabolus iam misisset in corde ut traderet eum Iudas Simonis Scariotis
clem: Et cna facta, cum diabolus jam misisset in cor ut traderet eum Judas Simonis Iscariot:
tr: και δειπνου γενομενου του διαβολου ηδη βεβληκοτος εις την καρδιαν ιουδα σιμωνος ισκαριωτου ινα αυτον παραδω
kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

vulg: sciens quia omnia dedit ei Pater in manus et quia a Deo exivit et ad Deum vadit
clem: sciens quia omnia dedit ei Pater in manus, et quia a Deo exivit, et ad Deum vadit:
tr: ειδως ο ιησους οτι παντα δεδωκεν αυτω ο πατηρ εις τας χειρας και οτι απο θεου εξηλθεν και προς τον θεον υπαγει
kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

vulg: surgit a cena et ponit vestimenta sua et cum accepisset linteum praecinxit se
clem: surgit a cna, et ponit vestimenta sua, et cum accepisset linteum, prcinxit se.
tr: εγειρεται εκ του δειπνου και τιθησιν τα ιματια και λαβων λεντιον διεζωσεν εαυτον
kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

vulg: deinde mittit aquam in pelvem et coepit lavare pedes discipulorum et extergere linteo quo erat praecinctus
clem: Deinde mittit aquam in pelvim, et cpit lavare pedes discipulorum, et extergere linteo, quo erat prcinctus.
tr: ειτα βαλλει υδωρ εις τον νιπτηρα και ηρξατο νιπτειν τους ποδας των μαθητων και εκμασσειν τω λεντιω ω ην διεζωσμενος
kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

vulg: venit ergo ad Simonem Petrum et dicit ei Petrus Domine tu mihi lavas pedes
clem: Venit ergo ad Simonem Petrum. Et dicit ei Petrus: Domine, tu mihi lavas pedes?
tr: ερχεται ουν προς σιμωνα πετρον και λεγει αυτω εκεινος κυριε συ μου νιπτεις τους ποδας
kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dicit ei quod ego facio tu nescis modo scies autem postea
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Quod ego facio, tu nescis modo: scies autem postea.
tr: απεκριθη ιησους και ειπεν αυτω ο εγω ποιω συ ουκ οιδας αρτι γνωση δε μετα ταυτα
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

vulg: dicit ei Petrus non lavabis mihi pedes in aeternum respondit Iesus ei si non lavero te non habes partem mecum
clem: Dicit ei Petrus: Non lavabis mihi pedes in ternum. Respondit ei Jesus: Si non lavero te, non habebis partem mecum.
tr: λεγει αυτω πετρος ου μη νιψης τους ποδας μου εις τον αιωνα απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους εαν μη νιψω σε ουκ εχεις μερος μετ εμου
kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

vulg: dicit ei Simon Petrus Domine non tantum pedes meos sed et manus et caput
clem: Dicit ei Simon Petrus: Domine, non tantum pedes meos, sed et manus, et caput.
tr: λεγει αυτω σιμων πετρος κυριε μη τους ποδας μου μονον αλλα και τας χειρας και την κεφαλην
kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus qui lotus est non indiget ut lavet sed est mundus totus et vos mundi estis sed non omnes
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Qui lotus est, non indiget nisi ut pedes lavet, sed est mundus totus. Et vos mundi estis, sed non omnes.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους ο λελουμενος ου χρειαν εχει η τους ποδας νιψασθαι αλλ εστιν καθαρος ολος και υμεις καθαροι εστε αλλ ουχι παντες
kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

vulg: sciebat enim quisnam esset qui traderet eum propterea dixit non estis mundi omnes
clem: Sciebat enim quisnam esset qui traderet eum; propterea dixit: Non estis mundi omnes.
tr: ηδει γαρ τον παραδιδοντα αυτον δια τουτο ειπεν ουχι παντες καθαροι εστε
kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

vulg: postquam ergo lavit pedes eorum et accepit vestimenta sua cum recubuisset iterum dixit eis scitis quid fecerim vobis
clem: Postquam ergo lavit pedes eorum, et accepit vestimenta sua: cum recubuisset iterum, dixit eis: Scitis quid fecerim vobis?
tr: οτε ουν ενιψεν τους ποδας αυτων και ελαβεν τα ιματια αυτου αναπεσων παλιν ειπεν αυτοις γινωσκετε τι πεποιηκα υμιν
kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

vulg: vos vocatis me magister et Domine et bene dicitis sum etenim
clem: Vos vocatis me Magister et Domine, et bene dicitis: sum etenim.
tr: υμεις φωνειτε με ο διδασκαλος και ο κυριος και καλως λεγετε ειμι γαρ
kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

vulg: si ergo ego lavi vestros pedes Dominus et magister et vos debetis alter alterius lavare pedes
clem: Si ergo ego lavi pedes vestros, Dominus et Magister, et vos debetis alter alterutrum lavare pedes.
tr: ει ουν εγω ενιψα υμων τους ποδας ο κυριος και ο διδασκαλος και υμεις οφειλετε αλληλων νιπτειν τους ποδας
kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

vulg: exemplum enim dedi vobis ut quemadmodum ego feci vobis ita et vos faciatis
clem: Exemplum enim dedi vobis, ut quemadmodum ego feci vobis, ita et vos faciatis.
tr: υποδειγμα γαρ εδωκα υμιν ινα καθως εγω εποιησα υμιν και υμεις ποιητε
kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis non est servus maior domino suo neque apostolus maior eo qui misit illum
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: non est servus major domino suo: neque apostolus major est eo qui misit illum.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ουκ εστιν δουλος μειζων του κυριου αυτου ουδε αποστολος μειζων του πεμψαντος αυτον
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

vulg: si haec scitis beati eritis si feceritis ea
clem: Si hc scitis, beati eritis si feceritis ea.
tr: ει ταυτα οιδατε μακαριοι εστε εαν ποιητε αυτα
kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

vulg: non de omnibus vobis dico ego scio quos elegerim sed ut impleatur scriptura qui manducat mecum panem levavit contra me calcaneum suum
clem: Non de omnibus vobis dico: ego scio quos elegerim; sed ut adimpleatur Scriptura: Qui manducat mecum panem, levabit contra me calcaneum suum.
tr: ου περι παντων υμων λεγω εγω οιδα ους εξελεξαμην αλλ ινα η γραφη πληρωθη ο τρωγων μετ εμου τον αρτον επηρεν επ εμε την πτερναν αυτου
kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

vulg: amodo dico vobis priusquam fiat ut credatis cum factum fuerit quia ego sum
clem: Amodo dico vobis, priusquam fiat: ut cum factum fuerit, credatis, quia ego sum.
tr: απ αρτι λεγω υμιν προ του γενεσθαι ινα οταν γενηται πιστευσητε οτι εγω ειμι
kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

vulg: amen amen dico vobis qui accipit si quem misero me accipit qui autem me accipit accipit eum qui me misit
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: qui accipit si quem misero, me accipit; qui autem me accipit, accipit eum qui me misit.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ο λαμβανων εαν τινα πεμψω εμε λαμβανει ο δε εμε λαμβανων λαμβανει τον πεμψαντα με
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

vulg: cum haec dixisset Iesus turbatus est spiritu et protestatus est et dixit amen amen dico vobis quia unus ex vobis tradet me
clem: Cum hc dixisset Jesus, turbatus est spiritu: et protestatus est, et dixit: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia unus ex vobis tradet me.
tr: ταυτα ειπων ο ιησους εταραχθη τω πνευματι και εμαρτυρησεν και ειπεν αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εις εξ υμων παραδωσει με
kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

vulg: aspiciebant ergo ad invicem discipuli haesitantes de quo diceret
clem: Aspiciebant ergo ad invicem discipuli, hsitantes de quo diceret.
tr: εβλεπον ουν εις αλληλους οι μαθηται απορουμενοι περι τινος λεγει
kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

vulg: erat ergo recumbens unus ex discipulis eius in sinu Iesu quem diligebat Iesus
clem: Erat ergo recumbens unus ex discipulis ejus in sinu Jesu, quem diligebat Jesus.
tr: ην δε ανακειμενος εις των μαθητων αυτου εν τω κολπω του ιησου ον ηγαπα ο ιησους
kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

vulg: innuit ergo huic Simon Petrus et dicit ei quis est de quo dicit
clem: Innuit ergo huic Simon Petrus, et dixit ei: Quis est, de quo dicit?
tr: νευει ουν τουτω σιμων πετρος πυθεσθαι τις αν ειη περι ου λεγει
kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

vulg: itaque cum recubuisset ille supra pectus Iesu dicit ei Domine quis est
clem: Itaque cum recubuisset ille supra pectus Jesu, dicit ei: Domine, quis est?
tr: επιπεσων δε εκεινος επι το στηθος του ιησου λεγει αυτω κυριε τις εστιν
kjv: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

vulg: respondit Iesus ille est cui ego intinctum panem porrexero et cum intinxisset panem dedit Iudae Simonis Scariotis
clem: Respondit Jesus: Ille est cui ego intinctum panem porrexero. Et cum intinxisset panem, dedit Jud Simonis Iscariot.
tr: αποκρινεται ο ιησους εκεινος εστιν ω εγω βαψας το ψωμιον επιδωσω και εμβαψας το ψωμιον διδωσιν ιουδα σιμωνος ισκαριωτη
kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

vulg: et post buccellam tunc introivit in illum Satanas dicit ei Iesus quod facis fac citius
clem: Et post buccellam, introivit in eum Satanas. Et dixit ei Jesus: Quod facis, fac citius.
tr: και μετα το ψωμιον τοτε εισηλθεν εις εκεινον ο σατανας λεγει ουν αυτω ο ιησους ο ποιεις ποιησον ταχιον
kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

vulg: hoc autem nemo scivit discumbentium ad quid dixerit ei
clem: Hoc autem nemo scivit discumbentium ad quid dixerit ei.
tr: τουτο δε ουδεις εγνω των ανακειμενων προς τι ειπεν αυτω
kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

vulg: quidam enim putabant quia loculos habebat Iudas quia dicit ei Iesus eme ea quae opus sunt nobis ad diem festum aut egenis ut aliquid daret
clem: Quidam enim putabant, quia loculos habebat Judas, quod dixisset ei Jesus: Eme ea qu opus sunt nobis ad diem festum: aut egenis ut aliquid daret.
tr: τινες γαρ εδοκουν επει το γλωσσοκομον ειχεν ο ιουδας οτι λεγει αυτω ο ιησους αγορασον ων χρειαν εχομεν εις την εορτην η τοις πτωχοις ινα τι δω
kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

vulg: cum ergo accepisset ille buccellam exivit continuo erat autem nox
clem: Cum ergo accepisset ille buccellam, exivit continuo. Erat autem nox.
tr: λαβων ουν το ψωμιον εκεινος ευθεως εξηλθεν ην δε νυξ
kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

vulg: cum ergo exisset dicit Iesus nunc clarificatus est Filius hominis et Deus clarificatus est in eo
clem: Cum ergo exisset, dixit Jesus: Nunc clarificatus est Filius hominis, et Deus clarificatus est in eo.
tr: οτε  ουν  εξηλθεν λεγει ο ιησους νυν εδοξασθη ο υιος του ανθρωπου και ο θεος εδοξασθη εν αυτω
kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

vulg: si Deus clarificatus est in eo et Deus clarificabit eum in semet ipso et continuo clarificabit eum
clem: Si Deus clarificatus est in eo, et Deus clarificabit eum in semetipso: et continuo clarificabit eum.
tr: ει ο θεος εδοξασθη εν αυτω και ο θεος δοξασει αυτον εν εαυτω και ευθυς δοξασει αυτον
kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

vulg: filioli adhuc modicum vobiscum sum quaeretis me et sicut dixi Iudaeis quo ego vado vos non potestis venire et vobis dico modo
clem: Filioli, adhuc modicum vobiscum sum. Quretis me; et sicut dixi Judis, quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire: et vobis dico modo.
tr: τεκνια ετι μικρον μεθ υμων ειμι ζητησετε με και καθως ειπον τοις ιουδαιοις οτι οπου υπαγω εγω υμεις ου δυνασθε ελθειν και υμιν λεγω αρτι
kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

vulg: mandatum novum do vobis ut diligatis invicem sicut dilexi vos ut et vos diligatis invicem
clem: Mandatum novum do vobis: ut diligatis invicem: sicut dilexi vos, ut et vos diligatis invicem.
tr: εντολην καινην διδωμι υμιν ινα αγαπατε αλληλους καθως ηγαπησα υμας ινα και υμεις αγαπατε αλληλους
kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

vulg: in hoc cognoscent omnes quia mei discipuli estis si dilectionem habueritis ad invicem
clem: In hoc cognoscent omnes quia discipuli mei estis, si dilectionem habueritis ad invicem.
tr: εν τουτω γνωσονται παντες οτι εμοι μαθηται εστε εαν αγαπην εχητε εν αλληλοις
kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

vulg: dicit ei Simon Petrus Domine quo vadis respondit Iesus quo ego vado non potes me modo sequi sequeris autem postea
clem: Dicit ei Simon Petrus: Domine, quo vadis? Respondit Jesus: Quo ego vado non potes me modo sequi: sequeris autem postea.
tr: λεγει αυτω σιμων πετρος κυριε που υπαγεις απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους οπου υπαγω ου δυνασαι μοι νυν ακολουθησαι υστερον δε ακολουθησεις μοι
kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

vulg: dicit ei Petrus quare non possum sequi te modo animam meam pro te ponam
clem: Dicit ei Petrus: Quare non possum te sequi modo? animam meam pro te ponam.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο πετρος κυριε δια τι ου δυναμαι σοι ακολουθησαι αρτι την ψυχην μου υπερ σου θησω
kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

vulg: respondit Iesus animam tuam pro me ponis amen amen dico tibi non cantabit gallus donec me ter neges
clem: Respondit ei Jesus: Animam tuam pro me pones? amen, amen dico tibi: non cantabit gallus, donec ter me neges.
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους την ψυχην σου υπερ εμου θησεις αμην αμην λεγω σοι ου μη αλεκτωρ φωνησει εως ου απαρνηση με τρις
kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

vulg: non turbetur cor vestrum creditis in Deum et in me credite
clem: Non turbetur cor vestrum. Creditis in Deum, et in me credite.
tr: μη ταρασσεσθω υμων η καρδια πιστευετε εις τον θεον και εις εμε πιστευετε
kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

vulg: in domo Patris mei mansiones multae sunt si quo minus dixissem vobis quia vado parare vobis locum
clem: In domo Patris mei mansiones mult sunt; si quominus dixissem vobis: quia vado parare vobis locum.
tr: εν τη οικια του πατρος μου μοναι πολλαι εισιν ει δε μη ειπον αν υμιν πορευομαι ετοιμασαι τοπον υμιν
kjv: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

vulg: et si abiero et praeparavero vobis locum iterum venio et accipiam vos ad me ipsum ut ubi sum ego et vos sitis
clem: Et si abiero, et prparavero vobis locum, iterum venio, et accipiam vos ad meipsum: ut ubi sum ego, et vos sitis.
tr: και εαν πορευθω και ετοιμασω υμιν τοπον παλιν ερχομαι και παραληψομαι υμας προς εμαυτον ινα οπου ειμι εγω και υμεις ητε
kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

vulg: et quo ego vado scitis et viam scitis
clem: Et quo ego vado scitis, et viam scitis.
tr: και οπου εγω υπαγω οιδατε και την οδον οιδατε
kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

vulg: dicit ei Thomas Domine nescimus quo vadis et quomodo possumus viam scire
clem: Dicit ei Thomas: Domine, nescimus quo vadis: et quomodo possumus viam scire?
tr: λεγει αυτω θωμας κυριε ουκ οιδαμεν που υπαγεις και πως δυναμεθα την οδον ειδεναι
kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

vulg: dicit ei Iesus ego sum via et veritas et vita nemo venit ad Patrem nisi per me
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Ego sum via, et veritas, et vita. Nemo venit ad Patrem, nisi per me.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους εγω ειμι η οδος και η αληθεια και η ζωη ουδεις ερχεται προς τον πατερα ει μη δι εμου
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

vulg: si cognovissetis me et Patrem meum utique cognovissetis et amodo cognoscitis eum et vidistis eum
clem: Si cognovissetis me, et Patrem meum utique cognovissetis: et amodo cognoscetis eum, et vidistis eum.
tr: ει εγνωκειτε με και τον πατερα μου εγνωκειτε αν και απ αρτι γινωσκετε αυτον και εωρακατε αυτον
kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

vulg: dicit ei Philippus Domine ostende nobis Patrem et sufficit nobis
clem: Dicit ei Philippus: Domine, ostende nobis Patrem, et sufficit nobis.
tr: λεγει αυτω φιλιππος κυριε δειξον ημιν τον πατερα και αρκει ημιν
kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus tanto tempore vobiscum sum et non cognovistis me Philippe qui vidit me vidit et Patrem quomodo tu dicis ostende nobis Patrem
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Tanto tempore vobiscum sum, et non cognovistis me? Philippe, qui videt me, videt et Patrem. Quomodo tu dicis: Ostende nobis Patrem?
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους τοσουτον χρονον μεθ υμων ειμι και ουκ εγνωκας με φιλιππε ο εωρακως εμε εωρακεν τον πατερα και πως συ λεγεις δειξον ημιν τον πατερα
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Show us the Father?

vulg: non credis quia ego in Patre et Pater in me est verba quae ego loquor vobis a me ipso non loquor Pater autem in me manens ipse facit opera
clem: Non creditis quia ego in Patre, et Pater in me est? Verba qu ego loquor vobis, a meipso non loquor. Pater autem in me manens, ipse fecit opera.
tr: ου πιστευεις οτι εγω εν τω πατρι και ο πατηρ εν εμοι εστιν τα ρηματα α εγω λαλω υμιν απ εμαυτου ου λαλω ο δε πατηρ ο εν εμοι μενων αυτος ποιει τα εργα
kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

vulg: non creditis quia ego in Patre et Pater in me est
clem: Non creditis quia ego in Patre, et Pater in me est?
tr: πιστευετε μοι οτι εγω εν τω πατρι και ο πατηρ εν εμοι ει δε μη δια τα εργα αυτα πιστευετε μοι
kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

vulg: alioquin propter opera ipsa credite amen amen dico vobis qui credit in me opera quae ego facio et ipse faciet et maiora horum faciet quia ego ad Patrem vado
clem: alioquin propter opera ipsa credite. Amen, amen dico vobis, qui credit in me, opera qu ego facio, et ipse faciet, et majora horum faciet: quia ego ad Patrem vado.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν ο πιστευων εις εμε τα εργα α εγω ποιω κακεινος ποιησει και μειζονα τουτων ποιησει οτι εγω προς τον πατερα μου πορευομαι
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

vulg: et quodcumque petieritis in nomine meo hoc faciam ut glorificetur Pater in Filio
clem: Et quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, hoc faciam: ut glorificetur Pater in Filio.
tr: και ο τι αν αιτησητε εν τω ονοματι μου τουτο ποιησω ινα δοξασθη ο πατηρ εν τω υιω
kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

vulg: si quid petieritis me in nomine meo hoc faciam
clem: Si quid petieritis me in nomine meo, hoc faciam.
tr: εαν τι αιτησητε εν τω ονοματι μου εγω ποιησω
kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

vulg: si diligitis me mandata mea servate
clem: Si diligitis me, mandata mea servate:
tr: εαν αγαπατε με τας εντολας τας εμας τηρησατε
kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

vulg: et ego rogabo Patrem et alium paracletum dabit vobis ut maneat vobiscum in aeternum
clem: et ego rogabo Patrem, et alium Paraclitum dabit vobis, ut maneat vobiscum in ternum,
tr: και εγω ερωτησω τον πατερα και αλλον παρακλητον δωσει υμιν ινα μενη μεθ υμων εις τον αιωνα
kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

vulg: Spiritum veritatis quem mundus non potest accipere quia non videt eum nec scit eum vos autem cognoscitis eum quia apud vos manebit et in vobis erit
clem: Spiritum veritatis, quem mundus non potest accipere, quia non videt eum, nec scit eum: vos autem cognoscetis eum, quia apud vos manebit, et in vobis erit.
tr: το πνευμα της αληθειας ο ο κοσμος ου δυναται λαβειν οτι ου θεωρει αυτο ουδε γινωσκει αυτο υμεις δε γινωσκετε αυτο οτι παρ υμιν μενει και εν υμιν εσται
kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

vulg: non relinquam vos orfanos veniam ad vos
clem: Non relinquam vos orphanos: veniam ad vos.
tr: ουκ αφησω υμας ορφανους ερχομαι προς υμας
kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

vulg: adhuc modicum et mundus me iam non videt vos autem videtis me quia ego vivo et vos vivetis
clem: Adhuc modicum, et mundus me jam non videt. Vos autem videtis me: quia ego vivo, et vos vivetis.
tr: ετι μικρον και ο κοσμος με ουκ ετι θεωρει υμεις δε θεωρειτε με οτι εγω ζω και υμεις ζησεσθε
kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

vulg: in illo die vos cognoscetis quia ego sum in Patre meo et vos in me et ego in vobis
clem: In illo die vos cognoscetis quia ego sum in Patre meo, et vos in me, et ego in vobis.
tr: εν εκεινη τη ημερα γνωσεσθε υμεις οτι εγω εν τω πατρι μου και υμεις εν εμοι καγω εν υμιν
kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

vulg: qui habet mandata mea et servat ea ille est qui diligit me qui autem diligit me diligetur a Patre meo et ego diligam eum et manifestabo ei me ipsum
clem: Qui habet mandata mea, et servat ea: ille est qui diligit me. Qui autem diligit me, diligetur a Patre meo: et ego diligam eum, et manifestabo ei meipsum.
tr: ο εχων τας εντολας μου και τηρων αυτας εκεινος εστιν ο αγαπων με ο δε αγαπων με αγαπηθησεται υπο του πατρος μου και εγω αγαπησω αυτον και εμφανισω αυτω εμαυτον
kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

vulg: dicit ei Iudas non ille Scariotis Domine quid factum est quia nobis manifestaturus es te ipsum et non mundo
clem: Dicit ei Judas, non ille Iscariotes: Domine, quid factum est, quia manifestaturus es nobis tepisum, et non mundo?
tr: λεγει αυτω ιουδας ουχ ο ισκαριωτης κυριε τι γεγονεν οτι ημιν μελλεις εμφανιζειν σεαυτον και ουχι τω κοσμω
kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

vulg: respondit Iesus et dixit ei si quis diligit me sermonem meum servabit et Pater meus diliget eum et ad eum veniemus et mansiones apud eum faciemus
clem: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei: Si quis diligit me, sermonem meum servabit, et Pater meus diliget eum, et ad eum veniemus, et mansionem apud eum faciemus;
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους και ειπεν αυτω εαν τις αγαπα με τον λογον μου τηρησει και ο πατηρ μου αγαπησει αυτον και προς αυτον ελευσομεθα και μονην παρ αυτω ποιησομεν
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

vulg: qui non diligit me sermones meos non servat et sermonem quem audistis non est meus sed eius qui misit me Patris
clem: qui non diligit me, sermones meos non servat. Et sermonem, quem audistis, non est meus: sed ejus qui misit me, Patris.
tr: ο μη αγαπων με τους λογους μου ου τηρει και ο λογος ον ακουετε ουκ εστιν εμος αλλα του πεμψαντος με πατρος
kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

vulg: haec locutus sum vobis apud vos manens
clem: Hc locutus sum vobis apud vos manens.
tr: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν παρ υμιν μενων
kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

vulg: paracletus autem Spiritus Sanctus quem mittet Pater in nomine meo ille vos docebit omnia et suggeret vobis omnia quaecumque dixero vobis
clem: Paraclitus autem Spiritus Sanctus, quem mittet Pater in nomine meo, ille vos docebit omnia, et suggeret vobis omnia qucumque dixero vobis.
tr: ο δε παρακλητος το πνευμα το αγιον ο πεμψει ο πατηρ εν τω ονοματι μου εκεινος υμας διδαξει παντα και υπομνησει υμας παντα α ειπον υμιν
kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

vulg: pacem relinquo vobis pacem meam do vobis non quomodo mundus dat ego do vobis non turbetur cor vestrum neque formidet
clem: Pacem relinquo vobis, pacem meam do vobis: non quomodo mundus dat, ego do vobis. Non turbetur cor vestrum, neque formidet.
tr: ειρηνην αφιημι υμιν ειρηνην την εμην διδωμι υμιν ου καθως ο κοσμος διδωσιν εγω διδωμι υμιν μη ταρασσεσθω υμων η καρδια μηδε δειλιατω
kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

vulg: audistis quia ego dixi vobis vado et venio ad vos si diligeretis me gauderetis utique quia vado ad Patrem quia Pater maior me est
clem: Audistis quia ego dixi vobis: Vado, et venio ad vos. Si diligeretis me, gauderetis utique, quia vado ad Patrem: quia Pater major me est.
tr: ηκουσατε οτι εγω ειπον υμιν υπαγω και ερχομαι προς υμας ει ηγαπατε με εχαρητε αν οτι ειπον πορευομαι προς τον πατερα οτι ο πατηρ μου μειζων μου εστιν
kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

vulg: et nunc dixi vobis priusquam fiat ut cum factum fuerit credatis
clem: Et nunc dixi vobis priusquam fiat: ut cum factum fuerit, credatis.
tr: και νυν ειρηκα υμιν πριν γενεσθαι ινα οταν γενηται πιστευσητε
kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

vulg: iam non multa loquar vobiscum venit enim princeps mundi huius et in me non habet quicquam
clem: Jam non multa loquar vobiscum: venit enim princeps mundi hujus, et in me non habet quidquam.
tr: ουκ ετι πολλα λαλησω μεθ υμων ερχεται γαρ ο του κοσμου τουτου αρχων και εν εμοι ουκ εχει ουδεν
kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

vulg: sed ut cognoscat mundus quia diligo Patrem et sicut mandatum dedit mihi Pater sic facio surgite eamus hinc
clem: Sed ut cognoscat mundus quia diligo Patrem, et sicut mandatum dedit mihi Pater, sic facio. Surgite, eamus hinc.
tr: αλλ ινα γνω ο κοσμος οτι αγαπω τον πατερα και καθως ενετειλατο μοι ο πατηρ ουτως ποιω εγειρεσθε αγωμεν εντευθεν
kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

vulg: ego sum vitis vera et Pater meus agricola est
clem: Ego sum vitis vera, et Pater meus agricola est.
tr: εγω ειμι η αμπελος η αληθινη και ο πατηρ μου ο γεωργος εστιν
kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

vulg: omnem palmitem in me non ferentem fructum tollet eum et omnem qui fert fructum purgabit eum ut fructum plus adferat
clem: Omnem palmitem in me non ferentem fructum, tollet eum, et omnem qui fert fructum, purgabit eum, ut fructum plus afferat.
tr: παν κλημα εν εμοι μη φερον καρπον αιρει αυτο και παν το καρπον φερον καθαιρει αυτο ινα πλειονα καρπον φερη
kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

vulg: iam vos mundi estis propter sermonem quem locutus sum vobis
clem: Jam vos mundi estis propter sermonem quem locutus sum vobis.
tr: ηδη υμεις καθαροι εστε δια τον λογον ον λελαληκα υμιν
kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

vulg: manete in me et ego in vobis sicut palmes non potest ferre fructum a semet ipso nisi manserit in vite sic nec vos nisi in me manseritis
clem: Manete in me, et ego in vobis. Sicut palmes non potest fere fructum a semetipso, nisi manserit in vite, sic nec vos, nisi in me manseritis.
tr: μεινατε εν εμοι καγω εν υμιν καθως το κλημα ου δυναται καρπον φερειν αφ εαυτου εαν μη μεινη εν τη αμπελω ουτως ουδε υμεις εαν μη εν εμοι μεινητε
kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

vulg: ego sum vitis vos palmites qui manet in me et ego in eo hic fert fructum multum quia sine me nihil potestis facere
clem: Ego sum vitis, vos palmites: qui manet in me, et ego in eo, hic fert fructum multum, quia sine me nihil potestis facere.
tr: εγω ειμι η αμπελος υμεις τα κληματα ο μενων εν εμοι καγω εν αυτω ουτος φερει καρπον πολυν οτι χωρις εμου ου δυνασθε ποιειν ουδεν
kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

vulg: si quis in me non manserit mittetur foras sicut palmes et aruit et colligent eos et in ignem mittunt et ardent
clem: Si quis in me non manserit, mittetur foras sicut palmes, et arescet, et colligent eum, et in ignem mittent, et ardet.
tr: εαν μη τις μεινη εν εμοι εβληθη εξω ως το κλημα και εξηρανθη και συναγουσιν αυτα και εις πυρ βαλλουσιν και καιεται
kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

vulg: si manseritis in me et verba mea in vobis manserint quodcumque volueritis petetis et fiet vobis
clem: Si manseritis in me, et verba mea in vobis manserint, quodcumque volueritis petetis, et fiet vobis.
tr: εαν μεινητε εν εμοι και τα ρηματα μου εν υμιν μεινη ο εαν θελητε αιτησεσθε και γενησεται υμιν
kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

vulg: in hoc clarificatus est Pater meus ut fructum plurimum adferatis et efficiamini mei discipuli
clem: In hoc clarificatus est Pater meus, ut fructum plurimum afferatis, et efficiamini mei discipuli.
tr: εν τουτω εδοξασθη ο πατηρ μου ινα καρπον πολυν φερητε και γενησεσθε εμοι μαθηται
kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

vulg: sicut dilexit me Pater et ego dilexi vos manete in dilectione mea
clem: Sicut dilexit me Pater, et ego dilexi vos. Manete in dilectione mea.
tr: καθως ηγαπησεν με ο πατηρ καγω ηγαπησα υμας μεινατε εν τη αγαπη τη εμη
kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

vulg: si praecepta mea servaveritis manebitis in dilectione mea sicut et ego Patris mei praecepta servavi et maneo in eius dilectione
clem: Si prcepta mea servaveritis, manebitis in dilectione mea, sicut et ego Patris mei prcepta servavi, et maneo in ejus dilectione.
tr: εαν τας εντολας μου τηρησητε μενειτε εν τη αγαπη μου καθως εγω τας εντολας του πατρος μου τετηρηκα και μενω αυτου εν τη αγαπη
kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

vulg: haec locutus sum vobis ut gaudium meum in vobis sit et gaudium vestrum impleatur
clem: Hc locutus sum vobis: ut gaudium meum in vobis sit, et gaudium vestrum impleatur.
tr: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα η χαρα η εμη εν υμιν μεινη και η χαρα υμων πληρωθη
kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

vulg: hoc est praeceptum meum ut diligatis invicem sicut dilexi vos
clem: Hoc est prceptum meum, ut diligatis invicem, sicut dilexi vos.
tr: αυτη εστιν η εντολη η εμη ινα αγαπατε αλληλους καθως ηγαπησα υμας
kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

vulg: maiorem hac dilectionem nemo habet ut animam suam quis ponat pro amicis suis
clem: Majorem hac dilectionem nemo habet, ut animam suam ponat qui pro amicis suis.
tr: μειζονα ταυτης αγαπην ουδεις εχει ινα τις την ψυχην αυτου θη υπερ των φιλων αυτου
kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

vulg: vos amici mei estis si feceritis quae ego praecipio vobis
clem: Vos amici mei estis, si feceritis qu ego prcipio vobis.
tr: υμεις φιλοι μου εστε εαν ποιητε οσα εγω εντελλομαι υμιν
kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

vulg: iam non dico vos servos quia servus nescit quid facit dominus eius vos autem dixi amicos quia omnia quaecumque audivi a Patre meo nota feci vobis
clem: Jam non dicam vos servos: quia servus nescit quid faciat dominus ejus. Vos autem dixi amicos: quia omnia qucumque audivi a Patre meo, nota feci vobis.
tr: ουκετι υμας λεγω δουλους οτι ο δουλος ουκ οιδεν τι ποιει αυτου ο κυριος υμας δε ειρηκα φιλους οτι παντα α ηκουσα παρα του πατρος μου εγνωρισα υμιν
kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

vulg: non vos me elegistis sed ego elegi vos et posui vos ut eatis et fructum adferatis et fructus vester maneat ut quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo det vobis
clem: Non vos me elegistis, sed ego elegi vos, et posui vos ut eatis, et fructum afferatis, et fructus vester maneat: ut quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, det vobis.
tr: ουχ υμεις με εξελεξασθε αλλ εγω εξελεξαμην υμας και εθηκα υμας ινα υμεις υπαγητε και καρπον φερητε και ο καρπος υμων μενη ινα ο τι αν αιτησητε τον πατερα εν τω ονοματι μου δω υμιν
kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

vulg: haec mando vobis ut diligatis invicem
clem: Hc mando vobis: ut diligatis invicem.
tr: ταυτα εντελλομαι υμιν ινα αγαπατε αλληλους
kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

vulg: si mundus vos odit scitote quia me priorem vobis odio habuit
clem: Si mundus vos odit, scitote quia me priorem vobis odio habuit.
tr: ει ο κοσμος υμας μισει γινωσκετε  οτι εμε πρωτον υμων μεμισηκεν
kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

vulg: si de mundo fuissetis mundus quod suum erat diligeret quia vero de mundo non estis sed ego elegi vos de mundo propterea odit vos mundus
clem: Si de mundo fuissetis, mundus quod suum erat diligeret: quia vero de mundo non estis, sed ego elegi vos de mundo, propterea odit vos mundus.
tr: ει εκ του κοσμου ητε ο κοσμος αν το ιδιον εφιλει οτι δε εκ του κοσμου ουκ εστε αλλ εγω εξελεξαμην υμας εκ του κοσμου δια τουτο μισει υμας ο κοσμος
kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

vulg: mementote sermonis mei quem ego dixi vobis non est servus maior domino suo si me persecuti sunt et vos persequentur si sermonem meum servaverunt et vestrum servabunt
clem: Mementote sermonis mei, quem ego dixi vobis: non est servus major domino suo. Si me persecuti sunt, et vos persequentur; si sermonem meum servaverunt, et vestrum servabunt.
tr: μνημονευετε του λογου ου εγω ειπον υμιν ουκ εστιν δουλος μειζων του κυριου αυτου ει εμε εδιωξαν και υμας διωξουσιν ει τον λογον μου ετηρησαν και τον υμετερον τηρησουσιν
kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

vulg: sed haec omnia facient vobis propter nomen meum quia nesciunt eum qui misit me
clem: Sed hc omnia facient vobis propter nomen meum: quia nesciunt eum qui misit me.
tr: αλλα ταυτα παντα ποιησουσιν υμιν δια το ονομα μου οτι ουκ οιδασιν τον πεμψαντα με
kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

vulg: si non venissem et locutus fuissem eis peccatum non haberent nunc autem excusationem non habent de peccato suo
clem: Si non venissem, et locutus fuissem eis, peccatum non haberent: nunc autem excusationem non habent de peccato suo.
tr: ει μη ηλθον και ελαλησα αυτοις αμαρτιαν ουκ ειχον νυν δε προφασιν ουκ εχουσιν περι της αμαρτιας αυτων
kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.

vulg: qui me odit et Patrem meum odit
clem: Qui me odit, et Patrem meum odit.
tr: ο εμε μισων και τον πατερα μου μισει
kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

vulg: si opera non fecissem in eis quae nemo alius fecit peccatum non haberent nunc autem et viderunt et oderunt et me et Patrem meum
clem: Si opera non fecissem in eis qu nemo alius fecit, peccatum non haberent: nunc autem et viderunt, et oderunt et me, et Patrem meum.
tr: ει τα εργα μη εποιησα εν αυτοις α ουδεις αλλος πεποιηκεν αμαρτιαν ουκ ειχον νυν δε και εωρακασιν και μεμισηκασιν και εμε και τον πατερα μου
kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

vulg: sed ut impleatur sermo qui in lege eorum scriptus est quia odio me habuerunt gratis
clem: Sed ut adimpleatur sermo, qui in lege eorum scriptus est: Quia odio habuerunt me gratis.
tr: αλλ ινα πληρωθη ο λογος ο γεγραμμενος εν τω νομω αυτων οτι εμισησαν με δωρεαν
kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

vulg: cum autem venerit paracletus quem ego mittam vobis a Patre Spiritum veritatis qui a Patre procedit ille testimonium perhibebit de me
clem: Cum autem venerit Paraclitus, quem ego mittam vobis a Patre, Spiritum veritatis, qui a Patre procedit, ille testimonium perhibebit de me;
tr: οταν δε ελθη ο παρακλητος ον εγω πεμψω υμιν παρα του πατρος το πνευμα της αληθειας ο παρα του πατρος εκπορευεται εκεινος μαρτυρησει περι εμου
kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

vulg: et vos testimonium perhibetis quia ab initio mecum estis
clem: et vos testimonium perhibebitis, quia ab initio mecum estis.
tr: και υμεις δε μαρτυρειτε οτι απ αρχης μετ εμου εστε
kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

vulg: haec locutus sum vobis ut non scandalizemini
clem: Hc locutus sum vobis, ut non scandalizemini.
tr: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα μη σκανδαλισθητε
kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

vulg: absque synagogis facient vos sed venit hora ut omnis qui interficit vos arbitretur obsequium se praestare Deo
clem: Absque synagogis facient vos: sed venit hora, ut omnis qui interficit vos arbitretur obsequium se prstare Deo.
tr: αποσυναγωγους ποιησουσιν υμας αλλ ερχεται ωρα ινα πας ο αποκτεινας υμας δοξη λατρειαν προσφερειν τω θεω
kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

vulg: et haec facient quia non noverunt Patrem neque me
clem: Et hc facient vobis, quia non noverunt Patrem, neque me.
tr: και ταυτα ποιησουσιν υμιν οτι ουκ εγνωσαν τον πατερα ουδε εμε
kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

vulg: sed haec locutus sum vobis ut cum venerit hora eorum reminiscamini quia ego dixi vobis
clem: Sed hc locutus sum vobis, ut cum venerit hora eorum, reminiscamini quia ego dixi vobis.
tr: αλλα ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα οταν ελθη η ωρα μνημονευητε αυτων οτι εγω ειπον υμιν ταυτα δε υμιν εξ αρχης ουκ ειπον οτι μεθ υμων ημην
kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

vulg: haec autem vobis ab initio non dixi quia vobiscum eram at nunc vado ad eum qui me misit et nemo ex vobis interrogat me quo vadis
clem: Hc autem vobis ab initio non dixi, quia vobiscum eram. Et nunc vado ad eum qui misit me; et nemo ex vobis interrogat me: Quo vadis?
tr: νυν δε υπαγω προς τον πεμψαντα με και ουδεις εξ υμων ερωτα με που υπαγεις
kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

vulg: sed quia haec locutus sum vobis tristitia implevit cor vestrum
clem: sed quia hc locutus sum vobis, tristitia implevit cor vestrum.
tr: αλλ οτι ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν η λυπη πεπληρωκεν υμων την καρδιαν
kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

vulg: sed ego veritatem dico vobis expedit vobis ut ego vadam si enim non abiero paracletus non veniet ad vos si autem abiero mittam eum ad vos
clem: Sed ego veritatem dico vobis: expedit vobis ut ego vadam: si enim non abiero, Paraclitus non veniet ad vos; si autem abiero, mittam eum ad vos.
tr: αλλ εγω την αληθειαν λεγω υμιν συμφερει υμιν ινα εγω απελθω εαν γαρ μη απελθω ο παρακλητος ουκ ελευσεται προς υμας εαν δε πορευθω πεμψω αυτον προς υμας
kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

vulg: et cum venerit ille arguet mundum de peccato et de iustitia et de iudicio
clem: Et cum venerit ille, arguet mundum de peccato, et de justitia, et de judicio.
tr: και ελθων εκεινος ελεγξει τον κοσμον περι αμαρτιας και περι δικαιοσυνης και περι κρισεως
kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

vulg: de peccato quidem quia non credunt in me
clem: De peccato quidem, quia non crediderunt in me.
tr: περι αμαρτιας μεν οτι ου πιστευουσιν εις εμε
kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

vulg: de iustitia vero quia ad Patrem vado et iam non videbitis me
clem: De justitia vero, quia ad Patrem vado, et jam non videbitis me.
tr: περι δικαιοσυνης δε οτι προς τον πατερα μου υπαγω και ουκ ετι θεωρειτε με
kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

vulg: de iudicio autem quia princeps mundi huius iudicatus est
clem: De judicio autem, quia princeps hujus mundi jam judicatus est.
tr: περι δε κρισεως οτι ο αρχων του κοσμου τουτου κεκριται
kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

vulg: adhuc multa habeo vobis dicere sed non potestis portare modo
clem: Adhuc multa habeo vobis dicere, sed non potestis portare modo.
tr: ετι πολλα εχω λεγειν υμιν αλλ ου δυνασθε βασταζειν αρτι
kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

vulg: cum autem venerit ille Spiritus veritatis docebit vos in omnem veritatem non enim loquetur a semet ipso sed quaecumque audiet loquetur et quae ventura sunt adnuntiabit vobis
clem: Cum autem venerit ille Spiritus veritatis, docebit vos omnem veritatem: non enim loquetur a semetipso, sed qucumque audiet loquetur, et qu ventura sunt annuntiabit vobis.
tr: οταν δε ελθη εκεινος το πνευμα της αληθειας οδηγησει υμας εις πασαν την αληθειαν ου γαρ λαλησει αφ εαυτου αλλ οσα αν ακουση λαλησει και τα ερχομενα αναγγελει υμιν
kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

vulg: ille me clarificabit quia de meo accipiet et adnuntiabit vobis
clem: Ille me clarificabit, quia de meo accipiet, et annuntiabit vobis.
tr: εκεινος εμε δοξασει οτι εκ του εμου ληψεται και αναγγελει υμιν
kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

vulg: omnia quaecumque habet Pater mea sunt propterea dixi quia de meo accipit et adnuntiabit vobis
clem: Omnia qucumque habet Pater, mea sunt. Propterea dixi: quia de meo accipiet, et annuntiabit vobis.
tr: παντα οσα εχει ο πατηρ εμα εστιν δια τουτο ειπον οτι εκ του εμου ληψεται και αναγγελει υμιν
kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

vulg: modicum et iam non videbitis me et iterum modicum et videbitis me quia vado ad Patrem
clem: Modicum, et jam non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me: quia vado ad Patrem.
tr: μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με οτι εγω υπαγω προς τον πατερα
kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ex discipulis eius ad invicem quid est hoc quod dicit nobis modicum et non videbitis me et iterum modicum et videbitis me et quia vado ad Patrem
clem: Dixerunt ergo ex discipulis ejus ad invicem: Quid est hoc quod dicit nobis: Modicum, et non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me, et quia vado ad Patrem?
tr: ειπον ουν εκ των μαθητων αυτου προς αλληλους τι εστιν τουτο ο λεγει ημιν μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με και οτι εγω υπαγω προς τον πατερα
kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

vulg: dicebant ergo quid est hoc quod dicit modicum nescimus quid loquitur
clem: Dicebant ergo: Quid est hoc quod dicit: Modicum? nescimus quid loquitur.
tr: ελεγον ουν τουτο τι εστιν ο λεγει το μικρον ουκ οιδαμεν τι λαλει
kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

vulg: cognovit autem Iesus quia volebant eum interrogare et dixit eis de hoc quaeritis inter vos quia dixi modicum et non videbitis me et iterum modicum et videbitis me
clem: Cognovit autem Jesus, quia volebant eum interrogare, et dixit eis: De hoc quritis inter vos quia dixi: Modicum, et non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me.
tr: εγνω ουν ο ιησους οτι ηθελον αυτον ερωταν και ειπεν αυτοις περι τουτου ζητειτε μετ αλληλων οτι ειπον μικρον και ου θεωρειτε με και παλιν μικρον και οψεσθε με
kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

vulg: amen amen dico vobis quia plorabitis et flebitis vos mundus autem gaudebit vos autem contristabimini sed tristitia vestra vertetur in gaudium
clem: Amen, amen dico vobis: quia plorabitis, et flebitis vos, mundus autem gaudebit; vos autem contristabimini, sed tristitia vestra vertetur in gaudium.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι κλαυσετε και θρηνησετε υμεις ο δε κοσμος χαρησεται υμεις δε λυπηθησεσθε αλλ η λυπη υμων εις χαραν γενησεται
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

vulg: mulier cum parit tristitiam habet quia venit hora eius cum autem pepererit puerum iam non meminit pressurae propter gaudium quia natus est homo in mundum
clem: Mulier cum parit, tristitiam habet, quia venit hora ejus; cum autem pepererit puerum, jam non meminit pressur propter gaudium, quia natus est homo in mundum.
tr: η γυνη οταν τικτη λυπην εχει οτι ηλθεν η ωρα αυτης οταν δε γεννηση το παιδιον ουκ ετι μνημονευει της θλιψεως δια την χαραν οτι εγεννηθη ανθρωπος εις τον κοσμον
kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

vulg: et vos igitur nunc quidem tristitiam habetis iterum autem videbo vos et gaudebit cor vestrum et gaudium vestrum nemo tollit a vobis
clem: Et vos igitur nunc quidem tristitiam habetis, iterum autem videbo vos, et gaudebit cor vestrum: et gaudium vestrum nemo tollet a vobis.
tr: και υμεις ουν λυπην μεν νυν εχετε παλιν δε οψομαι υμας και χαρησεται υμων η καρδια και την χαραν υμων ουδεις αιρει αφ υμων
kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

vulg: et in illo die me non rogabitis quicquam amen amen dico vobis si quid petieritis Patrem in nomine meo dabit vobis
clem: Et in illo die me non rogabitis quidquam. Amen, amen dico vobis: si quid petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, dabit vobis.
tr: και εν εκεινη τη ημερα εμε ουκ ερωτησετε ουδεν αμην αμην λεγω υμιν οτι οσα αν αιτησητε τον πατερα εν τω ονοματι μου δωσει υμιν
kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

vulg: usque modo non petistis quicquam in nomine meo petite et accipietis ut gaudium vestrum sit plenum
clem: Usque modo non petistis quidquam in nomine meo: petite, et accipietis, ut gaudium vestrum sit plenum.
tr: εως αρτι ουκ ητησατε ουδεν εν τω ονοματι μου αιτειτε και ληψεσθε ινα η χαρα υμων η πεπληρωμενη
kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

vulg: haec in proverbiis locutus sum vobis venit hora cum iam non in proverbiis loquar vobis sed palam de Patre adnuntiabo vobis
clem: Hc in proverbiis locutus sum vobis. Venit hora cum jam non in proverbiis loquar vobis, sed palam de Patre annuntiabo vobis:
tr: ταυτα εν παροιμιαις λελαληκα υμιν αλλ   ερχεται ωρα οτε ουκ ετι εν παροιμιαις λαλησω υμιν αλλα παρρησια περι του πατρος αναγγελω υμιν
kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

vulg: illo die in nomine meo petetis et non dico vobis quia ego rogabo Patrem de vobis
clem: in illo die in nomine meo petetis: et non dico vobis quia ego rogabo Patrem de vobis:
tr: εν εκεινη τη ημερα εν τω ονοματι μου αιτησεσθε και ου λεγω υμιν οτι εγω ερωτησω τον πατερα περι υμων
kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

vulg: ipse enim Pater amat vos quia vos me amastis et credidistis quia ego a Deo exivi
clem: ipse enim Pater amat vos, quia vos me amastis, et credidistis, quia ego a Deo exivi.
tr: αυτος γαρ ο πατηρ φιλει υμας οτι υμεις εμε πεφιληκατε και πεπιστευκατε οτι εγω παρα του θεου εξηλθον
kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

vulg: exivi a Patre et veni in mundum iterum relinquo mundum et vado ad Patrem
clem: Exivi a Patre, et veni in mundum: iterum relinquo mundum, et vado ad Patrem.
tr: εξηλθον παρα του πατρος και εληλυθα εις τον κοσμον παλιν αφιημι τον κοσμον και πορευομαι προς τον πατερα
kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

vulg: dicunt ei discipuli eius ecce nunc palam loqueris et proverbium nullum dicis
clem: Dicunt ei discipuli ejus: Ecce nunc palam loqueris, et proverbium nullum dicis:
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ιδε νυν παρρησια λαλεις και παροιμιαν ουδεμιαν λεγεις
kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

vulg: nunc scimus quia scis omnia et non opus est tibi ut quis te interroget in hoc credimus quia a Deo existi
clem: nunc scimus quia scis omnia, et non opus est tibi ut quis te interroget: in hoc credimus quia a Deo existi.
tr: νυν οιδαμεν οτι οιδας παντα και ου χρειαν εχεις ινα τις σε ερωτα εν τουτω πιστευομεν οτι απο θεου εξηλθες
kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

vulg: respondit eis Iesus modo creditis
clem: Respondit eis Jesus: Modo creditis?
tr: απεκριθη αυτοις ο ιησους αρτι πιστευετε
kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

vulg: ecce venit hora et iam venit ut dispergamini unusquisque in propria et me solum relinquatis et non sum solus quia Pater mecum est
clem: ecce venit hora, et jam venit, ut dispergamini unusquisque in propria, et me solum relinquatis: et non sum solus, quia Pater mecum est.
tr: ιδου ερχεται ωρα και νυν εληλυθεν ινα σκορπισθητε εκαστος εις τα ιδια και εμε μονον αφητε και ουκ ειμι μονος οτι ο πατηρ μετ εμου εστιν
kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

vulg: haec locutus sum vobis ut in me pacem habeatis in mundo pressuram habetis sed confidite ego vici mundum
clem: Hc locutus sum vobis, ut in me pacem habeatis. In mundo pressuram habebitis: sed confidite, ego vici mundum.
tr: ταυτα λελαληκα υμιν ινα εν εμοι ειρηνην εχητε εν τω κοσμω θλιψιν εχετε  εξετε  αλλα θαρσειτε εγω νενικηκα τον κοσμον
kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

vulg: haec locutus est Iesus et sublevatis oculis in caelum dixit Pater venit hora clarifica Filium tuum ut Filius tuus clarificet te
clem: Hc locutus est Jesus: et sublevatis oculis in clum, dixit: Pater, venit hora: clarifica Filium tuum, ut Filius tuus clarificet te:
tr: ταυτα ελαλησεν ο ιησους και επηρεν τους οφθαλμους αυτου εις τον ουρανον και ειπεν πατερ εληλυθεν η ωρα δοξασον σου τον υιον ινα και ο υιος σου δοξαση σε
kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

vulg: sicut dedisti ei potestatem omnis carnis ut omne quod dedisti ei det eis vitam aeternam
clem: sicut dedisti ei potestatem omnis carnis, ut omne, quod dedisti ei, det eis vitam ternam.
tr: καθως εδωκας αυτω εξουσιαν πασης σαρκος ινα παν ο δεδωκας αυτω δωση αυτοις ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

vulg: haec est autem vita aeterna ut cognoscant te solum verum Deum et quem misisti Iesum Christum
clem: Hc est autem vita terna: ut cognoscant te, solum Deum verum, et quem misisti Jesum Christum.
tr: αυτη δε εστιν η αιωνιος ζωη ινα γινωσκωσιν σε τον μονον αληθινον θεον και ον απεστειλας ιησουν χριστον
kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

vulg: ego te clarificavi super terram opus consummavi quod dedisti mihi ut faciam
clem: Ego te clarificavi super terram: opus consummavi, quod dedisti mihi ut faciam:
tr: εγω σε εδοξασα επι της γης το εργον ετελειωσα ο δεδωκας μοι ινα ποιησω
kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

vulg: et nunc clarifica me tu Pater apud temet ipsum claritatem quam habui priusquam mundus esset apud te
clem: et nunc clarifica me tu, Pater, apud temetipsum, claritate quam habui, prius quam mundus esset, apud te.
tr: και νυν δοξασον με συ πατερ παρα σεαυτω τη δοξη η ειχον προ του τον κοσμον ειναι παρα σοι
kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

vulg: manifestavi nomen tuum hominibus quos dedisti mihi de mundo tui erant et mihi eos dedisti et sermonem tuum servaverunt
clem: Manifestavi nomen tuum hominibus, quos dedisti mihi de mundo: tui erant, et mihi eos dedisti: et sermonem tuum servaverunt.
tr: εφανερωσα σου το ονομα τοις ανθρωποις ους δεδωκας μοι εκ του κοσμου σοι ησαν και εμοι αυτους δεδωκας και τον λογον σου τετηρηκασιν
kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

vulg: nunc cognoverunt quia omnia quae dedisti mihi abs te sunt
clem: Nunc cognoverunt quia omnia qu dedisti mihi, abs te sunt:
tr: νυν εγνωκαν οτι παντα οσα δεδωκας μοι παρα σου εστιν
kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

vulg: quia verba quae dedisti mihi dedi eis et ipsi acceperunt et cognoverunt vere quia a te exivi et crediderunt quia tu me misisti
clem: quia verba qu dedisti mihi, dedi eis: et ipsi acceperunt, et cognoverunt vere quia a te exivi, et crediderunt quia tu me misisti.
tr: οτι τα ρηματα α δεδωκας μοι δεδωκα αυτοις και αυτοι ελαβον και εγνωσαν αληθως οτι παρα σου εξηλθον και επιστευσαν οτι συ με απεστειλας
kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

vulg: ego pro eis rogo non pro mundo rogo sed pro his quos dedisti mihi quia tui sunt
clem: Ego pro eis rogo; non pro mundo rogo, sed pro his quos dedisti mihi: quia tui sunt:
tr: εγω περι αυτων ερωτω ου περι του κοσμου ερωτω αλλα περι ων δεδωκας μοι οτι σοι εισιν
kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

vulg: et mea omnia tua sunt et tua mea sunt et clarificatus sum in eis
clem: et mea omnia tua sunt, et tua mea sunt: et clarificatus sum in eis.
tr: και τα εμα παντα σα εστιν και τα σα εμα και δεδοξασμαι εν αυτοις
kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

vulg: et iam non sum in mundo et hii in mundo sunt et ego ad te venio Pater sancte serva eos in nomine tuo quos dedisti mihi ut sint unum sicut et nos
clem: Et jam non sum in mundo, et hi in mundo sunt, et ego ad te venio. Pater sancte, serva eos in nomine tuo, quos dedisti mihi: ut sint unum, sicut et nos.
tr: και ουκ ετι ειμι εν τω κοσμω και ουτοι εν τω κοσμω εισιν και εγω προς σε ερχομαι πατερ αγιε τηρησον αυτους εν τω ονοματι σου ους δεδωκας μοι ινα ωσιν εν καθως ημεις
kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

vulg: cum essem cum eis ego servabam eos in nomine tuo quos dedisti mihi custodivi et nemo ex his perivit nisi filius perditionis ut scriptura impleatur
clem: Cum essem cum eis, ego servabam eos in nomine tuo. Quos dedisti mihi, custodivi: et nemo ex eis periit, nisi filius perditionis, ut Scriptura impleatur.
tr: οτε ημην μετ αυτων εν τω κοσμω εγω ετηρουν αυτους εν τω ονοματι σου ους δεδωκας μοι εφυλαξα και ουδεις εξ αυτων απωλετο ει μη ο υιος της απωλειας ινα η γραφη πληρωθη
kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

vulg: nunc autem ad te venio et haec loquor in mundo ut habeant gaudium meum impletum in semet ipsis
clem: Nunc autem ad te venio: et hc loquor in mundo, ut habeant gaudium meum impletum in semetipsis.
tr: νυν δε προς σε ερχομαι και ταυτα λαλω εν τω κοσμω ινα εχωσιν την χαραν την εμην πεπληρωμενην εν αυτοις
kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

vulg: ego dedi eis sermonem tuum et mundus odio eos habuit quia non sunt de mundo sicut et ego non sum de mundo
clem: Ego dedi eis sermonem tuum, et mundus eos odio habuit, quia non sunt de mundo, sicut et ego non sum de mundo.
tr: εγω δεδωκα αυτοις τον λογον σου και ο κοσμος εμισησεν αυτους οτι ουκ εισιν εκ του κοσμου καθως εγω ουκ ειμι εκ του κοσμου
kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

vulg: non rogo ut tollas eos de mundo sed ut serves eos ex malo
clem: Non rogo ut tollas eos de mundo, sed ut serves eos a malo.
tr: ουκ ερωτω ινα αρης αυτους εκ του κοσμου αλλ ινα τηρησης αυτους εκ του πονηρου
kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

vulg: de mundo non sunt sicut et ego non sum de mundo
clem: De mundo non sunt, sicut et ego non sum de mundo.
tr: εκ του κοσμου ουκ εισιν καθως εγω εκ του κοσμου ουκ ειμι
kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

vulg: sanctifica eos in veritate sermo tuus veritas est
clem: Sanctifica eos in veritate. Sermo tuus veritas est.
tr: αγιασον αυτους εν τη αληθεια σου ο λογος ο σος αληθεια εστιν
kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

vulg: sicut me misisti in mundum et ego misi eos in mundum
clem: Sicut tu me misisti in mundum, et ego misi eos in mundum:
tr: καθως εμε απεστειλας εις τον κοσμον καγω απεστειλα αυτους εις τον κοσμον
kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

vulg: et pro eis ego sanctifico me ipsum ut sint et ipsi sanctificati in veritate
clem: et pro eis ego sanctificabo meipsum: ut sint et ipsi sanctificati in veritate.
tr: και υπερ αυτων εγω αγιαζω εμαυτον ινα και αυτοι ωσιν ηγιασμενοι εν αληθεια
kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

vulg: non pro his autem rogo tantum sed et pro eis qui credituri sunt per verbum eorum in me
clem: Non pro eis rogo tantum, sed et pro eis qui credituri sunt per verbum eorum in me:
tr: ου περι τουτων δε ερωτω μονον αλλα και περι των πιστευσοντων δια του λογου αυτων εις εμε
kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

vulg: ut omnes unum sint sicut tu Pater in me et ego in te ut et ipsi in nobis unum sint ut mundus credat quia tu me misisti
clem: ut omnes unum sint, sicut tu Pater in me, et ego in te, ut et ipsi in nobis unum sint: ut credat mundus, quia tu me misisti.
tr: ινα παντες εν ωσιν καθως συ πατερ εν εμοι καγω εν σοι ινα και αυτοι εν ημιν εν ωσιν ινα ο κοσμος πιστευση οτι συ με απεστειλας
kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

vulg: et ego claritatem quam dedisti mihi dedi eis ut sint unum sicut nos unum sumus
clem: Et ego claritatem, quam dedisti mihi, dedi eis: ut sint unum, sicut et nos unum sumus.
tr: και εγω την δοξαν ην δεδωκας μοι δεδωκα αυτοις ινα ωσιν εν καθως ημεις εν εσμεν
kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

vulg: ego in eis et tu in me ut sint consummati in unum et cognoscat mundus quia tu me misisti et dilexisti eos sicut me dilexisti
clem: Ego in eis, et tu in me: ut sint consummati in unum: et cognoscat mundus quia tu me misisti, et dilexisti eos, sicut et me dilexisti.
tr: εγω εν αυτοις και συ εν εμοι ινα ωσιν τετελειωμενοι εις εν και ινα γινωσκη ο κοσμος οτι συ με απεστειλας και ηγαπησας αυτους καθως εμε ηγαπησας
kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

vulg: Pater quos dedisti mihi volo ut ubi ego sum et illi sint mecum ut videant claritatem meam quam dedisti mihi quia dilexisti me ante constitutionem mundi
clem: Pater, quos dedisti mihi, volo ut ubi sum ego, et illi sint mecum: ut videant claritatem meam, quam dedisti mihi: quia dilexisti me ante constitutionem mundi.
tr: πατερ ους δεδωκας μοι θελω ινα οπου ειμι εγω κακεινοι ωσιν μετ εμου ινα θεωρωσιν την δοξαν την εμην ην εδωκας μοι οτι ηγαπησας με προ καταβολης κοσμου
kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

vulg: Pater iuste et mundus te non cognovit ego autem te cognovi et hii cognoverunt quia tu me misisti
clem: Pater juste, mundus te non cognovit, ego autem te cognovi: et hi cognoverunt, quia tu me misisti.
tr: πατερ δικαιε και ο κοσμος σε ουκ εγνω εγω δε σε εγνων και ουτοι εγνωσαν οτι συ με απεστειλας
kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

vulg: et notum feci eis nomen tuum et notum faciam ut dilectio qua dilexisti me in ipsis sit et ego in ipsis
clem: Et notum feci eis nomen tuum, et notum faciam: ut dilectio, qua dilexisti me, in ipsis sit, et ego in ipsis.
tr: και εγνωρισα αυτοις το ονομα σου και γνωρισω ινα η αγαπη ην ηγαπησας με εν αυτοις η καγω εν αυτοις
kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

vulg: haec cum dixisset Iesus egressus est cum discipulis suis trans torrentem Cedron ubi erat hortus in quem introivit ipse et discipuli eius
clem: Hc cum dixisset Jesus, egressus est cum discipulis suis trans torrentem Cedron, ubi erat hortus, in quem introivit ipse, et discipuli ejus.
tr: ταυτα ειπων ο ιησους εξηλθεν συν τοις μαθηταις αυτου περαν του χειμαρρου των κεδρων οπου ην κηπος εις ον εισηλθεν αυτος και οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

vulg: sciebat autem et Iudas qui tradebat eum ipsum locum quia frequenter Iesus convenerat illuc cum discipulis suis
clem: Sciebat autem et Judas, qui tradebat eum, locum: quia frequenter Jesus convenerat illuc cum discipulis suis.
tr: ηδει δε και ιουδας ο παραδιδους αυτον τον τοπον οτι πολλακις συνηχθη ο ιησους εκει μετα των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

vulg: Iudas ergo cum accepisset cohortem et a pontificibus et Pharisaeis ministros venit illuc cum lanternis et facibus et armis
clem: Judas ergo cum accepisset cohortem, et a pontificibus et pharisis ministros, venit illuc cum laternis, et facibus, et armis.
tr: ο ουν ιουδας λαβων την σπειραν και εκ των αρχιερεων και φαρισαιων υπηρετας ερχεται εκει μετα φανων και λαμπαδων και οπλων
kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

vulg: Iesus itaque sciens omnia quae ventura erant super eum processit et dicit eis quem quaeritis
clem: Jesus itaque sciens omnia qu ventura erant super eum, processit, et dixit eis: Quem quritis?
tr: ιησους ουν ειδως παντα τα ερχομενα επ αυτον εξελθων ειπεν αυτοις τινα ζητειτε
kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

vulg: responderunt ei Iesum Nazarenum dicit eis Iesus ego sum stabat autem et Iudas qui tradebat eum cum ipsis
clem: Responderunt ei: Jesum Nazarenum. Dicit eis Jesus: Ego sum. Stabat autem et Judas, qui tradebat eum, cum ipsis.
tr: απεκριθησαν αυτω ιησουν τον ναζωραιον λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους εγω ειμι ειστηκει δε και ιουδας ο παραδιδους αυτον μετ αυτων
kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

vulg: ut ergo dixit eis ego sum abierunt retrorsum et ceciderunt in terram
clem: Ut ergo dixit eis: Ego sum: abierunt retrorsum, et ceciderunt in terram.
tr: ως ουν ειπεν αυτοις οτι εγω ειμι απηλθον εις τα οπισω και επεσον χαμαι
kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

vulg: iterum ergo eos interrogavit quem quaeritis illi autem dixerunt Iesum Nazarenum
clem: Iterum ergo interrogavit eos: Quem quritis? Illi autem dixerunt: Jesum Nazarenum.
tr: παλιν ουν αυτους επηρωτησεν τινα ζητειτε οι δε ειπον ιησουν τον ναζωραιον
kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

vulg: respondit Iesus dixi vobis quia ego sum si ergo me quaeritis sinite hos abire
clem: Respondit Jesus: Dixi vobis, quia ego sum: si ergo me quritis, sinite hos abire.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους ειπον υμιν οτι εγω ειμι ει ουν εμε ζητειτε αφετε τουτους υπαγειν
kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

vulg: ut impleretur sermo quem dixit quia quos dedisti mihi non perdidi ex ipsis quemquam
clem: Ut impleretur sermo, quem dixit: Quia quos dedisti mihi, non perdidi ex eis quemquam.
tr: ινα πληρωθη ο λογος ον ειπεν οτι ους δεδωκας μοι ουκ απωλεσα εξ αυτων ουδενα
kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

vulg: Simon ergo Petrus habens gladium eduxit eum et percussit pontificis servum et abscidit eius auriculam dextram erat autem nomen servo Malchus
clem: Simon ergo Petrus habens gladium eduxit eum: et percussit pontificis servum, et abscidit auriculam ejus dexteram. Erat autem nomen servo Malchus.
tr: σιμων ουν πετρος εχων μαχαιραν ειλκυσεν αυτην και επαισεν τον του αρχιερεως δουλον και απεκοψεν αυτου το ωτιον το δεξιον ην δε ονομα τω δουλω μαλχος
kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

vulg: dixit ergo Iesus Petro mitte gladium in vaginam calicem quem dedit mihi Pater non bibam illum
clem: Dixit ergo Jesus Petro: Mitte gladium tuum in vaginam. Calicem, quem dedit mihi Pater, non bibam illum?
tr: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους τω πετρω βαλε την μαχαιραν σου εις την θηκην το ποτηριον ο δεδωκεν μοι ο πατηρ ου μη πιω αυτο
kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

vulg: cohors ergo et tribunus et ministri Iudaeorum conprehenderunt Iesum et ligaverunt eum
clem: Cohors ergo, et tribunus, et ministri Judorum comprehenderunt Jesum, et ligaverunt eum.
tr: η ουν σπειρα και ο χιλιαρχος και οι υπηρεται των ιουδαιων συνελαβον τον ιησουν και εδησαν αυτον
kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

vulg: et adduxerunt eum ad Annam primum erat enim socer Caiaphae qui erat pontifex anni illius
clem: Et adduxerunt eum ad Annam primum: erat enim socer Caiph, qui erat pontifex anni illius.
tr: και απηγαγον αυτον προς ανναν πρωτον ην γαρ πενθερος του καιαφα ος ην αρχιερευς του ενιαυτου εκεινου
kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

vulg: erat autem Caiaphas qui consilium dederat Iudaeis quia expedit unum hominem mori pro populo
clem: Erat autem Caiphas, qui consilium dederat Judis: Quia expedit unum hominem mori pro populo.
tr: ην δε καιαφας ο συμβουλευσας τοις ιουδαιοις οτι συμφερει ενα ανθρωπον απολεσθαι υπερ του λαου
kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

vulg: sequebatur autem Iesum Simon Petrus et alius discipulus discipulus autem ille erat notus pontifici et introivit cum Iesu in atrium pontificis
clem: Sequebatur autem Jesum Simon Petrus, et alius discipulus. Discipulus autem ille erat notus pontifici, et introivit cum Jesu in atrium pontificis.
tr: ηκολουθει δε τω ιησου σιμων πετρος και ο   αλλος μαθητης ο δε μαθητης εκεινος ην γνωστος τω αρχιερει και συνεισηλθεν τω ιησου εις την αυλην του αρχιερεως
kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

vulg: Petrus autem stabat ad ostium foris exivit ergo discipulus alius qui erat notus pontifici et dixit ostiariae et introduxit Petrum
clem: Petrus autem stabat ad ostium foris. Exivit ergo discipulus alius, qui erat notus pontifici, et dixit ostiari: et introduxit Petrum.
tr: ο δε πετρος ειστηκει προς τη θυρα εξω εξηλθεν ουν ο μαθητης ο αλλος ος ην γνωστος τω αρχιερει και ειπεν τη θυρωρω και εισηγαγεν τον πετρον
kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

vulg: dicit ergo Petro ancilla ostiaria numquid et tu ex discipulis es hominis istius dicit ille non sum
clem: Dicit ergo Petro ancilla ostiaria: Numquid et tu ex discipulis es hominis istius? Dicit ille: Non sum.
tr: λεγει ουν η παιδισκη η θυρωρος τω πετρω μη και συ εκ των μαθητων ει του ανθρωπου τουτου λεγει εκεινος ουκ ειμι
kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

vulg: stabant autem servi et ministri ad prunas quia frigus erat et calefiebant erat autem cum eis et Petrus stans et calefaciens se
clem: Stabant autem servi et ministri ad prunas, quia frigus erat, et calefaciebant se: erat autem cum eis et Petrus stans, et calefaciens se.
tr: ειστηκεισαν δε οι δουλοι και οι υπηρεται ανθρακιαν πεποιηκοτες οτι ψυχος ην και εθερμαινοντο ην δε μετ αυτων ο πετρος εστως και θερμαινομενος
kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

vulg: pontifex ergo interrogavit Iesum de discipulis suis et de doctrina eius
clem: Pontifex ergo interrogavit Jesum de discipulis suis, et de doctrina ejus.
tr: ο ουν αρχιερευς ηρωτησεν τον ιησουν περι των μαθητων αυτου και περι της διδαχης αυτου
kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

vulg: respondit ei Iesus ego palam locutus sum mundo ego semper docui in synagoga et in templo quo omnes Iudaei conveniunt et in occulto locutus sum nihil
clem: Respondit ei Jesus: Ego palam locutus sum mundo: ego semper docui in synagoga, et in templo, quo omnes Judi conveniunt, et in occulto locutus sum nihil.
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους εγω παρρησια ελαλησα τω κοσμω εγω παντοτε εδιδαξα εν τη συναγωγη και εν τω ιερω οπου παντοτε οι ιουδαιοι συνερχονται και εν κρυπτω ελαλησα ουδεν
kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

vulg: quid me interrogas interroga eos qui audierunt quid locutus sum ipsis ecce hii sciunt quae dixerim ego
clem: Quid me interrogas? interroga eos qui audierunt quid locutus sim ipsis: ecce hi sciunt qu dixerim ego.
tr: τι με επερωτας επερωτησον τους ακηκοοτας τι ελαλησα αυτοις ιδε ουτοι οιδασιν α ειπον εγω
kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

vulg: haec autem cum dixisset unus adsistens ministrorum dedit alapam Iesu dicens sic respondes pontifici
clem: Hc autem cum dixisset, unus assistens ministrorum dedit alapam Jesu, dicens: Sic respondes pontifici?
tr: ταυτα δε αυτου ειποντος εις των υπηρετων παρεστηκως εδωκεν ραπισμα τω ιησου ειπων ουτως αποκρινη τω αρχιερει
kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

vulg: respondit ei Iesus si male locutus sum testimonium perhibe de malo si autem bene quid me caedis
clem: Respondit ei Jesus: Si male locutus sum, testimonium perhibe de malo: si autem bene, quid me cdis?
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους ει κακως ελαλησα μαρτυρησον περι του κακου ει δε καλως τι με δερεις
kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

vulg: et misit eum Annas ligatum ad Caiaphan pontificem
clem: Et misit eum Annas ligatum ad Caipham pontificem.
tr: απεστειλεν  ουν  αυτον ο αννας δεδεμενον προς καιαφαν τον αρχιερεα
kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

vulg: erat autem Simon Petrus stans et calefaciens se dixerunt ergo ei numquid et tu ex discipulis eius es negavit ille et dixit non sum
clem: Erat autem Simon Petrus stans, et calefaciens se. Dixerunt ergo ei: Numquid et tu ex discipulis ejus es? Negavit ille, et dixit: Non sum.
tr: ην δε σιμων πετρος εστως και θερμαινομενος ειπον ουν αυτω μη και συ εκ των μαθητων αυτου ει ηρνησατο εκεινος και ειπεν ουκ ειμι
kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

vulg: dicit unus ex servis pontificis cognatus eius cuius abscidit Petrus auriculam nonne ego te vidi in horto cum illo
clem: Dicit ei unus ex servis pontificis, cognatus ejus, cujus abscidit Petrus auriculam: Nonne ego te vidi in horto cum illo?
tr: λεγει εις εκ των δουλων του αρχιερεως συγγενης ων ου απεκοψεν πετρος το ωτιον ουκ εγω σε ειδον εν τω κηπω μετ αυτου
kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

vulg: iterum ergo negavit Petrus et statim gallus cantavit
clem: Iterum ergo negavit Petrus: et statim gallus cantavit.
tr: παλιν ουν ηρνησατο ο πετρος και ευθεως αλεκτωρ εφωνησεν
kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

vulg: adducunt ergo Iesum a Caiapha in praetorium erat autem mane et ipsi non introierunt in praetorium ut non contaminarentur sed manducarent pascha
