clem: Adducunt ergo Jesum a Caipha in prtorium. Erat autem mane: et ipsi non introierunt in prtorium, ut non contaminarentur, sed ut manducarent Pascha.
tr: αγουσιν ουν τον ιησουν απο του καιαφα εις το πραιτωριον ην δε πρωια και αυτοι ουκ εισηλθον εις το πραιτωριον ινα μη μιανθωσιν αλλ ινα φαγωσιν το πασχα
kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

vulg: exivit ergo Pilatus ad eos foras et dixit quam accusationem adfertis adversus hominem hunc
clem: Exivit ergo Pilatus ad eos foras, et dixit: Quam accusationem affertis adversus hominem hunc?
tr: εξηλθεν ουν ο πιλατος προς αυτους και ειπεν τινα κατηγοριαν φερετε κατα του ανθρωπου τουτου
kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

vulg: responderunt et dixerunt ei si non esset hic malefactor non tibi tradidissemus eum
clem: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei: Si non esset hic malefactor, non tibi tradidissemus eum.
tr: απεκριθησαν και ειπον αυτω ει μη ην ουτος κακοποιος ουκ αν σοι παρεδωκαμεν αυτον
kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

vulg: dixit ergo eis Pilatus accipite eum vos et secundum legem vestram iudicate eum dixerunt ergo ei Iudaei nobis non licet interficere quemquam
clem: Dixit ergo eis Pilatus: Accipite eum vos, et secundum legem vestram judicate eum. Dixerunt ergo ei Judi: Nobis non licet interficere quemquam.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο πιλατος λαβετε αυτον υμεις και κατα τον νομον υμων κρινατε αυτον ειπον ουν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι ημιν ουκ εξεστιν αποκτειναι ουδενα
kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

vulg: ut sermo Iesu impleretur quem dixit significans qua esset morte moriturus
clem: Ut sermo Jesu impleretur, quem dixit, significans qua morte esset moriturus.
tr: ινα ο λογος του ιησου πληρωθη ον ειπεν σημαινων ποιω θανατω ημελλεν αποθνησκειν
kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

vulg: introivit ergo iterum in praetorium Pilatus et vocavit Iesum et dixit ei tu es rex Iudaeorum
clem: Introivit ergo iterum in prtorium Pilatus: et vocavit Jesum, et dixit ei: Tu es rex Judorum?
tr: εισηλθεν ουν εις το πραιτωριον παλιν ο πιλατος και εφωνησεν τον ιησουν και ειπεν αυτω συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

vulg: et respondit Iesus a temet ipso hoc dicis an alii tibi dixerunt de me
clem: Respondit Jesus: A temetipso hoc dicis, an alii dixerunt tibi de me?
tr: απεκριθη αυτω ο ιησους αφ εαυτου συ τουτο λεγεις η αλλοι σοι ειπον περι εμου
kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

vulg: respondit Pilatus numquid ego Iudaeus sum gens tua et pontifices tradiderunt te mihi quid fecisti
clem: Respondit Pilatus: Numquid ego Judus sum? gens tua et pontifices tradiderunt te mihi: quid fecisti?
tr: απεκριθη ο πιλατος μητι εγω ιουδαιος ειμι το εθνος το σον και οι αρχιερεις παρεδωκαν σε εμοι τι εποιησας
kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

vulg: respondit Iesus regnum meum non est de mundo hoc si ex hoc mundo esset regnum meum ministri mei decertarent ut non traderer Iudaeis nunc autem meum regnum non est hinc
clem: Respondit Jesus: Regnum meum non est de hoc mundo. Si ex hoc mundo esset regnum meum, ministri mei utique decertarent ut non traderer Judis: nunc autem regnum meum non est hinc.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους η βασιλεια η εμη ουκ εστιν εκ του κοσμου τουτου ει εκ του κοσμου τουτου ην η βασιλεια η εμη οι υπηρεται αν οι εμοι ηγωνιζοντο ινα μη παραδοθω τοις ιουδαιοις νυν δε η βασιλεια η εμη ουκ εστιν εντευθεν
kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

vulg: dixit itaque ei Pilatus ergo rex es tu respondit Iesus tu dicis quia rex sum ego ego in hoc natus sum et ad hoc veni in mundum ut testimonium perhibeam veritati omnis qui est ex veritate audit meam vocem
clem: Dixit itaque ei Pilatus: Ergo rex es tu? Respondit Jesus: Tu dicis quia rex sum ego. Ego in hoc natus sum, et ad hoc veni in mundum, ut testimonium perhibeam veritati: omnis qui est ex veritate, audit vocem meam.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτω ο πιλατος ουκουν βασιλευς ει συ απεκριθη ο ιησους συ λεγεις οτι βασιλευς ειμι εγω εγω εις τουτο γεγεννημαι και εις τουτο εληλυθα εις τον κοσμον ινα μαρτυρησω τη αληθεια πας ο ων εκ της αληθειας ακουει μου της φωνης
kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

vulg: dicit ei Pilatus quid est veritas et cum hoc dixisset iterum exivit ad Iudaeos et dicit eis ego nullam invenio in eo causam
clem: Dicit ei Pilatus: Quid est veritas? Et cum hoc dixisset, iterum exivit ad Judos, et dicit eis: Ego nullam invenio in eo causam.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο πιλατος τι εστιν αληθεια και τουτο ειπων παλιν εξηλθεν προς τους ιουδαιους και λεγει αυτοις εγω ουδεμιαν αιτιαν ευρισκω εν αυτω
kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

vulg: est autem consuetudo vobis ut unum dimittam vobis in pascha vultis ergo dimittam vobis regem Iudaeorum
clem: Est autem consuetudo vobis ut unum dimittam vobis in Pascha: vultis ergo dimittam vobis regem Judorum?
tr: εστιν δε συνηθεια υμιν ινα ενα υμιν απολυσω εν τω πασχα βουλεσθε ουν υμιν απολυσω τον βασιλεα των ιουδαιων
kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

vulg: clamaverunt rursum omnes dicentes non hunc sed Barabban erat autem Barabbas latro
clem: Clamaverunt ergo rursum omnes, dicentes: Non hunc, sed Barabbam. Erat autem Barabbas latro.
tr: εκραυγασαν ουν παλιν παντες λεγοντες μη τουτον αλλα τον βαραββαν ην δε ο βαραββας ληστης
kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

vulg: tunc ergo adprehendit Pilatus Iesum et flagellavit
clem: Tunc ergo apprehendit Pilatus Jesum, et flagellavit.
tr: τοτε ουν ελαβεν ο πιλατος τον ιησουν και εμαστιγωσεν
kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

vulg: et milites plectentes coronam de spinis inposuerunt capiti eius et veste purpurea circumdederunt eum
clem: Et milites plectentes coronam de spinis, imposuerunt capiti ejus: et veste purpurea circumdederunt eum.
tr: και οι στρατιωται πλεξαντες στεφανον εξ ακανθων επεθηκαν αυτου τη κεφαλη και ιματιον πορφυρουν περιεβαλον αυτον
kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

vulg: et veniebant ad eum et dicebant have rex Iudaeorum et dabant ei alapas
clem: Et veniebant ad eum, et dicebant: Ave, rex Judorum: et dabant ei alapas.
tr: και ελεγον χαιρε ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων και εδιδουν αυτω ραπισματα
kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

vulg: exiit iterum Pilatus foras et dicit eis ecce adduco vobis eum foras
clem: Exivit ergo iterum Pilatus foras, et dicit eis: Ecce adduco vobis eum foras, ut cognoscatis quia nullam invenio in eo causam.
tr: εξηλθεν ουν παλιν εξω ο πιλατος και λεγει αυτοις ιδε αγω υμιν αυτον εξω ινα γνωτε οτι εν αυτω ουδεμιαν αιτιαν ευρισκω
kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

vulg: ut cognoscatis quia in eo nullam causam invenio et purpureum vestimentum et dicit eis ecce homo
clem: (Exivit ergo Jesus portans coronam spineam, et purpureum vestimentum.) Et dicit eis: Ecce homo.
tr: εξηλθεν ουν ο ιησους εξω φορων τον ακανθινον στεφανον και το πορφυρουν ιματιον και λεγει αυτοις ιδε ο ανθρωπος
kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

vulg: cum ergo vidissent eum pontifices et ministri clamabant dicentes crucifige crucifige dicit eis Pilatus accipite eum vos et crucifigite ego enim non invenio in eo causam
clem: Cum ergo vidissent eum pontifices et ministri, clamabant, dicentes: Crucifige, crucifige eum. Dicit eis Pilatus: Accipite eum vos, et crucifigite: ego enim non invenio in eo causam.
tr: οτε ουν ειδον αυτον οι αρχιερεις και οι υπηρεται εκραυγασαν λεγοντες σταυρωσον σταυρωσον λεγει αυτοις ο πιλατος λαβετε αυτον υμεις και σταυρωσατε εγω γαρ ουχ ευρισκω εν αυτω αιτιαν
kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

vulg: responderunt ei Iudaei nos legem habemus et secundum legem debet mori quia Filium Dei se fecit
clem: Responderunt ei Judi: Nos legem habemus, et secundum legem debet mori, quia Filium Dei se fecit.
tr: απεκριθησαν αυτω οι ιουδαιοι ημεις νομον εχομεν και κατα τον νομον ημων οφειλει αποθανειν οτι εαυτον υιον  του  θεου εποιησεν
kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

vulg: cum ergo audisset Pilatus hunc sermonem magis timuit
clem: Cum ergo audisset Pilatus hunc sermonem, magis timuit.
tr: οτε ουν ηκουσεν ο πιλατος τουτον τον λογον μαλλον εφοβηθη
kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

vulg: et ingressus est praetorium iterum et dicit ad Iesum unde es tu Iesus autem responsum non dedit ei
clem: Et ingressus est prtorium iterum: et dixit ad Jesum: Unde es tu? Jesus autem responsum non dedit ei.
tr: και εισηλθεν εις το πραιτωριον παλιν και λεγει τω ιησου ποθεν ει συ ο δε ιησους αποκρισιν ουκ εδωκεν αυτω
kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

vulg: dicit ergo ei Pilatus mihi non loqueris nescis quia potestatem habeo crucifigere te et potestatem habeo dimittere te
clem: Dicit ergo ei Pilatus: Mihi non loqueris? nescis quia potestatem habeo crucifigere te, et potestatem habeo dimittere te?
tr: λεγει ουν αυτω ο πιλατος εμοι ου λαλεις ουκ οιδας οτι εξουσιαν εχω σταυρωσαι σε και εξουσιαν εχω απολυσαι σε
kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

vulg: respondit Iesus non haberes potestatem adversum me ullam nisi tibi esset datum desuper propterea qui tradidit me tibi maius peccatum habet
clem: Respondit Jesus: Non haberes potestatem adversum me ullam, nisi tibi datum esset desuper. Propterea qui me tradidit tibi, majus peccatum habet.
tr: απεκριθη ο ιησους ουκ ειχες εξουσιαν ουδεμιαν κατ εμου ει μη ην σοι δεδομενον ανωθεν δια τουτο ο παραδιδους με σοι μειζονα αμαρτιαν εχει
kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

vulg: exinde quaerebat Pilatus dimittere eum Iudaei autem clamabant dicentes si hunc dimittis non es amicus Caesaris omnis qui se regem facit contradicit Caesari
clem: Et exinde qurebat Pilatus dimittere eum. Judi autem clamabant dicentes: Si hunc dimittis, non es amicus Csaris. Omnis enim qui se regem facit, contradicit Csari.
tr: εκ τουτου εζητει ο πιλατος απολυσαι αυτον οι δε ιουδαιοι εκραζον λεγοντες εαν τουτον απολυσης ουκ ει φιλος του καισαρος πας ο βασιλεα αυτον ποιων αντιλεγει τω καισαρι
kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

vulg: Pilatus ergo cum audisset hos sermones adduxit foras Iesum et sedit pro tribunali in locum qui dicitur Lithostrotus hebraice autem Gabbatha
clem: Pilatus autem cum audisset hos sermones, adduxit foras Jesum: et sedit pro tribunali, in loco qui dicitur Lithostrotos, hebraice autem Gabbatha.
tr: ο ουν πιλατος ακουσας τουτον τον λογον ηγαγεν εξω τον ιησουν και εκαθισεν επι του βηματος εις τοπον λεγομενον λιθοστρωτον εβραιστι δε γαββαθα
kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

vulg: erat autem parasceve paschae hora quasi sexta et dicit Iudaeis ecce rex vester
clem: Erat enim parasceve Pasch, hora quasi sexta, et dicit Judis: Ecce rex vester.
tr: ην δε παρασκευη του πασχα ωρα δε ωσει εκτη και λεγει τοις ιουδαιοις ιδε ο βασιλευς υμων
kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

vulg: illi autem clamabant tolle tolle crucifige eum dixit eis Pilatus regem vestrum crucifigam responderunt pontifices non habemus regem nisi Caesarem
clem: Illi autem clamabant: Tolle, tolle, crucifige eum. Dicit eis Pilatus: Regem vestrum crucifigam? Responderunt pontifices: Non habemus regem, nisi Csarem.
tr: οι δε εκραυγασαν αρον αρον σταυρωσον αυτον λεγει αυτοις ο πιλατος τον βασιλεα υμων σταυρωσω απεκριθησαν οι αρχιερεις ουκ εχομεν βασιλεα ει μη καισαρα
kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

vulg: tunc ergo tradidit eis illum ut crucifigeretur susceperunt autem Iesum et eduxerunt
clem: Tunc ergo tradidit eis illum ut crucifigeretur. Susceperunt autem Jesum, et eduxerunt.
tr: τοτε ουν παρεδωκεν αυτον αυτοις ινα σταυρωθη παρελαβον δε τον ιησουν και απηγαγον
kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

vulg: et baiulans sibi crucem exivit in eum qui dicitur Calvariae locum hebraice Golgotha
clem: Et bajulans sibi crucem exivit in eum, qui dicitur Calvari locum, hebraice autem Golgotha:
tr: και βασταζων τον σταυρον αυτου εξηλθεν εις τον λεγομενον κρανιου τοπον ος λεγεται εβραιστι γολγοθα
kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

vulg: ubi eum crucifixerunt et cum eo alios duos hinc et hinc medium autem Iesum
clem: ubi crucifixerunt eum, et cum eo alios duos hinc et hinc, medium autem Jesum.
tr: οπου αυτον εσταυρωσαν και μετ αυτου αλλους δυο εντευθεν και εντευθεν μεσον δε τον ιησουν
kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

vulg: scripsit autem et titulum Pilatus et posuit super crucem erat autem scriptum Iesus Nazarenus rex Iudaeorum
clem: Scripsit autem et titulum Pilatus, et posuit super crucem. Erat autem scriptum: Jesus Nazarenus, Rex Judorum.
tr: εγραψεν δε και τιτλον ο πιλατος και εθηκεν επι του σταυρου ην δε γεγραμμενον ιησους ο ναζωραιος ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was Jesus Of Nazareth The King Of The Jews.

vulg: hunc ergo titulum multi legerunt Iudaeorum quia prope civitatem erat locus ubi crucifixus est Iesus et erat scriptum hebraice graece et latine
clem: Hunc ergo titulum multi Judorum legerunt: quia prope civitatem erat locus, ubi crucifixus est Jesus, et erat scriptum hebraice, grce, et latine.
tr: τουτον ουν τον τιτλον πολλοι ανεγνωσαν των ιουδαιων οτι εγγυς ην της πολεως ο τοπος οπου εσταυρωθη ο ιησους και ην γεγραμμενον εβραιστι ελληνιστι ρωμαιστι
kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

vulg: dicebant ergo Pilato pontifices Iudaeorum noli scribere rex Iudaeorum sed quia ipse dixit rex sum Iudaeorum
clem: Dicebant ergo Pilato pontifices Judorum: Noli scribere: Rex Judorum: sed quia ipse dixit: Rex sum Judorum.
tr: ελεγον ουν τω πιλατω οι αρχιερεις των ιουδαιων μη γραφε ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων αλλ οτι εκεινος ειπεν βασιλευς ειμι των ιουδαιων
kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

vulg: respondit Pilatus quod scripsi scripsi
clem: Respondit Pilatus: Quod scripsi, scripsi.
tr: απεκριθη ο πιλατος ο γεγραφα γεγραφα
kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

vulg: milites ergo cum crucifixissent eum acceperunt vestimenta eius et fecerunt quattuor partes unicuique militi partem et tunicam erat autem tunica inconsutilis desuper contexta per totum
clem: Milites ergo cum crucifixissent eum, acceperunt vestimenta ejus (et fecerunt quatuor partes, unicuique militi partem) et tunicam. Erat autem tunica inconsutilis, desuper contexta per totum.
tr: οι ουν στρατιωται οτε εσταυρωσαν τον ιησουν ελαβον τα ιματια αυτου και εποιησαν τεσσαρα μερη εκαστω στρατιωτη μερος και τον χιτωνα ην δε ο χιτων αρραφος εκ των ανωθεν υφαντος δι ολου
kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ad invicem non scindamus eam sed sortiamur de illa cuius sit ut scriptura impleatur dicens partiti sunt vestimenta mea sibi et in vestem meam miserunt sortem et milites quidem haec fecerunt
clem: Dixerunt ergo ad invicem: Non scindamus eam, sed sortiamur de illa cujus sit. Ut Scriptura impleretur, dicens: Partiti sunt vestimenta mea sibi: et in vestem meam miserunt sortem. Et milites quidem hc fecerunt.
tr: ειπον ουν προς αλληλους μη σχισωμεν αυτον αλλα λαχωμεν περι αυτου τινος εσται ινα η γραφη πληρωθη η λεγουσα διεμερισαντο τα ιματια μου εαυτοις και επι τον ιματισμον μου εβαλον κληρον οι μεν ουν στρατιωται ταυτα εποιησαν
kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

vulg: stabant autem iuxta crucem Iesu mater eius et soror matris eius Maria Cleopae et Maria Magdalene
clem: Stabant autem juxta crucem Jesu mater ejus, et soror matris ejus, Maria Cleoph, et Maria Magdalene.
tr: ειστηκεισαν δε παρα τω σταυρω του ιησου η μητηρ αυτου και η αδελφη της μητρος αυτου μαρια η του κλωπα και μαρια η μαγδαληνη
kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

vulg: cum vidisset ergo Iesus matrem et discipulum stantem quem diligebat dicit matri suae mulier ecce filius tuus
clem: Cum vidisset ergo Jesus matrem, et discipulum stantem, quem diligebat, dicit matri su: Mulier, ecce filius tuus.
tr: ιησους ουν ιδων την μητερα και τον μαθητην παρεστωτα ον ηγαπα λεγει τη μητρι αυτου γυναι ιδου ο υιος σου
kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

vulg: deinde dicit discipulo ecce mater tua et ex illa hora accepit eam discipulus in sua
clem: Deinde dicit discipulo: Ecce mater tua. Et ex illa hora accepit eam discipulus in sua.
tr: ειτα λεγει τω μαθητη ιδου η μητηρ σου και απ εκεινης της ωρας ελαβεν αυτην ο μαθητης εις τα ιδια
kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

vulg: postea sciens Iesus quia iam omnia consummata sunt ut consummaretur scriptura dicit sitio
clem: Postea sciens Jesus quia omnia consummata sunt, ut consummaretur Scriptura, dixit: Sitio.
tr: μετα τουτο ειδως ο ιησους οτι παντα ηδη τετελεσται ινα τελειωθη η γραφη λεγει διψω
kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

vulg: vas ergo positum erat aceto plenum illi autem spongiam plenam aceto hysopo circumponentes obtulerunt ori eius
clem: Vas ergo erat positum aceto plenum. Illi autem spongiam plenam aceto, hyssopo circumponentes, obtulerunt ori ejus.
tr: σκευος ουν εκειτο οξους μεστον οι δε πλησαντες σπογγον οξους και υσσωπω περιθεντες προσηνεγκαν αυτου τω στοματι
kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

vulg: cum ergo accepisset Iesus acetum dixit consummatum est et inclinato capite tradidit spiritum
clem: Cum ergo accepisset Jesus acetum, dixit: Consummatum est. Et inclinato capite tradidit spiritum.
tr: οτε ουν ελαβεν το οξος ο ιησους ειπεν τετελεσται και κλινας την κεφαλην παρεδωκεν το πνευμα
kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

vulg: Iudaei ergo quoniam parasceve erat ut non remanerent in cruce corpora sabbato erat enim magnus dies ille sabbati rogaverunt Pilatum ut frangerentur eorum crura et tollerentur
clem: Judi ergo (quoniam parasceve erat) ut non remanerent in cruce corpora sabbato (erat enim magnus dies ille sabbati), rogaverunt Pilatum ut frangerentur eorum crura, et tollerentur.
tr: οι ουν ιουδαιοι  επει παρασκευη ην  ινα μη μεινη επι του σταυρου τα σωματα εν τω σαββατω επει παρασκευη ην   ην γαρ μεγαλη η ημερα εκεινου του σαββατου ηρωτησαν τον πιλατον ινα κατεαγωσιν αυτων τα σκελη και αρθωσιν
kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

vulg: venerunt ergo milites et primi quidem fregerunt crura et alterius qui crucifixus est cum eo
clem: Venerunt ergo milites: et primi quidem fregerunt crura, et alterius, qui crucifixus est cum eo.
tr: ηλθον ουν οι στρατιωται και του μεν πρωτου κατεαξαν τα σκελη και του αλλου του συσταυρωθεντος αυτω
kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

vulg: ad Iesum autem cum venissent ut viderunt eum iam mortuum non fregerunt eius crura
clem: Ad Jesum autem cum venissent, ut viderunt eum jam mortuum, non fregerunt ejus crura,
tr: επι δε τον ιησουν ελθοντες ως ειδον αυτον ηδη τεθνηκοτα ου κατεαξαν αυτου τα σκελη
kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

vulg: sed unus militum lancea latus eius aperuit et continuo exivit sanguis et aqua
clem: sed unus militum lancea latus ejus aperuit, et continuo exivit sanguis et aqua.
tr: αλλ εις των στρατιωτων λογχη αυτου την πλευραν ενυξεν και ευθυς εξηλθεν αιμα και υδωρ
kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

vulg: et qui vidit testimonium perhibuit et verum est eius testimonium et ille scit quia vera dicit ut et vos credatis
clem: Et qui vidit, testimonium perhibuit: et verum est testimonium ejus. Et ille scit quia vera dicit: ut et vos credatis.
tr: και ο εωρακως μεμαρτυρηκεν και αληθινη αυτου εστιν η μαρτυρια κακεινος οιδεν οτι αληθη λεγει ινα υμεις πιστευσητε
kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

vulg: facta sunt enim haec ut scriptura impleatur os non comminuetis ex eo
clem: Facta sunt enim hc ut Scriptura impleretur: Os non comminuetis ex eo.
tr: εγενετο γαρ ταυτα ινα η γραφη πληρωθη οστουν ου συντριβησεται αυτου
kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

vulg: et iterum alia scriptura dicit videbunt in quem transfixerunt
clem: Et iterum alia Scriptura dicit: Videbunt in quem transfixerunt.
tr: και παλιν ετερα γραφη λεγει οψονται εις ον εξεκεντησαν
kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

vulg: post haec autem rogavit Pilatum Ioseph ab Arimathia eo quod esset discipulus Iesu occultus autem propter metum Iudaeorum ut tolleret corpus Iesu et permisit Pilatus venit ergo et tulit corpus Iesu
clem: Post hc autem rogavit Pilatum Joseph ab Arimatha (eo quod esset discipulus Jesu, occultus autem propter metum Judorum), ut tolleret corpus Jesu. Et permisit Pilatus. Venit ergo, et tulit corpus Jesu.
tr: μετα δε ταυτα ηρωτησεν τον πιλατον ο ιωσηφ ο απο αριμαθαιας ων μαθητης του ιησου κεκρυμμενος δε δια τον φοβον των ιουδαιων ινα αρη το σωμα του ιησου και επετρεψεν ο πιλατος ηλθεν ουν και ηρεν το σωμα του ιησου
kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

vulg: venit autem et Nicodemus qui venerat ad Iesum nocte primum ferens mixturam murrae et aloes quasi libras centum
clem: Venit autem et Nicodemus, qui venerat ad Jesum nocte primum, ferens mixturam myrrh et alos, quasi libras centum.
tr: ηλθεν δε και νικοδημος ο ελθων προς τον ιησουν νυκτος το πρωτον φερων μιγμα σμυρνης και αλοης ωσει λιτρας εκατον
kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

vulg: acceperunt ergo corpus Iesu et ligaverunt eum linteis cum aromatibus sicut mos Iudaeis est sepelire
clem: Acceperunt ergo corpus Jesu, et ligaverunt illud linteis cum aromatibus, sicut mos est Judis sepelire.
tr: ελαβον ουν το σωμα του ιησου και εδησαν αυτο οθονιοις μετα των αρωματων καθως εθος εστιν τοις ιουδαιοις ενταφιαζειν
kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

vulg: erat autem in loco ubi crucifixus est hortus et in horto monumentum novum in quo nondum quisquam positus erat
clem: Erat autem in loco, ubi crucifixus est, hortus: et in horto monumentum novum, in quo nondum quisquam positus erat.
tr: ην δε εν τω τοπω οπου εσταυρωθη κηπος και εν τω κηπω μνημειον καινον εν ω ουδεπω ουδεις ετεθη
kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

vulg: ibi ergo propter parasceven Iudaeorum quia iuxta erat monumentum posuerunt Iesum
clem: Ibi ergo propter parasceven Judorum, quia juxta erat monumentum, posuerunt Jesum.
tr: εκει ουν δια την παρασκευην των ιουδαιων οτι εγγυς ην το μνημειον εθηκαν τον ιησουν
kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

vulg: una autem sabbati Maria Magdalene venit mane cum adhuc tenebrae essent ad monumentum et videt lapidem sublatum a monumento
clem: Una autem sabbati, Maria Magdalene venit mane, cum adhuc tenebr essent, ad monumentum: et vidit lapidem sublatum a monumento.
tr: τη δε μια των σαββατων μαρια η μαγδαληνη ερχεται πρωι σκοτιας ετι ουσης εις το μνημειον και βλεπει τον λιθον ηρμενον εκ του μνημειου
kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

vulg: cucurrit ergo et venit ad Simonem Petrum et ad alium discipulum quem amabat Iesus et dicit eis tulerunt Dominum de monumento et nescimus ubi posuerunt eum
clem: Cucurrit ergo, et venit ad Simonem Petrum, et ad alium discipulum, quem amabat Jesus, et dicit illis: Tulerunt Dominum de monumento, et nescimus ubi posuerunt eum.
tr: τρεχει ουν και ερχεται προς σιμωνα πετρον και προς τον αλλον μαθητην ον εφιλει ο ιησους και λεγει αυτοις ηραν τον κυριον εκ του μνημειου και ουκ οιδαμεν που εθηκαν αυτον
kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

vulg: exiit ergo Petrus et ille alius discipulus et venerunt ad monumentum
clem: Exiit ergo Petrus, et ille alius discipulus, et venerunt ad monumentum.
tr: εξηλθεν ουν ο πετρος και ο αλλος μαθητης και ηρχοντο εις το μνημειον
kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

vulg: currebant autem duo simul et ille alius discipulus praecucurrit citius Petro et venit primus ad monumentum
clem: Currebant autem duo simul, et ille alius discipulus prcucurrit citius Petro, et venit primus ad monumentum.
tr: ετρεχον δε οι δυο ομου και ο αλλος μαθητης προεδραμεν ταχιον του πετρου και ηλθεν πρωτος εις το μνημειον
kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

vulg: et cum se inclinasset videt posita linteamina non tamen introivit
clem: Et cum se inclinasset, vidit posita linteamina: non tamen introivit.
tr: και παρακυψας βλεπει κειμενα τα οθονια ου μεντοι εισηλθεν
kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

vulg: venit ergo Simon Petrus sequens eum et introivit in monumentum et videt linteamina posita
clem: Venit ergo Simon Petrus sequens eum, et introivit in monumentum, et vidit linteamina posita,
tr: ερχεται ουν σιμων πετρος ακολουθων αυτω και εισηλθεν εις το μνημειον και θεωρει τα οθονια κειμενα
kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

vulg: et sudarium quod fuerat super caput eius non cum linteaminibus positum sed separatim involutum in unum locum
clem: et sudarium, quod fuerat super caput ejus, non cum linteaminibus positum, sed separatim involutum in unum locum.
tr: και το σουδαριον ο ην επι της κεφαλης αυτου ου μετα των οθονιων κειμενον αλλα χωρις εντετυλιγμενον εις ενα τοπον
kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

vulg: tunc ergo introivit et ille discipulus qui venerat primus ad monumentum et vidit et credidit
clem: Tunc ergo introivit et ille discipulus qui venerat primus ad monumentum: et vidit, et credidit:
tr: τοτε ουν εισηλθεν και ο αλλος μαθητης ο ελθων πρωτος εις το μνημειον και ειδεν και επιστευσεν
kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

vulg: nondum enim sciebant scripturam quia oportet eum a mortuis resurgere
clem: nondum enim sciebant Scripturam, quia oportebat eum a mortuis resurgere.
tr: ουδεπω γαρ ηδεισαν την γραφην οτι δει αυτον εκ νεκρων αναστηναι
kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

vulg: abierunt ergo iterum ad semet ipsos discipuli
clem: Abierunt ergo iterum discipuli ad semetipsos.
tr: απηλθον ουν παλιν προς εαυτους οι μαθηται
kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

vulg: Maria autem stabat ad monumentum foris plorans dum ergo fleret inclinavit se et prospexit in monumentum
clem: Maria autem stabat ad monumentum foris, plorans. Dum ergo fleret, inclinavit se, et prospexit in monumentum:
tr: μαρια δε ειστηκει προς το μνημειον κλαιουσα εξω ως ουν εκλαιεν παρεκυψεν εις το μνημειον
kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

vulg: et vidit duos angelos in albis sedentes unum ad caput et unum ad pedes ubi positum fuerat corpus Iesu
clem: et vidit duos angelos in albis sedentes, unum ad caput, et unum ad pedes, ubi positum fuerat corpus Jesu.
tr: και θεωρει δυο αγγελους εν λευκοις καθεζομενους ενα προς τη κεφαλη και ενα προς τοις ποσιν οπου εκειτο το σωμα του ιησου
kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

vulg: dicunt ei illi mulier quid ploras dicit eis quia tulerunt Dominum meum et nescio ubi posuerunt eum
clem: Dicunt ei illi: Mulier, quid ploras? Dicit eis: Quia tulerunt Dominum meum: et nescio ubi posuerunt eum.
tr: και λεγουσιν αυτη εκεινοι γυναι τι κλαιεις λεγει αυτοις οτι ηραν τον κυριον μου και ουκ οιδα που εθηκαν αυτον
kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

vulg: haec cum dixisset conversa est retrorsum et videt Iesum stantem et non sciebat quia Iesus est
clem: Hc cum dixisset, conversa est retrorsum, et vidit Jesum stantem: et non sciebat quia Jesus est.
tr: και ταυτα ειπουσα εστραφη εις τα οπισω και θεωρει τον ιησουν εστωτα και ουκ ηδει οτι ο ιησους εστιν
kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus mulier quid ploras quem quaeris illa existimans quia hortulanus esset dicit ei domine si tu sustulisti eum dicito mihi ubi posuisti eum et ego eum tollam
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Mulier, quid ploras? quem quris? Illa existimans quia hortulanus esset, dicit ei: Domine, si tu sustulisti eum, dicito mihi ubi posuisti eum, et ego eum tollam.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους γυναι τι κλαιεις τινα ζητεις εκεινη δοκουσα οτι ο κηπουρος εστιν λεγει αυτω κυριε ει συ εβαστασας αυτον ειπε μοι που αυτον εθηκας καγω αυτον αρω
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus Maria conversa illa dicit ei rabboni quod dicitur magister
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Maria. Conversa illa, dicit ei: Rabboni (quod dicitur Magister).
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους μαρια στραφεισα εκεινη λεγει αυτω ραββουνι ο λεγεται διδασκαλε
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus noli me tangere nondum enim ascendi ad Patrem meum vade autem ad fratres meos et dic eis ascendo ad Patrem meum et Patrem vestrum et Deum meum et Deum vestrum
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Noli me tangere, nondum enim ascendi ad Patrem meum: vade autem ad fratres meos, et dic eis: Ascendo ad Patrem meum, et Patrem vestrum, Deum meum, et Deum vestrum.
tr: λεγει αυτη ο ιησους μη μου απτου ουπω γαρ αναβεβηκα προς τον πατερα μου πορευου δε προς τους αδελφους μου και ειπε αυτοις αναβαινω προς τον πατερα μου και πατερα υμων και θεον μου και θεον υμων
kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

vulg: venit Maria Magdalene adnuntians discipulis quia vidi Dominum et haec dixit mihi
clem: Venit Maria Magdalene annuntians discipulis: Quia vidi Dominum, et hc dixit mihi.
tr: ερχεται μαρια η μαγδαληνη απαγγελλουσα τοις μαθηταις οτι εωρακεν τον κυριον και ταυτα ειπεν αυτη
kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

vulg: cum esset ergo sero die illo una sabbatorum et fores essent clausae ubi erant discipuli propter metum Iudaeorum venit Iesus et stetit in medio et dicit eis pax vobis
clem: Cum ergo sero esset die illo, una sabbatorum, et fores essent claus, ubi erant discipuli congregati propter metum Judorum: venit Jesus, et stetit in medio, et dixit eis: Pax vobis.
tr: ουσης ουν οψιας τη ημερα εκεινη τη μια των σαββατων και των θυρων κεκλεισμενων οπου ησαν οι μαθηται συνηγμενοι δια τον φοβον των ιουδαιων ηλθεν ο ιησους και εστη εις το μεσον και λεγει αυτοις ειρηνη υμιν
kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

vulg: et hoc cum dixisset ostendit eis manus et latus gavisi sunt ergo discipuli viso Domino
clem: Et cum hoc dixisset, ostendit eis manus et latus. Gavisi sunt discipuli, viso Domino.
tr: και τουτο ειπων εδειξεν αυτοις τας χειρας και την πλευραν αυτου εχαρησαν ουν οι μαθηται ιδοντες τον κυριον
kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

vulg: dixit ergo eis iterum pax vobis sicut misit me Pater et ego mitto vos
clem: Dixit ergo eis iterum: Pax vobis. Sicut misit me Pater, et ego mitto vos.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις ο ιησους παλιν ειρηνη υμιν καθως απεσταλκεν με ο πατηρ καγω πεμπω υμας
kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

vulg: hoc cum dixisset insuflavit et dicit eis accipite Spiritum Sanctum
clem: Hc cum dixisset, insufflavit, et dixit eis: Accipite Spiritum Sanctum:
tr: και τουτο ειπων ενεφυσησεν και λεγει αυτοις λαβετε πνευμα αγιον
kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

vulg: quorum remiseritis peccata remittuntur eis quorum retinueritis detenta sunt
clem: quorum remiseritis peccata, remittuntur eis: et quorum retinueritis, retenta sunt.
tr: αν τινων αφητε τας αμαρτιας αφιενται αυτοις αν τινων κρατητε κεκρατηνται
kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

vulg: Thomas autem unus ex duodecim qui dicitur Didymus non erat cum eis quando venit Iesus
clem: Thomas autem unus ex duodecim, qui dicitur Didymus, non erat cum eis quando venit Jesus.
tr: θωμας δε εις εκ των δωδεκα ο λεγομενος διδυμος ουκ ην μετ αυτων οτε ηλθεν ο ιησους
kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

vulg: dixerunt ergo ei alii discipuli vidimus Dominum ille autem dixit eis nisi videro in manibus eius figuram clavorum et mittam digitum meum in locum clavorum et mittam manum meam in latus eius non credam
clem: Dixerunt ergo ei alii discipuli: Vidimus Dominum. Ille autem dixit eis: Nisi videro in manibus ejus fixuram clavorum, et mittam digitum meum in locum clavorum, et mittam manum meam in latus ejus, non credam.
tr: ελεγον ουν αυτω οι αλλοι μαθηται εωρακαμεν τον κυριον ο δε ειπεν αυτοις εαν μη ιδω εν ταις χερσιν αυτου τον τυπον των ηλων και βαλω τον δακτυλον μου εις τον τυπον των ηλων και βαλω την χειρα μου εις την πλευραν αυτου ου μη πιστευσω
kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

vulg: et post dies octo iterum erant discipuli eius intus et Thomas cum eis venit Iesus ianuis clausis et stetit in medio et dixit pax vobis
clem: Et post dies octo, iterum erant discipuli ejus intus, et Thomas cum eis. Venit Jesus januis clausis, et stetit in medio, et dixit: Pax vobis.
tr: και μεθ ημερας οκτω παλιν ησαν εσω οι μαθηται αυτου και θωμας μετ αυτων ερχεται ο ιησους των θυρων κεκλεισμενων και εστη εις το μεσον και ειπεν ειρηνη υμιν
kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

vulg: deinde dicit Thomae infer digitum tuum huc et vide manus meas et adfer manum tuam et mitte in latus meum et noli esse incredulus sed fidelis
clem: Deinde dicit Thom: Infer digitum tuum huc, et vide manus meas, et affer manum tuam, et mitte in latus meum: et noli esse incredulus, sed fidelis.
tr: ειτα λεγει τω θωμα φερε τον δακτυλον σου ωδε και ιδε τας χειρας μου και φερε την χειρα σου και βαλε εις την πλευραν μου και μη γινου απιστος αλλα πιστος
kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

vulg: respondit Thomas et dixit ei Dominus meus et Deus meus
clem: Respondit Thomas, et dixit ei: Dominus meus et Deus meus.
tr: και απεκριθη ο θωμας και ειπεν αυτω ο κυριος μου και ο θεος μου
kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

vulg: dicit ei Iesus quia vidisti me credidisti beati qui non viderunt et crediderunt
clem: Dixit ei Jesus: Quia vidisti me, Thoma, credidisti: beati qui non viderunt, et crediderunt.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους οτι εωρακας με θωμα πεπιστευκας μακαριοι οι μη ιδοντες και πιστευσαντες
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

vulg: multa quidem et alia signa fecit Iesus in conspectu discipulorum suorum quae non sunt scripta in libro hoc
clem: Multa quidem et alia signa fecit Jesus in conspectu discipulorum suorum, qu non sunt scripta in libro hoc.
tr: πολλα μεν ουν και αλλα σημεια εποιησεν ο ιησους ενωπιον των μαθητων αυτου α ουκ εστιν γεγραμμενα εν τω βιβλιω τουτω
kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

vulg: haec autem scripta sunt ut credatis quia Iesus est Christus Filius Dei et ut credentes vitam habeatis in nomine eius
clem: Hc autem scripta sunt ut credatis, quia Jesus est Christus Filius Dei: et ut credentes, vitam habeatis in nomine ejus.
tr: ταυτα δε γεγραπται ινα πιστευσητε οτι ο ιησους εστιν ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου και ινα πιστευοντες ζωην εχητε εν τω ονοματι αυτου
kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

vulg: postea manifestavit se iterum Iesus ad mare Tiberiadis manifestavit autem sic
clem: Postea manifestavit se iterum Jesus discipulis ad mare Tiberiadis. Manifestavit autem sic:
tr: μετα ταυτα εφανερωσεν εαυτον παλιν ο ιησους τοις μαθηταις επι της θαλασσης της τιβεριαδος εφανερωσεν δε ουτως
kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

vulg: erant simul Simon Petrus et Thomas qui dicitur Didymus et Nathanahel qui erat a Cana Galilaeae et filii Zebedaei et alii ex discipulis eius duo
clem: erant simul Simon Petrus, et Thomas, qui dicitur Didymus, et Nathanal, qui erat a Cana Galil, et filii Zebedi, et alii ex discipulis ejus duo.
tr: ησαν ομου σιμων πετρος και θωμας ο λεγομενος διδυμος και ναθαναηλ ο απο κανα της γαλιλαιας και οι του ζεβεδαιου και αλλοι εκ των μαθητων αυτου δυο
kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

vulg: dicit eis Simon Petrus vado piscari dicunt ei venimus et nos tecum et exierunt et ascenderunt in navem et illa nocte nihil prendiderunt
clem: Dicit eis Simon Petrus: Vado piscari. Dicunt ei: Venimus et nos tecum. Et exierunt, et ascenderunt in navim: et illa nocte nihil prendiderunt.
tr: λεγει αυτοις σιμων πετρος υπαγω αλιευειν λεγουσιν αυτω ερχομεθα και ημεις συν σοι εξηλθον και ανεβησαν εις το πλοιον ευθυς και εν εκεινη τη νυκτι επιασαν ουδεν
kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

vulg: mane autem iam facto stetit Iesus in litore non tamen cognoverunt discipuli quia Iesus est
clem: Mane autem facto stetit Jesus in littore: non tamen cognoverunt discipuli quia Jesus est.
tr: πρωιας δε ηδη γενομενης εστη ο ιησους εις τον αιγιαλον ου μεντοι ηδεισαν οι μαθηται οτι ιησους εστιν
kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

vulg: dicit ergo eis Iesus pueri numquid pulmentarium habetis responderunt ei non
clem: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Pueri, numquid pulmentarium habetis? Responderunt ei: Non.
tr: λεγει ουν αυτοις ο ιησους παιδια μη τι προσφαγιον εχετε απεκριθησαν αυτω ου
kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

vulg: dixit eis mittite in dexteram navigii rete et invenietis miserunt ergo et iam non valebant illud trahere a multitudine piscium
clem: Dicit eis: Mittite in dexteram navigii rete, et invenietis. Miserunt ergo: et jam non valebant illud trahere pr multitudine piscium.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις βαλετε εις τα δεξια μερη του πλοιου το δικτυον και ευρησετε εβαλον ουν και ουκ ετι αυτο ελκυσαι ισχυσαν απο του πληθους των ιχθυων
kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

vulg: dicit ergo discipulus ille quem diligebat Iesus Petro Dominus est Simon Petrus cum audisset quia Dominus est tunicam succinxit se erat enim nudus et misit se in mare
clem: Dixit ergo discipulus ille, quem diligebat Jesus, Petro: Dominus est. Simon Petrus cum audisset quia Dominus est, tunica succinxit se (erat enim nudus) et misit se in mare.
tr: λεγει ουν ο μαθητης εκεινος ον ηγαπα ο ιησους τω πετρω ο κυριος εστιν σιμων ουν πετρος ακουσας οτι ο κυριος εστιν τον επενδυτην διεζωσατο ην γαρ γυμνος και εβαλεν εαυτον εις την θαλασσαν
kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

vulg: alii autem discipuli navigio venerunt non enim longe erant a terra sed quasi a cubitis ducentis trahentes rete piscium
clem: Alii autem discipuli navigio venerunt (non enim longe erant a terra, sed quasi cubitis ducentis), trahentes rete piscium.
tr: οι δε αλλοι μαθηται τω πλοιαριω ηλθον ου γαρ ησαν μακραν απο της γης αλλ ως απο πηχων διακοσιων συροντες το δικτυον των ιχθυων
kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

vulg: ut ergo descenderunt in terram viderunt prunas positas et piscem superpositum et panem
clem: Ut ergo descenderunt in terram, viderunt prunas positas, et piscem superpositum, et panem.
tr: ως ουν απεβησαν εις την γην βλεπουσιν ανθρακιαν κειμενην και οψαριον επικειμενον και αρτον
kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

vulg: dicit eis Iesus adferte de piscibus quos prendidistis nunc
clem: Dicit eis Jesus: Afferte de piscibus, quos prendidistis nunc.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους ενεγκατε απο των οψαριων ων επιασατε νυν
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

vulg: ascendit Simon Petrus et traxit rete in terram plenum magnis piscibus centum quinquaginta tribus et cum tanti essent non est scissum rete
clem: Ascendit Simon Petrus et traxit rete in terram, plenum magnis piscibus centum quinquaginta tribus. Et cum tanti essent, non est scissum rete.
tr: ανεβη σιμων πετρος και ειλκυσεν το δικτυον επι της γης μεστον ιχθυων μεγαλων εκατον πεντηκοντατριων και τοσουτων οντων ουκ εσχισθη το δικτυον
kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

vulg: dicit eis Iesus venite prandete et nemo audebat discentium interrogare eum tu quis es scientes quia Dominus esset
clem: Dicit eis Jesus: Venite, prandete. Et nemo audebat discumbentium interrogare eum: Tu quis es? scientes, quia Dominus est.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους δευτε αριστησατε ουδεις δε ετολμα των μαθητων εξετασαι αυτον συ τις ει ειδοτες οτι ο κυριος εστιν
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

vulg: et venit Iesus et accepit panem et dat eis et piscem similiter
clem: Et venit Jesus, et accipit panem, et dat eis, et piscem similiter.
tr: ερχεται ουν ο ιησους και λαμβανει τον αρτον και διδωσιν αυτοις και το οψαριον ομοιως
kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

vulg: hoc iam tertio manifestatus est Iesus discipulis cum surrexisset a mortuis
clem: Hoc jam tertio manifestatus est Jesus discipulis suis cum resurrexisset a mortuis.
tr: τουτο ηδη τριτον εφανερωθη ο ιησους τοις μαθηταις αυτου εγερθεις εκ νεκρων
kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

vulg: cum ergo prandissent dicit Simoni Petro Iesus Simon Iohannis diligis me plus his dicit ei etiam Domine tu scis quia amo te dicit ei pasce agnos meos
clem: Cum ergo prandissent, dicit Simoni Petro Jesus: Simon Joannis, diligis me plus his? Dicit ei: Etiam Domine, tu scis quia amo te. Dicit ei: Pasce agnos meos.
tr: οτε ουν ηριστησαν λεγει τω σιμωνι πετρω ο ιησους σιμων ιωνα αγαπας με πλειον τουτων  λεγει αυτω ναι κυριε συ οιδας οτι φιλω σε λεγει αυτω βοσκε τα αρνια μου
kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

vulg: dicit ei iterum Simon Iohannis diligis me ait illi etiam Domine tu scis quia amo te dicit ei pasce agnos meos
clem: Dicit ei iterum: Simon Joannis, diligis me? Ait illi: Etiam Domine, tu scis quia amo te. Dicit ei: Pasce agnos meos.
tr: λεγει αυτω παλιν δευτερον σιμων ιωνα αγαπας με λεγει αυτω ναι κυριε συ οιδας οτι φιλω σε λεγει αυτω ποιμαινε τα προβατα μου
kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

vulg: dicit ei tertio Simon Iohannis amas me contristatus est Petrus quia dixit ei tertio amas me et dicit ei Domine tu omnia scis tu scis quia amo te dicit ei pasce oves meas
clem: Dicit ei tertio: Simon Joannis, amas me? Contristatus est Petrus, quia dixit ei tertio: Amas me? et dixit ei: Domine, tu omnia nosti, tu scis quia amo te. Dixit ei: Pasce oves meas.
tr: λεγει αυτω το τριτον σιμων ιωνα φιλεις με ελυπηθη ο πετρος οτι ειπεν αυτω το τριτον φιλεις με και ειπεν αυτω κυριε συ παντα οιδας συ γινωσκεις οτι φιλω σε λεγει αυτω ο ιησους βοσκε τα προβατα μου
kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

vulg: amen amen dico tibi cum esses iunior cingebas te et ambulabas ubi volebas cum autem senueris extendes manus tuas et alius te cinget et ducet quo non vis
clem: Amen, amen dico tibi: cum esses junior, cingebas te, et ambulabas ubi volebas: cum autem senueris, extendes manus tuas, et alius te cinget, et ducet quo tu non vis.
tr: αμην αμην λεγω σοι οτε ης νεωτερος εζωννυες σεαυτον και περιεπατεις οπου ηθελες οταν δε γηρασης εκτενεις τας χειρας σου και αλλος σε ζωσει και οισει οπου ου θελεις
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdest thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

vulg: hoc autem dixit significans qua morte clarificaturus esset Deum et hoc cum dixisset dicit ei sequere me
clem: Hoc autem dixit significans qua morte clarificaturus esset Deum. Et cum hoc dixisset, dicit ei: Sequere me.
tr: τουτο δε ειπεν σημαινων ποιω θανατω δοξασει τον θεον και τουτο ειπων λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι
kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

vulg: conversus Petrus vidit illum discipulum quem diligebat Iesus sequentem qui et recubuit in cena super pectus eius et dixit Domine quis est qui tradit te
clem: Conversus Petrus vidit illum discipulum, quem diligebat Jesus, sequentem, qui et recubuit in cna super pectus ejus, et dixit: Domine, quis est qui tradet te?
tr: επιστραφεις δε ο πετρος βλεπει τον μαθητην ον ηγαπα ο ιησους ακολουθουντα ος και ανεπεσεν εν τω δειπνω επι το στηθος αυτου και ειπεν κυριε τις εστιν ο παραδιδους σε
kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

vulg: hunc ergo cum vidisset Petrus dicit Iesu Domine hic autem quid
clem: Hunc ergo cum vidisset Petrus, dixit Jesu: Domine, hic autem quid?
tr: τουτον ιδων ο πετρος λεγει τω ιησου κυριε ουτος δε τι
kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

vulg: dicit ei Iesus si sic eum volo manere donec veniam quid ad te tu me sequere
clem: Dicit ei Jesus: Sic eum volo manere donec veniam, quid ad te? tu me sequere.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους εαν αυτον θελω μενειν εως ερχομαι τι προς σε συ ακολουθει μοι
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

vulg: exivit ergo sermo iste in fratres quia discipulus ille non moritur et non dixit ei Iesus non moritur sed si sic eum volo manere donec venio quid ad te
clem: Exiit ergo sermo iste inter fratres quia discipulus ille non moritur. Et non dixit ei Jesus: Non moritur, sed: Sic eum volo manere donec veniam, quid ad te?
tr: εξηλθεν ουν ο λογος ουτος εις τους αδελφους οτι ο μαθητης εκεινος ουκ αποθνησκει και ουκ ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους οτι ουκ αποθνησκει αλλ εαν αυτον θελω μενειν εως ερχομαι τι προς σε
kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

vulg: hic est discipulus qui testimonium perhibet de his et scripsit haec et scimus quia verum est testimonium eius
clem: Hic est discipulus ille qui testimonium perhibet de his, et scripsit hc: et scimus quia verum est testimonium ejus.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο μαθητης ο μαρτυρων περι τουτων και γραψας ταυτα και οιδαμεν οτι αληθης εστιν η μαρτυρια αυτου
kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

vulg: sunt autem et alia multa quae fecit Iesus quae si scribantur per singula nec ipsum arbitror mundum capere eos qui scribendi sunt libros amen
clem: Sunt autem et alia multa qu fecit Jesus: qu si scribantur per singula, nec ipsum arbitror mundum capere posse eos, qui scribendi sunt, libros.
tr: εστιν δε και αλλα πολλα οσα εποιησεν ο ιησους ατινα εαν γραφηται καθ εν ουδε αυτον οιμαι τον κοσμον χωρησαι τα γραφομενα βιβλια αμην
kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
